COLONEL WEN YING SING COMMENDED FOR ARRESTING HEADS OF THE
SOUTH-EASTERN SELF-DEFENCE ARMY.
Mr. Wu Tieh Chen, Mayor of the Municipalty of
Greater Shanghai, has received a telegram from General Chiang Kai
Shek, Chief of the Military Affairs Committee, commencing having
arrested Chiang Ming Chi and other important members of the South-
Eastern Self-Defence Army, which organ is prejudicial to the Republic
of China.

------
Alleged rebel - Court proceedings
Tsiang Ming-tsih who was arrested at 744 Sze Wei
Li, Seymour Road, on March 19 on a Shanghai Special District
Court warrant (issued at the request of the Bureau of
Public Safety), charging him with being a rebel, appeared
before Court on March 21 when representatives of the
Bureau of Public Safety applied for his extradition.
The Court,however, ruled that the Safety Bureau had not
made out a prima facie case and ordered a remand until
23 to enable the Bureau to produce two prisoners in its
custody who had implicated the accused.

涉嫌叛乱分子 - 法庭诉讼程序
蒋明之（Tsiang Ming-tsih）于3月19日持上海特区地方法院传票（应公安局请求签发），以叛乱罪名在西摩路（Seymour Road）四维里744号被捕，并于3月21日出庭，当时公安局代表申请将其引渡。
然而，法院裁定公安局尚未确立表面证据确凿的案件，并命令还押至23日，以便该局提审两名在其羁押下且牵涉被告的囚犯。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-
Statements taken personally from Instigators of the
South-Eastern Self-Defence Army
According to information secured by a report of
the Kyo Min News Agency, after the extradition of the
prisoners of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army from the
2nd Branch Kiangsu High Court to the Public Safety Bureau,
Colonel Vung Ying Shing, Chief of the Bureau, instructed the
Investigation Office of the 3rd Section to undertake the
responsibility for conducting the examination of the case.
Strict inquiries have been in progress and the truth of
the case has gradually come out. A report on the case
has been submitted respectively to the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters and the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai for instructions.

of the Military Department of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison

visited the offices of the Public Safety Bureau, and ordered
the offenders of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army to be
brought before him when he personally secured their
statements.

Members of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army questioned
by the Bureau of Public Safety

All ten men including one Chang Min Yuan of the
South-Eastern Self-defence Army organized in the Datung
Hotel, after careful investigation by the Court, were sent
the day before yesterday to the Bureau of Public Safety
of the Shanghai Special District where they were questioned
one by one during the night. According to the statement
unanimously confirmed by the ten men, the Southern-Eastern
Self-defence Army is an organization the principle of which
is national salvation in resisting Japan.

They regretted they were unable to proceed to the
front to fight for the Nation and refused to admit that they
had any other purposes. Furthermore, they stated that formerly
they had all been high military officers, possession excellent
records, so they will never permit themselves to attempt any
violation of the law.

The Bureau of Public Safety reported the matter to the
higher officials and the case may be submitted in the near
future to Nanking for final investigation.

In its issue of March 16th the "Kuo Nan Wan Ker"
reports the following on the above cases:

Rumoured that South-Eastern Self-defence Army
Organized by the Japanese

According to the information from the Bureau of
Public Safety, it appears that the purposes for organizing the
South-Eastern Army are rather puzzling. Chief Police Officer
Yang of the Bureau was approached with the proposal to serve

公安局讯问东南自卫军成员

包括张明远在内的十名在大通旅馆组织的东南自卫军成员，经法院仔细调查后，于前天被送往上海特区公安局，并在夜间逐一接受讯问。根据这十人一致确认的供词，东南自卫军是一个以抗日救国为宗旨的组织。

他们表示遗憾未能前往前线为国作战，并拒绝承认有任何其他目的。此外，他们声称以前都是高级军官，拥有良好的履历，因此绝不会允许自己尝试任何违法行为。

公安局已将此事上报上级官员，该案可能在不久的将来提交南京进行最终调查。

3月16日出版的《国民晚报》就上述案件报道如下：

谣传东南自卫军由日本人组织

据公安局消息，组织东南军的目的似乎相当令人困惑。有人向该局杨警官提议，由其担任

pages.en:
- 2 -

as Divisional Commander of the 3rd Division. Wang pretended
to accept the appointment, but privately reported this matter
to Mr. Wen, the chief of the Bureau of Public Safety. Further
investigations disclosed that the above Army was formed in
accordance with instructions from a certain Chinese, named
Chow, and arms and ammunitions were supplied by the Japanese.
It appears that the sole object of this organization was to
seize political reign of powers of Shanghai and destroy the
good order at present prevailing in Nantao.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

第三师师长。王假装接受任命，但私下将此事项报告给公安局长温先生。进一步调查显示，上述军队是根据一位姓周的中国人的指示组建的，武器弹药由日本人提供。看来该组织的唯一目的是夺取上海的政治统治权，并破坏南市目前的良好秩序。

The eleven men arrested on March 12 at the request
of the Public Safety Bureau for plotting the overthrow
of the Public Safety Bureau and the Municipality of

"All the accused, together with the evidence
"and articles seized, are ordered to be
"handed over with the exception of Tan
"Tsai-sien (譚財光), 11th accused, who is
"to find security and surrender himself
"to the Public Safety Bureau Authorities in
"case he is required."

Subject (in full) Arrest of 'Revolutionaries' in the Settlement

Made by ____________________ and ____________________ Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

At 4.10 p.m. March 12, members of the Public
Safety Bureau requested assistance from Louza Station to
arrest persons who were using Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great
Eastern Hotel, Kin Wo Kan, off Nanking Road as a meeting
place where they were plotting the overthrow of the Public
Safety Bureau and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
A party of Municipal Police attended and the following nine
persons were arrested:

Lee Ming-tsoong （李敏崇）
Li Sing-ngoh （李醒我）
Soong Suh-tsang （宋武漳）
Chou Tsz-zah （周子石）
Chhu Keng-zung （周幹臣）
Iung Ngoh-ding （尹玉亭）
Woong Zoong-zung （王仲仁）
Sung Ngoh-su （孫玉書）
Tsang Ming-yuen （張明遠）

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized showing the arrested men to belong to an
organization known as the "Headquarters of the South-Eastern
Self Defence Army"（東南自衛軍）. At 9.30 p.m. on the
same day Municipal Police with the assistance of members
of the French Police and Nantao Police searched the home
of the 2nd accused Lee Sing-ngoh （李醒我） at 7 Rue Chapsal
and seized a suitcase containing documents and correspondence
and in addition visited the home of the third accused Soong
Suh-tsang （宋武漳） at 26 Sing Ning Taung Alleyway,
Rue Brenier de Montmorand where a box containing documents
and correspondence was seized and the two persons as follows

3月12日下午4时10分，公安局成员请求老闸捕房协助，逮捕那些利用南京路附近金沃馆（Kin Wo Kan）大东旅馆29号和34号房间作为集会地点的人，他们正在策划推翻公安局和大上海特别市政府。

李敏崇 （Lee Ming-tsoong）

宋武漳 （Soong Suh-tsang）
周子石 （Chou Tsz-zah）

查获大量文件、印章和委任状，显示被捕人员属于一个名为“东南自卫军总部”（東南自衛軍）的组织。同日晚上9时30分，工部局警察在法国警察和南市警察的协助下，搜查了第二被告李醒我（李醒我）位于查普萨尔路（Rue Chapsal）7号的住所，查获一个装有文件和信件的公文箱，此外还走访了第三被告宋武漳（宋武漳）位于白利南路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）新宁唐弄堂26号的住所，在那里查获一个装有文件和信件的箱子，以及以下两人

found on the premises, taken into custody

The seizure at this address, on examination, however, proved of
no value and had no bearing on the case.

From statements made by the accused copies of which
are attached it appears that the Public Safety Bureau and
the offices of the various organs of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai were to be occupied by the South Eastern Self
Defence Army at a certain time on March 13. The nucleus of
this army was to consist of members of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Merchants Volunteer Corps for which assistance
$100,000 was to be paid and 2,000 rifle supplied to the
representative of the Bureau in question together with an
assurance that no dismissal or change of the present staff
of the Public Safety Bureau would be effected. The new
army when formed would be commanded by General Chow Feng-chi
(周鳳岐), who according to the statement of the first and
principal accused Li Ming-tsoong, engineered the plot under
the name of Li Ngoh (李鰲).

General Chou Feng-chi who resides at 146 Rue Pere
Robert is notorious for his treachery against Lu Yung-hsiang
(盧永祥), Tuchun of Chekiang, when he was overthrown by
Sun Chuan Fang and against the latter when the Nationalists
entered Chekiang in 1927. For his desertion of Sun Chuan-
fang the Nationalists appointed him commander of the 26th
Army which occupied Chapei and Paoshan in 1927. He held
this post for about six months when his command was given

然而，经检查，在此地址查获的物品被证明毫无价值，且与本案无关。

从附后的被告供词副本来看，东南自卫军计划于3月13日的某个时刻占领公共安全局及大上海市政府各机关办公室。该军队的核心将由公共安全局成员和商团义勇队组成，为此将向该局代表支付10万美元援助金并提供2,000支步枪，同时保证不对公共安全局现有人员进行解职或变动。新军队组建后，将由周鳳岐将军指挥，据第一主要被告李敏宗（Li Ming-tsoong）供称，该阴谋是以李鰲（Li Ngoh）之名策划的。

居住在罗伯特神父路146号的周鳳岐将军，因其背叛行为而臭名昭著：先是在浙江督军盧永祥被孙传芳推翻时背叛卢，后又在1927年国民革命军进入浙江时背叛孙传芳。因其背弃孙传芳，国民革命军任命他为第二十六军军长，该军于1927年占领了闸北和宝山。他担任此职约六个月，后因蒋介石对其忠诚度表示怀疑，其指挥权被移交

My name is Soong Sih Tseng (宋式璋), alias Soong Hai-
liang (宋季良). I am 26 years of age and a native of
Changsha, Hunan. I am married and have one son who lives
with my wife at Changsha. I am chief of the Registration
Department of the Kiangnan Arsenal.

At 7 years of age, I commenced my education in a primary
school at Changsha and after studying there for 5 years I
continued my studies in the Ming Teh University at Hankow
which I attended for 8 years studying literature. On
graduating I returned to my native home and stayed there
for 3 years maintaining myself on property left by my
father who died when I was 6 years of age. At the end of
that period I went to Hankow where I obtained employment
as a clerk for 2 years with the Municipal Council of the
Russian Concession. On leaving the employment the Municipality
of the Russian Concession I became chief of the Correspondence
Department of the Hupoh Provincial Bank, Hankow for 6 months
I then took over the position as chief of the First Department
of the Saltpetre and Sulphur Bureau of Hupoh Province at a
salary of $120.00 per mensem which I retained until April
1921. I then returned to my home at Changsha and in July
of the same year I went to Peking in Chekiang to manage
Yang Kwokman which lasted for months. In September 1921
I went to Peking to visit my brother Soong Sih Chen who was
then Vice-Minister of Railways. At the end of November
1921 I came to Shanghai and took up residence at the Shanghai
Railway Station, No. 34 Szechuen Road, Shanghai.

（李泽桂起诉书样本）

宋式璋 (Soong Sih Tseng)，
湖南长沙。刑侦督察 Robertson。
兰心分局 1930年3月12日 书记员：廖俊健

我叫宋式璋，别名宋季良。我今年26岁，籍贯湖南长沙。我已婚，有一子，与妻子同住长沙。我是江南兵工厂登记处处长。

7岁时，我在长沙的一所小学开始受教育，在那里学习了5年后，我继续在汉口明德大学求学，攻读文学8年。毕业后，我回到家乡，依靠父亲留下的财产生活了3年，父亲在我6岁时去世。期满后，我前往汉口，在俄国租界工部局担任书记员2年。离开俄国租界工部局后，我成为汉口湖北银行通讯处处长，为期6个月。随后，我接任湖北省硝磺局第一处处长的职位，月薪120美元，一直任职至1921年4月。之后我回到长沙家中，同年7月我去浙江北京管理杨国曼（音译）事务，持续了数月。1921年9月，我去北京探望当时任铁道部次长的哥哥宋式珍。1921年11月底，我来到上海，住在上海四川路34号上海火车站。

pages.en:
-2-
the purchase of drainage machinery. During my visits I used to
reside at the ei Tsong (惠中) Hotel on Nanking Road. In Wuhu
I was on friendly terms with Leo Ts Yuan (李子遠), magistrate
of the Tu Wei (湖) Hsien. Leo and Yuan were also
chairman of the Wu Wei (合肥) Fellow Countrymen's Association
in Wuhu, but I never met any persons belonging to any military
or political circles. Following the closing down of the mines
I returned to my native place where I remained for about one
year during which period I visited Wuhu at irregular intervals
for the purpose of calling on friends and relatives and in
connection with the affairs of the mine. At this time I was
28 years old. On the 2nd day of the 1st moon 1932 (February 7,
1932) I left home and proceeded to Chi Tung (啟東) island near
Haimen (海門), in response to a letter from a villager named
Kwei Ts Kwong (管志剛), who is the chief of a police detachment
at Chi Tung. I proceeded via the following route: From Wuhu to
Nanking by steamer, thence by rail to Nantziang where I alighted; by
boat to Loutien (羅店) and after walking to Liuho (瀏河)
completed the journey to Chi Tung by boat. Upon arrival I was
met by Kwei. I lived with him for twenty days and as he was
unable to assist me to secure employment I returned to the mainland
in company with one Tsoong Ming (宋明), a training officer in
the Chi Tung Police, who was proceeding to Shanghai for the
purpose of making some purchases. The letter I had received from
Kwei was left at Chi Tung, and prior to my departure Kwei gave me
$50. We landed at Liuho and proceeded to Nantziang. Here we obtain-
ed a lift in a Red Cross car as far as Chenjia. At this place we
stayed one night and on the following day continued our journey
to Shanghai in company with a Kempo coolie who acted as guide.
On arrival in the Ferry Road district we crossed the Creek
(Soochow) and entered into the settlement. Here we parted
company with our guide after paying him 90 cents. Tsoong
Ming and I went to the Tzong Chang (同昌) lodging house on
pages.zh:
-2-
购买排水机械事宜。在此期间，我通常住在南京路的惠中酒店。在芜湖，我与湖县知事李子遠（Leo Ts Yuan）关系友好。李和袁也是芜湖合肥同乡会的主席，但我从未接触过任何军方或政界人士。矿山关闭后，我回到家乡，在那里停留了大约一年，期间不定期访问芜湖，目的是拜访亲友和处理矿山事务。当时我28岁。1932年正月初二（1932年2月7日），我离家前往海门附近的啟東岛，是应一位名叫管志剛的村民的信邀，他是啟東一名警察分队的队长。我经由以下路线前往：从芜湖乘轮船到南京，然后乘火车到南翔下车；乘船到羅店，步行到瀏河后，再乘船完成到啟東的旅程。到达后，管接待了我。我与他同住了二十天，因他无法帮我找到工作，我便与啟東警察的一名训练官宋明一同返回大陆，宋明正前往上海采购物品。我从管那里收到的信留在了啟東，临行前管给了我50美元。我们在瀏河上岸，前往南翔。在这里，我们搭了一辆红十字会的车直到陈家。在此地住了一晚，第二天在一位充当向导的广东苦力的陪同下，继续前往上海。到达斐伦路地区后，我们越过苏州河，进入租界。在此我们付给向导9角钱后与其分手。宋明和我去了同昌客栈，位于

pages.en:
- 3 -
I only stayed a few moments and then went to the barber's.
On going back after an absence of one hour to Room 28,
I found about six persons among whom were Tseng Ming Yua
and Li Singteh. I seated myself in a corner of the room
and observed that the table was covered with papers. I
heard one man dressed in a Khaki coloured uniform, Wong
Seong Tang(王仲仁), say to Li Sing Tang that every thing
was ready and they were going to the Municipal police
of Greater Shanghai to-morrow morning, March 15.
A few minutes later the police arrived and arrested
every one in the room.
Li Ming Tseng appears to be the head of the
movement at the Great Eastern and one named Fung King is
responsible for the entire activities.

我只待了一会儿，然后去理发店。
一小时后回到28号房间时，
我发现房间里大约有六个人，其中包括曾明远和李顺德。
我坐在房间的一个角落，
注意到桌子上铺满了文件。
我听到一个身穿卡其色制服的人，王仲仁 (Wong Seong Tang)，对李顺德说，一切准备就绪，他们打算明天早上，即3月15日，去大上海市政府警察局。
几分钟后，警察赶到，逮捕了房间里的所有人。
李敏宗似乎是大东方饭店行动的负责人，而一个叫冯京的人负责全部活动。
