SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
S.1, Special Branch.
No. D 3369
Date May 11, 1932.
// / 5 / 32

REPORT

Subject (in full) Unsuccessful Coup d'Etat in Nantao and
arrest of 12 participants.

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt

The 10 persons arrested in connection with the
above conspiracy by the Shanghai Municipal Police at the
request of the Public Safety Bureau were, after extradition
to Nantao were dispatched to Nanking where they were tried before
a military tribunal, the result of which was that the 1st
accused Li Ming Chung (李敏宇) and Tsiang Ming Jih (蒋明傑)
were sentenced to death and were executed on May 2nd, 1932
at Nanking. Tsang Ming Yuen (张鸣远), 9th accused was
sentenced to life imprisonment whilst the remainder were
found not guilty and released.

Confirmation of the foregoing information has
been obtained from the Headquarters of the Public Safety
Bureau, Nantao.

D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,

Information.

O. i/c Sp. Br.
MAY 11 1932

报告

主题（全称） 南市未遂政变及逮捕12名参与者。

由 D. S. Golder 撰写 经警司 Tho Robertson 转呈

上述阴谋案件中，应公安局请求由上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕的10人，在被引渡至南市后，被遣送南京，由军事法庭受审。审判结果为：第一被告李敏宇（Li Ming Chung）和蒋明傑（Tsiang Ming Jih）被判处死刑，并于1932年5月2日在南京执行。第九被告张鸣远（Tsang Ming Yuen）被判处无期徒刑，其余人员被判无罪释放。

上述信息已从南市公安局总部获得证实。

D. S.

特科主管警官。

阁下，

List of documents seized in Room 29, Great Eastern Hotel,
at 4.20 pm, March 13.

1) Draft of a document containing orders instructing the
various squads of the Public Safety Bureau to occupy the
Bureau and the important points in Nantao on the forenoon
of March 13, 1932.
2) List of names and addresses of the official organs and public
utility concerns in Nantao.
3) Letter paper of the Great Eastern Hotel containing notes
relating to badges, flags, passes, circulars to
Consulates and local public bodies, password, signals and
flags.
4) Draft of a circular telegram, signed by "Commander-in-Chief
Lee Ngeh (李萼)", telling about the attack upon Chapei
by Japan, denouncing General Chiang Kai Shek as a traitor,
and urging the people to support the South-Eastern Self-
Defence Army which is to effect the salvation of the nation.
5) Draft of a manifesto denouncing General Chiang Kai Shek
and Mr. Wang Ching Wei for their "non-resistance" policy
and claiming that the "South-Eastern Self-Defence Army"
aims at the overthrow of traitors and the protection of
Chinese territory.
6) Two papers containing the names of the following officers
of the Public Safety Bureau :-
(1)
a) Yih Tseen Zung (易贊仁), In-charge of 2nd Branch, 1st District
Station.
b) Ning Li Bing (寧麗平), in-charge of 6th District.
c) Zung Wei Zien (淩維賢), in-charge of 1st Branch of 4th
District Station.
d) Lee Ying (李英), Chief Detective.
(Note) Please note that the above are intimates.
(2)
a) Yen Wen Ngeh's (嚴文額) men, 1st large Squad of the 3rd Main
Group, Tseng Ka Doe and vicinity.
b) Wang Yeong Kwei's (王永貴) men, 2nd Large squad of 3rd Main

Subject (in full) Unsuccessful Coup d'Etat in Nantao and
arrest of 12 participants.

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

The 10 persons arrested in connection with the
above conspiracy by the Shanghai Municipal Police at the
request of the Public Safety Bureau were, after extradition
to Nantao dispatched to Nanking where they were tried before
a military tribunal, the result of which was that the 1st
accused Li Ming Chung (李敏宇.) and Tsiang Ming Jih (蒋明杰)
were sentenced to death and were executed on May 2nd, 1932
at Nanking. Tsang Ming Yuen (张鸣远), 9th accused was
sentenced to life imprisonment whilst the remainder were
found not guilty and released.

Confirmation of the foregoing information has
been obtained from the Headquarters of the Public Safety
Bureau, Nantao.

D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,

Subject (in full) Resume of plot to stage coup d'etat at Nantao and
arrest of participants

Made by... D.S. Golder .................................................... Forwarded by... Tho Robertson, Supt.

On the night of March 10, 1932, Huang Ming (黄明),
Commander of the Reserve Unit of the Public Safety Bureau
reported to the headquarters of the Bureau that he had learned
from Sheng Shih-cheu (盛澤球), Commander of the 8th Corps
of the Reserve Unit and Kiangs Sung-dau (江聲濤), Commander
of the 1st Corps of the Reserve Unit that one Wang Zoong-jen
(王仲仁) at that time a military instructor in the Great
China University had at the instigation of one Chow Feng-chi
approached the two Corps Commanders requesting them to throw
in their lot with a plot to form a South Eastern Defence
Army. According to the plot Chow and his confederates had
planned to effect a coup d'etat at Nantao following which
they would assume control of Nantao, the Western District
and Pootung, the last named place being selected as a military
base. Sheng and Kiang were also asked to obtain the assistance
of the Merchant Volunteers who, according to plans, were to
form the nucleus of the new Army.

General Wen Ying-sing (温應星), Chief of the
Public Safety Bureau observing the seriousness of the
situation instructed the two Corps Commanders to act as
though falling in with the plot and attend any meetings of
the conspirators to which they were invited, whilst every
precautions was taken to avoid any untimely insurrection.

At 3 p.m. on March 11, 1932, Huang Ming, Kiang Sung-
dau and others of the Public Safety Bureau were instructed to
attend a meeting of the conspirators which was to be held in
the Great Eastern Hotel. During the meeting it was revealed
that Chow Feng-chi was the Commander-in-Chief of the South
Eastern Self Defence Army, whilst Li Ming-chung (李敏宗)

(批：Excellent report. 3/5)

1932年3月10日晚，公安局后备队指挥官黄明 (Huang Ming) 向局总部报告称，他从后备队第八团团长盛澤球 (Sheng Shih-cheu) 和后备队第一团团长江聲濤 (Kiangs Sung-dau) 处获悉，当时在大夏大学担任军事教官的王仲仁 (Wang Zoong-jen) 在周凤岐 (Chow Feng-chi) 的唆使下，接近这两位团长，请求他们加入组建东南防卫军的阴谋。根据该阴谋，周及其同伙计划在南市发动政变，随后控制南市、西区及浦东，最后选定浦东作为军事基地。盛和江还被要求获得商团义勇队的协助，根据计划，商团义勇队将组成新军的核心。

公安局局长温應星 (Wen Ying-sing) 将军鉴于局势严重，指示两位团长假装附和该阴谋，并参加受邀出席的任何密谋者会议，同时采取一切预防措施以避免过早发生暴动。

1932年3月11日下午3时，黄明、江聲濤及其他公安局人员奉命参加将在大东旅馆举行的密谋者会议。会议期间透露，周凤岐是东南自卫军总司令，而李敏宗 (Li Ming-chung)

was Commander of the Army, Chang Ming-yuen (張鳴遠),
Chief of Staff and Wang Zoong-chi (王仲仁), Chief of the
Public Safety Bureau to be formed under the new regime.
Other offices such as the Chief of the Staff Office, Chief
of the Adjutants Office, Chief of the Military Supply
Office and Chief of the Secretariat had been filled by other
adherents to the plot.
It transpired during the meeting that the aims of
the conspiracy were to occupy Nantao, at the same time
taking over the various organs of the Municipality, and
thereafter overthrow the present Nanking regime and offer
armed resistance to the Japanese. The next meeting of the
plotters was arranged for March 12 whilst the Coup d'Etat
was staged for the early morning of March 13. At the
request of Kiang Sung-dau, another meeting was held at
4 p.m. March 12 who received from Li Ming-chung $3,000.00
as an initial payment for the buying over of the Merchants
Volunteers together with documents appertaining to his
prospective post under the new regime.
At 4.10 p.m. on March 12 members of the Public
Safety Bureau and members of the Municipal Police who had
been previously warned regarding the march of events
raided Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great Eastern Hotel, Kin Wo
Kan, which rooms were being used by the plotters as their
meeting place. The following nine persons were apprehended
in addition to the seizure of a number of shops and letters
of appointment which incriminated the prisoners in a plot to
form a military unit to be styled "The South Eastern Self
Defence Corps":-

是军队指挥官，张鸣远 (Chang Ming-yuen) 是参谋长，王仲仁 (Wang Zoong-chi) 是新政权下拟成立的公安局局长。其他职位，如参谋处处长、副官处处长、军需处处长和秘书长，也由其他阴谋追随者担任。
会议期间透露，该阴谋的目标是占领南市，同时接管市政府的各个机构，随后推翻目前的南京政权，并对日本人进行武装抵抗。密谋者的下一次会议安排在3月12日，而政变定于3月13日凌晨发动。应江聲濤的请求，3月12日下午4时又举行了一次会议，他从李敏宗那里收到3,000.00美元，作为收买商团义勇队的首付款，以及与他在新政权下的预期职位相关的文件。
3月12日下午4时10分，事先已获知事态发展的公安局人员和市政警察突袭了金沃馆 (Kin Wo Kan) 大东旅馆的29号和34号房间，这些房间被密谋者用作会议地点。除了查获一批商店文件和任命书（这些文件证明囚犯参与组建名为“东南自卫军”的军事单位的阴谋）外，还逮捕了以下九人：

Academy and an individual with a varied military career,
who took part in the attack and capture of Shanghai in
1927 when he was an officer of the 26th Army under
General Chow Feng-chi (周鳳岐). Since 1927 he has

native province, Anhui.
2. Li Sing-ngoh was at the age of 19 a liaison officer
of the 19th Independent Brigade under Wu Pei-fu and at
the time of his arrest was an inspector in the Kiangnan
Arsenal.
3. Soong Suh-tsang was Chief of the Registration Department
of the Kiangnan Arsenal.
4. Chow Tsz-zah after graduating from the Wen Chi University,
Kiangwan, was appointed as postal and telegraph censor
in the Defence Commissioner's Office, Kiukiang. He
served with the 26th Army at Shanghai in 1927 and was a
pawn under various military commanders until late in
1930 when he fell out of employment and remained so

forced to flee. Chow has lived on political and military
intrigue for the past 25 years and according to the statement
of one of the prisoners was considered by the plotters as
a very suitable man to engineer a coup of this description.

周凤岐将军在阴谋策划期间居住于神父路146号（Rue Pere Robert），他因1927年背叛浙江督军卢永祥，以及后来向国民党出卖孙传芳而臭名昭著，国民党任命他为第二十六军军长，该军占领了闸北和法南。在蒋介石眼中，周一直是个不可靠的人物，因此他后来被解除职务并不令人意外。下一次听到他的消息是在1929年12月，当时他在杭州发动政变的计划失败，被迫逃亡。过去25年来，周一直依靠政治和军事阴谋为生，据一名囚犯供称，策划者认为他是策划此类政变的非常合适的人选。

pages.en:
COPY
The following is the statement of Lee Min Tsong (    )
native of Amhei taken by me D.I. Ross.
at Louza on the 12.3.32 and interpreted by Clerk Zung.

My name is Lee Min Tsong (李敏宗), 29 years of age
and a native of Hu-wei (合肥) Hsien, Amhei. I am married
and have four children. My wife and family are at my native
place. I studied for a number of years at a private school in
Hu Wei. On attaining the age 21 I came to Shanghai with the
object of visiting a relative named Van Ngoh Ling (范毓麟).
Chief of Staff to General Lu Yung Hsieng (盧永祥). I was
unable to find him so I called on a friend of my father named
General Ching Ngoh Tseng (金華振), in General Lu Yung Hsiang's
Army; who lived in the neighbourhood of the Head Post Office.
The exact address I am unable to recall to memory. On the
recommendation of General Ching I proceeded to Canton where I
entered the Whampoa Military Academy. In this institution I
studied infantry manoeuvres for about three months when I was
compelled to discontinue owing to sickness brought on by the
unfavourable climatic conditions. The president of the
academy was General Chiang Kai Shek. I then returned to my
native place and lived with my parents who are still alive.
My father's name is Lee Tsung You (李正佑). He is not connected
with any political party and is a principal shareholder in a
steam launch company. Sometime later I went to Wuhu, Anhui
to enter the employ of the Yuan Li (源利) Coal Mining Co., as
assistant manager. In this concern my father holds shares
to the amount of $8,000. In this capacity I worked until
1930, when the company suspended operations following the
flooding of the mines and rendering them unsafe for further work.
While in Wuhu I had occasion to visit Shanghai in connection with
pages.zh:
副本
以下是我，巡官罗斯（Ross），于1932年3月12日在老闸捕房讯问安徽籍人士李敏宗（Lee Min Tsong）所作的供词，由职员钟（Zung）翻译。

我叫李敏宗，29岁，安徽合肥县人。我已婚，有四个孩子。我的妻子和家人都在老家。我在合肥的一所私塾读了几年书。21岁时，我来到上海，目的是探望一位名叫范毓麟（Van Ngoh Ling）的亲戚，他是卢永祥将军的参谋长。我没找到他，于是去拜访了我父亲的一位朋友金华振将军（Ching Ngoh Tseng），他在卢永祥军中服役，住在邮政总局附近。具体的地址我记不起来了。在金将军的推荐下，我前往广州，进入了黄埔军校。在该校我学习了约三个月的步兵操演，后因气候条件恶劣导致生病，不得不中断学业。该校校长是蒋介石将军。随后我回到老家，与仍然健在的父母同住。我父亲名叫李正佑（Lee Tsung You）。他不属于任何政党，是一家轮船公司的主要股东。不久后，我去安徽芜湖，受雇于源利煤矿公司，担任副经理。在这家公司，我父亲持有价值8000美元的股份。我在此职位上工作到1930年，当时因矿井被淹，不再适合继续作业，公司停止了运营。
在芜湖期间，我曾因

pages.en:
-2-
the purchase of drainage machinery. During my visits I used to
reside at the Wei Tsong (惠中) Hotel on Hankow Road. In Wuhu
I was on friendly terms with Lee Ts Yuan (李子遠), magistrate
of the Wu Wei (無為) Hsien, Anhwei and Yuan Ter Chu (袁特樞)
chairman of the Huh Wei (合肥) Fellow Countrymen's Association
in Wuhu, but I never met any persons belonging to any military
or political circles. Following the closing down of the mines
I returned to my native place where I remained for about one
year during which period I visited Wuhu at irregular intervals
for the purpose of calling on friends and relatives and in
connection with the affairs of the mine. As this time I was
28 years old. On the 2nd day of the 1st moon 1932 (February 7,
1932) I left home and proceeded to Chi Tung (啟東) island near
Hainan (海門), in response to a letter from a villager named
Kwei Ts Kwong (歸志剛), who is the chief of a Police detachment
at Chi Tung. I proceeded via the following route: From Wuhu to
Nanking by steamer, thence by rail to Nantziang where I alighted; by
boat to Leotien (羅店) and after walking to Liuho (瀏河)
completed the journey to Chi Tung by boat. Upon arrival I was
met by Kwei. I lived with him for twenty days and as he was
unable to assist me to secure employment I returned to the mainland
in company with one Tsoong Ming (宗明), a training officer in
the Chi Tung Police, who was proceeding to Shanghai for the
purpose of making some purchases. The letter I had received from
Kwei was left at Chi Tung, and prior to my departure Kwei gave me
$50. We landed at Liuho and proceeded to Nantziang. Here we obtain-
ed a lift in a Red Cross car as far as Chenju. At this place we
stayed one night and on the following day continued our journey
to Shanghai in company with a Keape coolie who acted as guide.
On arrival in the Ferry Road district we crossed the Creek
(Soochow) and entered into the Settlement. Here we parted
company with our guide after paying his 30 cents. Tsoong
Ming and I went to the Tseong Chung (中正) lodging house in
pages.zh:
-2-
购买排水机械事宜去过上海。在访问期间，我通常住在汉口路的惠中酒店。在芜湖时，我与安徽无为县知事李子远（Lee Ts Yuan）以及芜湖合肥同乡会会长袁特枢（Yuan Ter Chu）关系友好，但我从未接触过任何军方或政界人士。矿井关闭后，我回到老家，在那里待了大约一年，期间不定期地去芜湖拜访亲友并处理矿务事宜。那时我28岁。1932年正月初二（1932年2月7日），我离家前往海门附近的启东岛，这是应一位名叫归志刚（Kwei Ts Kwong）的村民的信邀，他是启东一支警察分队的队长。我经过以下路线前往：从芜湖乘船到南京，然后乘火车到南翔下车；乘船到罗店，步行到浏河后，再乘船完成到启东的旅程。到达后，归志刚接待了我。我与他同住了二十天，由于他无法帮我找到工作，我便与启东警察的一名训练员宗明（Tsoong Ming）一同返回大陆，宗明正前往上海采购物品。我从归志刚那里收到的信留在了启东，临行前归志刚给了我50美元。我们在浏河上岸，前往南翔。在这里，我们搭上了一辆红十字会汽车，直到陈行。我们在那里住了一晚，第二天在一位充当向导的江北苦力的陪同下，继续前往上海。到达斐伦路地区后，我们越过苏州河，进入租界。付给向导30角钱后，我们与他分手。宗明和我去了

pages.en:
-3-
Avenue Joffre, where we rented a room in Tsong's name, for one
day. The date of our arrival in Shanghai, was on the 2nd day
of the 2nd Moon, 1932 (March 8, 1932). During the afternoon of
this date I was loitering on the footpath outside the lodging
house when I observed a kinsman of mine named Lee Ngoh (李鳌)
walking along the same footpath in a westerly direction. I
approached and stopped him and after conversing together on
general matters we entered the lodging house. The last time I
saw Lee was at my native place about 3 years ago, and I had no
idea that he was in Shanghai. At this time Tsoong was absent,
he having gone out shopping. I told Lee about my visit to
Chi Tung and my unsuccessful search for employment. After
hearing my story he instructed me to remove to the Wei Tsoong
(惠中) hotel on Hankow Road and rent a room there. At the
same time he handed me $100 to meet any expenses I may incur.
I immediately vacated the Toong Chong and went to the Wei
Tsoong, but as I was unable to get a room at this place I then
tried the Great Eastern Hotel, where I rented room No.29 at a
rate of $8 per day. Later I also rented room No.34. Both
rooms were registered in my name. After removing from the lodging
house on Avenue Joffre I never saw Tseong Ming again and I believe
that he has returned to Chi Tung. As I could not rent a room at t
the Wei Tsoong hotel I chalked a message on the hotel notice
board for the information of Lee Ngoh, who had planned to visit
me, that I had gone to the Great Eastern Hotel. About two hours
after renting room 29 at the Great Eastern Hotel Lee Ngoh
called upon me. He told me about the inefficiency of General
Chiang's government and the necessity of establishing a self
defence force to protect Chinese territory and in this connection
he had received instructions from the Canton government,
authorizing him to organize the South Eastern Self Defence Army
(东南自卫军). Lee also told me that a North Eastern Self
Defence Army (东北自卫军) had already been organized in Manchur-
ia. He did not tell me the commander of this force nor its
pages.zh:
-3-
霞飞路的中正旅社，以宗明的名义租了一个房间，为期一天。我们抵达上海的日期是1932年二月初二（1932年3月8日）。当天下午，我在旅社外的人行道上闲逛时，看到我的亲戚李鳌（Lee Ngoh）正沿着同一个人行道向西走。我上前拦住他，寒暄一番后，我们进了旅社。我上次见到李鳌是在大约三年前的老家，我不知道他在上海。当时宗明不在，他出去买东西了。我告诉李鳌我去启东的经历以及找工作未果的情况。听完我的讲述后，他指示我搬到汉口路的惠中酒店，并在那里租一个房间。同时，他递给我100美元，以支付我可能产生的任何费用。我立即搬离中正旅社去了惠中酒店，但由于在那里没租到房间，我便尝试了东亚大酒店，以每天8美元的价格租下了29号房间。后来我还租了34号房间。两个房间都登记在我的名下。从霞飞路的旅社搬走后，我再也没见过宗明，我相信他已经回启东了。由于我没能租到惠中酒店的房间，我在酒店的公告板上给计划来看我的李鳌留了个粉笔字条，告知他我已去了东亚大酒店。在东亚大酒店租下29号房间约两小时后，李鳌来看我。他告诉我蒋介石政府的无能，以及建立自卫力量以保卫中国领土的必要性，在这方面，他收到了广东政府的指示，授权他组织东南自卫军。李鳌还告诉我，东北自卫军已经在满洲组织起来。他没有告诉我这支军队的指挥官是谁，也没有告诉我它的

pages.en:
-4-
where its headquarters were located. He said that he had been
appointed Commander in Chief of the South Eastern Army but did
not, however, produce any documents regarding his appointment.
He produced two chops one large and one small, bearing the
characters Commander in Chief South Eastern Self Defence Army
(東南自衛軍). Sometimes he left them in a drawer in a table
in the room and at times he took them away with him. Lee visited
me frequently at irregular intervals and on one occasion spent
a night in the room. He brought several paper bundles to the
hotel containing documents relating to letters of appointment
for the posts of officers in the South Eastern Self Defence
Army. He also brought several flags wrapped up in parcels.
He ██████ did not offer me any appointment but I was hoping
to receive a post as staff officer. He told me to receive callers
to collect mail matter and to allow no strangers to enter the
room and to keep a careful watch on the documents and the
contents of the room. He did not promise me anything in return
for my services and had engaged me simply because I was unemployed
Among the visitors to room 29 was Wong Ming (黃明) the Chief of the
the Main Police Squad of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
He only visited this room on oneoccasion. This was on March 11,
1938. Wong Ming had been appointed commander of the 3rd
Division of the South Eastern Self Defence Army. He told Lee
Hgeh and myself that the policemen under his command would be
incorporated in the proposed 3rd Division. When Wong Ming
called he was accompanied by Kiang Sung Den (江宋登), Chief of
the 1st Squad of the Nantao Police, Wong Zeong Zung (王中仁)
(in custody), a military training officer of the Great China
University during the past two years, and one Zen Yih Van (陳一人)
whose occupation I do not know. When Wong Ming discussed
with Lee Hgeh about the transformation of the Nantao Police
into the 3rd Division of the South Eastern Self Defence Army,
after which Lee Hgeh left the hotel, giving me instructions to
pages.zh:
-4-
其总部所在地。他说他已被任命为东南军总司令，但并未出示任何关于其任命的文件。他出示了两枚印章，一大一小，刻有“东南自卫军总司令”字样。有时他把印章留在房间桌子的抽屉里，有时则随身带走。李（Lee）不定期地频繁来访，有一次还在房间里过了一夜。他带了几包文件到旅馆，里面是关于东南自卫军军官委任状的文件。他还带来了几面包裹在包裹里的旗帜。他 ██████ 没有给我提供任何职务，但我希望能得到一个参谋的职位。他让我负责接待访客、收取邮件，不许陌生人进入房间，并仔细看守文件和房间内的物品。他没有承诺给我的服务任何回报，雇用我仅仅是因为我当时失业。

29号房间的访客中包括上海公共安全局主要警察大队队长黄明（Wong Ming）。他只来过这个房间一次。那是1938年3月11日。黄明已被任命为东南自卫军第三师师长。他告诉李赫格（Lee Hgeh）和我，他手下的警察将被编入拟议中的第三师。黄明来访时，由南市警察第一队队长江宋登（Kiang Sung Den）、王中仁（Wong Zeong Zung）（在押，过去两年在大夏大学担任军事训练教官）以及一名职业不明的陈一人（Zen Yih Van）陪同。当黄明与李赫格讨论将南市警察改编为东南自卫军第三师的事宜后，李赫格离开了旅馆，并指示我

pages.en:
entertain Wong Ming and Wong's men to a dinner party.
Nothing particular was discussed at the subsequent dinner. Lee
Ngoh did not attend.

At 8 a.m. to-day March 12 Kiang Sung Dau, Wong Zoong
in
Zung ( custody) and Zau Yih Van came to room 34 which was also
opened by me on instructions from Lee Ngoh. Wong Zoong Zung
then came to Room 29 and asked Lee Ngoh to go to Room 34, but
Lee told me to go on his behalf. I went to Room 34 and asked
Kiang Sung Dau (江声涛) if Wong Ming had made any demands. Kiang
said that he had and then wrote down the following three demands:-
1) Payment of $100,000.
2) Supply of 2,000 rifles.
3) No dismissal or change of the present staff of the Public
Safety Bureau.

I then took the demands and showed them to Lee Ngoh
(李鳌) who was waiting in Room 29. Lee Ngoh wrote the following
reply:-
1) Payment of $50,000 after one week.
2) Supply of 1,500 rifles.
3) Fully accepted.

I handed the answer to Kiang who then demanded that
$10,000 be paid on March 12. Lee Ngoh promised to pay $5,000.
on the afternoon of the same day. At 2 p.m., Kiang Sung Dau,
Wong Zoong Zung (in custody) and Zau Yih Van came to Room 34
Shortly after their arrival, Tsun Tz Suh (孙子苏) (in custody),
who had been sent by Lee Ngoh, also came to room 34, and handed
over to Kiang $5,000. Kiang then gave Tsun a receipt for this
amount bearing the signature of Wong Ming. Upon receiving the
money, Kiang told Tsun that Wong Ming would come to see Lee Ngoh
and all Lee's men at 4 p.m. March 12. I was present when the
money was paid but took no part in the transaction.

However, about 3 p.m. the rooms were raided by the
Police and the occupants, including myself, arrested.
pages.zh:
宴请黄明及其手下。随后的晚餐中没有讨论什么特别的事情。李鳌（Lee Ngoh）没有出席。

今天上午3月12日上午8点，江声涛（Kiang Sung Dau）、王中仁（Wong Zoong Zung）（在押）和赵一人（Zau Yih Van）来到34号房间，该房间也是根据李鳌的指示由我打开的。随后王中仁来到29号房间，请李鳌去34号房间，但李让我代他前去。我去了34号房间，问江声涛黄明是否提出了任何要求。江说提了，然后写下了以下三项要求：
1) 支付10万美元。
2) 供应2,000支步枪。
3) 不得解雇或变更公共安全局现有人员。

随后我拿着这些要求给在29号房间等候的李鳌（Li Ngoh）看。李鳌写了如下回复：
1) 一周后支付5万美元。
2) 供应1,500支步枪。
3) 完全接受。

我把回复交给江，江随即要求于3月12日支付1万美元。李鳌答应在同日下午支付5,000美元。下午2点，江声涛、王中仁（在押）和赵一人来到34号房间。他们到达后不久，李鳌派来的孙子苏（Tsun Tz Suh）（在押）也来到34号房间，并将5,000美元交给江。随后江给了孙一张收据，上面有黄明的签名。收到钱后，江告诉孙，黄明将于3月12日下午4点来见李鳌及李的所有手下。付款时我在场，但未参与交易。

然而，大约在下午3点，警察突袭了这些房间，包括我在内的所有住客被捕。

pages.en:
6.
(After the completion of the above, Lee Min Tsoong
made the following statement which differs with somewhat
with his original).
Li Min Tsoong is my real name and I have never at any
time used any other name.
At the age of 19, I joined the Chekiang Military
School then located at Huchow(湖州), Chekiang. I completed
my course in 6 months and was then appointed Commander of the
5th Battalion of the Chekiang Guerrilla Troops stationed at
Huchow. This post I held for about four months after which
I proceeded to my native place. After staying at home for
about one year, I left for Canton to enter the Whampoa
Military Academy. I remained there about 3 months and then
returned to my native place owing to illness. I stayed
at home until the 16th year of the Republic (1927) when I
came to Shanghai and joined the 26th Army, under General
Chow Yung Chi(周凤岐) as Commander of the Supplementary Regiment
then stationed in Chapei. I and my troops assisted in
disarming the Labourers' Army in Chapei in 1927.
About June, 1927, General Chow Yung Chi resigned owing
to a diversion of opinion with General Chiang Kai Shek;
I also resigned, and returned to my native place in
Anhui, and engaged in the business I have mentioned in my
previous statement.
I am strongly anti-Communist and I am not a bandit.
Owing to my dissatisfaction with the administrations of the
Nanking Government, I am always anxious to do something to save
my country. So far I hear the North Eastern Self Defence Army,
which has just started to be organized, is purely for the
purpose of resisting foreign invasion, and in this connection
I understand that the plans to expedite the coup de will lead
to the occupation of the 19th Route Army, with what certain
parties are said to have made arrangements.
pages.zh:
6.
（在上述内容完成后，李敏宗（Lee Min Tsoong）作了如下陈述，与其原始陈述略有不同）。
李敏宗是我的真名，我从未在任何时候使用过其他名字。
19岁时，我加入了位于浙江湖州（Huchow）的浙江军事学校。我在6个月内完成了课程，随后被任命为驻扎在湖州的浙江游击队第五营营长。我担任此职约四个月，之后返回家乡。在家待了约一年后，我前往广州进入黄埔军校。我在那里待了约3个月，后因生病返回家乡。我在家一直待到民国十六年（1927年），当时我来到上海，加入周凤岐（Chow Yung Chi）将军麾下的第二十六军，担任驻扎在闸北的补充团团长。我和我的部队协助解除了1927年闸北劳工武装的武装。
1927年6月左右，周凤岐将军因与蒋介石将军意见分歧而辞职；我也随之辞职，回到安徽老家，从事我在之前陈述中提到的业务。
我强烈反共，我不是匪徒。由于对南京政府的管理不满，我总是渴望做点什么来拯救我的国家。据我所知，刚刚开始组建的东北自卫军纯粹是为了抵抗外国侵略，在此方面，我了解到加速政变的计划将导致占领第十九路军，据说某些党派已就此做出安排。

pages.en:
7.
and Chow Veng Chi are the one and same person.
pages.zh:
7.
周凤岐（Chow Veng Chi）是同一个人。

pages.en:
2
Li Sing Ngoh (李醒我)。
C.D.I. Note ptson.
Chie Ching, Honan
Louze Stn. 12/3/32 Clerk Liao Chung-chien

My name is Li Sing Ngoh (李醒我), alias Li Sau Tseng
(李紹曾), native of Chie Ching (懷慶) in the province of
Honan. I am 38 years old. I am married and have one son
who is now with my wife in Honan. I am the son of Li Tsau Chin
(李寿青), who was a medicine dealer in Hankow and who died 10
years ago. My mother lives at Chie Ching. At 8 years of age,
I commenced my education under a private tutor until I was
19 years old when I obtained an appointment as Liaison Officer
of the 16th Independent Brigade under Su Pei Fu at Ichang
which I retained until I was 27 years of age. I then secured
an appointment with General Yang Sen (楊森) as officer of the
Administration Department of his forces. I held the latter
position for four years and then went to reside in Hankow for
three years during which time I was unemployed. In the
following year (1928), I was appointed an Inspector of the
Administration Office of the 2nd Special District (Hankow
formerly Russian Concession) of Hankow administration. At that
time Soong Sih-piao (宋式磊), who is now chief of the
Kiangnan Arsenal, was in charge of the Office. About eight
months later that office was abolished and in consequence,
I found myself out of employment but continued to live in
Hankow. In 1930 I was appointed Chief of the Inspection
Office of the Teh Tse King Railway Station (First Station on
the line beyond Hankow to Peking), which position I only
held for four months because the office was established by the
2nd Route Army and so the Command of the 6th (刘峙), who ordered
the transfer to Kuchow. At that time Koh Tao-tung (高道通)
pages.zh:
2
李醒我（Li Sing Ngoh）。
刑事侦缉处注：囚犯。
河南怀庆（Chie Ching）
卢家湾站 32年3月12日 书记员 廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien）

我叫李醒我（Li Sing Ngoh），别名李绍曾（Li Sau Tseng），籍贯河南省怀庆（Chie Ching）。我今年38岁。已婚，有一子，现与妻子同在河南。我是李寿青（Li Tsau Chin）之子，他曾在汉口经营药材生意，于10年前去世。我母亲住在怀庆。我8岁开始随私塾老师读书，直到19岁，当时我在宜昌获得苏佩孚（Su Pei Fu）麾下第十六独立旅联络官的任命，我一直担任此职直到27岁。随后，我在杨森（Yang Sen）将军麾下获得其部队行政部官员的职位。我担任该职位四年，然后在汉口居住了三年，期间失业。次年（1928年），我被任命为汉口行政第二特区（原俄国租界）行政办公室督察。当时，现任江南兵工厂厂长的宋式磊（Soong Sih-piao）负责该办公室。约八个月后，该办公室被撤销，因此我失业，但仍居住在汉口。1930年，我被任命为德泽京铁路车站（汉口至北京线出汉口后的第一站）检查办公室主任，但该职位我只担任了四个月，因为该办公室是由第二路军设立的，第六军指挥官刘峙（Liu Zhi）命令将其转移至古州（Kuchow）。当时，高道通（Koh Tao-tung）

pages.en:
Li Sing Ngoh

- 2 -

Commander of the 25th Division, a former acquaintance, offered
me a position as a military advisor. With the intentions of
seeking the assistance of Soong Sih-piao (宋式善), to find me
a more lucrative position I came to Shanghai at the beginning
of December, 1931, and succeeded in being appointed an
Inspector of the Kiangnan Arsenal at a salary of $60.00 per mth
monson. On my arrival in Shanghai I took up residence alone at
No.7 Sau Tuh P'ong (三德坊), Rue Chapeal, French Concession.
I still retain my position in the Kiangnan Arsenal and under
the instructions of Soong Sih-piao supervised the removal of the
machinery of the Kiangnan Arsenal to Hangchow. Soong Sih-
piao left for Nanking on the evening of March 11 by the steamer
"ush".

On the afternoon of March 11, Tseng Ming-yuan (崔鸣远),
whom I met in Hankow about five years ago and who at that time
was Staff Officer of the 25th Division, under the command of
Chen Ming Shu, came to my house and invited me to dinner at
1.30 p.m., March 12 in the hall of the Great Eastern Hotel and
at the same time he informed me that he would give me a job the
nature of which he did not mention but I understood that it
would be a position in military circles. At 9 a.m., March 12,
Tseng Ming Yuan again came to my home and reminded me of my
appointment and I agreed to go. At 1.30 p.m. I and my friend
Soong Sih-tsang, a brother of Soong Sih-piao went by ricksha to
Room No.19 of the Great Eastern Hotel. On entering the room
I was greeted by Soong Sih-tsang and Tseng Ming-yuan, and seated
there and one other named Li Ming Tsung (李名宗). The last
pages.zh:
李醒我

- 2 -

第二十五师师长，一位旧识，给我提供了一个军事顾问的职位。为了寻求宋式善（Soong Sih-piao，注：此处原文与前文宋式磊拼音相同但汉字不同，依原文译出）的帮助以找到一份更丰厚的职位，我于1931年12月初来到上海，并成功被任命为江南兵工厂督察，月薪60.00美元。抵达上海后，我独自居住在法租界霞飞路（Rue Chapeal）三德坊（Sau Tuh P'ong）7号。我仍保留在江南兵工厂的职位，并根据宋式磊的指示监督江南兵工厂机器设备迁往杭州的工作。宋式磊于3月11日晚乘“ush”号轮船前往南京。

3月11日下午，崔鸣远（Tseng Ming-yuan）来到我家，我约五年前在汉口认识他，当时他是陈铭枢（Chen Ming Shu）指挥的第二十五师参谋。他邀请我于3月12日下午1:30在大东酒店大厅共进晚餐，同时告知我会给我一份工作，但未提及工作性质，我理解那将是军界的一个职位。3月12日上午9点，崔鸣远再次来到我家，提醒我赴约，我同意前往。下午1:30，我和我的朋友宋式璋（Soong Sih-tsang，宋式磊的兄弟）乘人力车前往大东酒店19号房间。进入房间后，宋式璋和崔鸣远向我打招呼，那里还坐着一位名叫李明宗（Li Ming Tsung）的人。最后

pages.en:
Li Sing Sooh

- 5 -

named two men were introduced to me by Tsang Ming Yuan.
Shortly afterwards we five men went to the ground floor of
the hotel have tiffin. During the tiffin Tsang Ming Yuan
and Li Ming Soong said we are going to organize an army
and requested the help of the remainder of the company. They
further stated that the proposed army would assist the 19th
Route Army to resist Japan. After further unimportant
conversation we all left the dining room and went upstairs
to the same floor where we entered another room the number
of which I do not know. On entering the room Tsang Ming
Yuan and Li Ming Soong asked the boy to serve tea and
cigarettes. While this was being done a man dressed in
a khaki uniform jacket (Wang Zoang Zung (王仲仁)) came in
and said to Li Ming Soong "our men are coming" and then left.
The police arrived immediately afterwards and arrested every
one in the room.
pages.zh:
李醒我（Li Sing Sooh，注：此处原文拼写有误，应为Li Sing Ngoh）

- 5 -

提到的这两个人是由崔鸣远介绍给我的。不久后，我们五人下楼到酒店底层吃便饭。用餐期间，崔鸣远和李明松（Li Ming Soong，注：此处原文名字拼写变化）说我们要组建一支军队，并请求在座其他人的帮助。他们进一步表示，拟议中的军队将协助第十九路军抗日。经过一些无关紧要的谈话后，我们都离开餐厅，上楼回到同一楼层，进入另一个房间，房号我不记得了。进入房间后，崔鸣远和李明松让侍者送上茶和香烟。在此期间，一个身穿卡其色制服上衣的人（王仲仁（Wang Zoang Zung））走进来，对李明松说“我们的人来了”，然后离开。警察随即赶到，逮捕了房间里的所有人。

pages.en:
(Name of person examined: Li Tse Kwei) 3

Soong Sih Tsang (宋式璋),
Changsha, Hunan. C.D.I. Robertson.
Louza Stn. 10/3/32 Clerk Liao Chun-chien

My name is Soong Sih Tsang (宋式璋), alias Soong Hsi-ling (宋季良). I am 28 years of age and a native of Changsha, Hunan. I am married and have one son who lives with my wife at Changsha. I am chief of the Registration Department of the Kiangnan Arsenal.

At 7 years of age, I commenced my education in a primary school at Changsha and after studying there for 5 years I continued my studies in the Ming Tuh University at Hankow which I attended for 9 years studying literature. On graduating I returned to my native home and stayed there for 3 years maintaining myself on property left by my father who died when I was 6 years of age. At the end of that period I went to Hankow where I obtained employment as a clerk for 2 years with the Municipal Council of the Russian Concession. On leaving the employment the Municipality of the Russian Concession I became chief of the Correspondence Department of the Hupeh Provincial Bank, Hankow for 6 months I then took over the position as chief of the First Department of the Saltpetre and Sulphur Bureau of Hupeh Province at a salary of $130.00 per mensem which I retained until April 1931. I then returned to my home at Changsha and in July of the same year I went to Kuling in Kiukiang to undergo lung treatment which lasted two months. In September 1931 I went to Nanking to visit my brother Soong Sih Piao who was then vice-minister of Munitions. At the end of September 1931 I came to Shanghai and took up residence at the Changsha Lodging House, Rue La Gironde, French Concession. On
pages.zh:
（受审人姓名：李子贵（Li Tse Kwei）） 3

宋式璋（Soong Sih Tsang），
湖南长沙。刑事侦缉处 罗伯逊（Robertson）。
卢家湾站 32年3月10日 书记员 廖春坚（Liao Chun-chien）

我叫宋式璋（Soong Sih Tsang），别名宋季良（Soong Hsi-ling）。我今年28岁，籍贯湖南长沙。已婚，有一子，与妻子同住长沙。我是江南兵工厂登记部主任。

7岁时，我在长沙的一所小学开始受教育，在那里学习5年后，我继续在汉口的明德大学（Ming Tuh University）求学，攻读文学9年。毕业后，我返回家乡，在那里住了3年，依靠父亲留下的财产维持生活，父亲在我6岁时去世。期满后，我前往汉口，在俄国租界工部局担任职员2年。离开俄国租界工部局后，我成为汉口湖北省银行通信科主任，为期6个月。随后，我接任湖北省硝磺局第一科科长，月薪130.00美元，一直担任至1931年4月。之后我返回长沙家中，同年7月前往九江牯岭进行肺部治疗，持续两个月。1931年9月，我前往南京探望时任军政部副部长的哥哥宋式彪（Soong Sih Piao）。1931年9月底，我来到上海，居住在法租界吉伦德路（Rue La Gironde）长沙旅馆。在

pages.en:
- 2 -
October 1, through the influence of my brother Soong Ching Piao
(宋式嘉). I obtained my present position in the
Kiangnan Arsenal. On August 11, I removed to 30 Sing King Tsung
Alleyway (新民村), Rue Brenier de Montmorand.

On the afternoon of March 11, I visited my friend Liu
Tse Ming who is a great friend and confidant of Doo Yuet-
sung and Wang Ching Yoong and who lives at 95 Yoong Yui Li
(永裕里), Rue Porte de L'Ouest, and there met Tsang Ming
Yuen (張鳴遠) who was introduced to me by Liu Tse Ming 副柳澤民
On leaving the residence of Liu Tse Ming, Tsang MingYuan
asked me to meet him at the Great Eastern Hotel, Room No. 29
the same evening and I agreed to do so provided I had the time.
Owing to the heavy rains that evening, I did not keep the
appointment. About 10 a.m. to-day (March 12), I received
a note from Tsang Ming Yuen Room No. 29 Great Eastern Hotel,
inviting me to tiffin at 12 noon. I took a ricksha to the Great
Eastern Hotel and proceeded direct to Room 29 where I saw
Tsang MingYuen and Li Ming Hoh. Later Li Ming Yoong and one
named Tsou arrived and were introduced to me by Tsang, Ming
Yuen. Li Ming Yoong then addressing the people in the
room stated that he was going to organize a Self Defense
Army and asked the help of those present. The name of the army,
its promoters or its supporters were not mentioned. We then
proceeded to the ground floor of the hotel where we had tiffin
and during the meal nothing was said. After tiffin,
Tsang Ming Yuen, Li Ming Hoh and I returned to Room No. 29
while the other two went elsewhere, on returning to the room
pages.zh:
- 2 -
10月1日，通过我兄弟宋式嘉（Soong Ching Piao）的关系，我在江南兵工厂获得了目前的职位。8月11日，我搬至布伦尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）新民村30号。

3月11日下午，我拜访了我的朋友刘泽民（Liu Tse Ming），他是杜月笙和王敬永的挚友和心腹，住在西門路永裕里95号，在那里我见到了由刘泽民介绍给我的张鸣远（Tsang Ming Yuen）。离开刘泽民住所后，张鸣远请我当晚在大东酒店29号房间与他见面，我同意如果有时间就去。由于当晚大雨，我没有赴约。今天（3月12日）上午10点左右，我收到张鸣远从大东酒店29号房间寄来的一张便条，邀请我中午12点共进午餐。我乘黄包车前往大东酒店，直接来到29号房间，在那里见到了张鸣远和李明浩（Li Ming Hoh）。随后李明永（Li Ming Yoong）和一个姓邹的人到达，并由张鸣远介绍给我。李明永随即对房间里的人说，他打算组织一支自卫军，并请求在场人士的帮助。未提及该军队的名称、发起人或支持者。随后我们前往酒店一楼用餐，席间未发一言。午餐后，张鸣远、李明浩和我返回29号房间，而另外两人则去了别处，回到房间后

pages.en:
- 5 -
I only stayed a few moments and then went to the barber's.
On going back after an absence of one hour to Room 29,
I found about six persons among whom were Tsang Ming Yuan
and Li Singloh. I seated myself in a corner of the room
and observed that the table was covered with papers. I
heard one man dressed in a khaki coloured uniform, Wang
Soong Zung(王仲仁), say to Li Ming Tsang that every thing
was ready and they were going to the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai to-morrow morning, March 13.
A few minutes later the police arrived and arrested
every one in the room.
Li Ming Tsang appears to be the head of the
movement at the Great Eastern and one named Tsang Ming is
responsible for the entire activities.
pages.zh:
- 5 -
我只停留了片刻，然后去理发店。一小时后回到29号房间时，我发现大约有六个人，其中包括张鸣远和李星洛（Li Singloh）。我在房间角落坐下，注意到桌子上铺满了文件。我听到一个身穿卡其色制服的人，王仲仁（Wang Soong Zung），对李明章（Li Ming Tsang）说，一切准备就绪，他们将于明天早上，即3月13日，前往上海特别市政府。几分钟后，警察赶到，逮捕了房间里的所有人。
李明章似乎是大东酒店行动的头目，而一个叫张鸣（Tsang Ming）的人负责全部活动。

pages.en:
4
Chou Tse-zah
Chekiang (Supt. Robertson)
9 p.m. March 13 D.I. Sih Ts Liang

My name is Chou Tse-zah. I am 29 years of age, native
of Chekiang, and reside in room 33 Dah Zung lodging house,
Route Chapsal, French Concession. I graduated from the Wen
Chi University, Kiangnan, in 1926 and went to Kiukiang where
I was employed as postal and telegraph censor by the Kiukiang
Defence Commissioner's Headquarters. I held this post for
three months at the end of which period the Defence Com-
missioner and his troops moved to Chuchow, Chekiang, where
they were reorganized and styled the 25th Revolutionary Army,
commanded by General Chou Feng-chi. I was appointed officer-
in-charge of the Telegraph Section of this army. In February
1927 the army arrived in Shanghai where I maintained my
position until October of the same year following the
resignation of Chou Feng-chi. I then went to Foochow and
and there was appointed Chief Detective to the Salt
Transportation Bureau. I held this post until March 1928
when I resigned following the Chief of the Bureau, Ying S
Li (殷士禮) giving up his appointment. I came to Shanghai
where I remained without employment until June 1929 when I
was asked by Chang Ting-fan through my friend named Zak Zaung
Feng (石尚峯) who formerly served as a Battalion Commander
under Chang Ting-fan, to assist him. Chang Ting-fan in the
capacity of a secret representative of Li Sung-jen in
Shanghai, opposed Chiang Kai-shek's dictatorship. This work
ceased one month later when Chang Ting-fan left for Canton.
From April to October 1930 I assisted Chang Tung-yun (張東雲)
and Lee Hing-pu (李興普) secret representatives of Feng
pages.zh:
4
周子扎（Chou Tse-zah）
浙江籍（罗伯逊警司）
3月13日晚9点 督察 梁思之（Sih Ts Liang）

我叫周子扎。现年29岁，浙江人，居住在法租界查普萨尔路（Route Chapsal）大中华旅舍33号。我于1926年毕业于江南文治大学，随后前往九江，在九江防卫专员公署担任邮政和电报检查员。我担任此职三个月，期满后，防卫专员及其部队移驻浙江衢州，在那里进行了整编，改称为第25革命军，由周凤岐将军指挥。我被任命为该军电报科负责人。1927年2月，该军抵达上海，我一直保持该职位直到同年10月周凤岐辞职。随后我前往福州，被任命为盐务运输局首席侦探。我担任此职直到1928年3月，因局长殷士禮（Ying S Li）离职而辞职。我来到上海，一直失业到1929年6月，当时我的朋友石尚峯（Zak Zaung Feng，曾任张廷藩部下营长）受张廷藩之托请我协助他。张廷藩作为李松仁在上海的秘密代表，反对蒋介石的独裁统治。一个月后张廷藩前往广州，这项工作随之停止。从1930年4月至10月，我协助冯

pages.en:
2

Yu-hsiang, in Shanghai, in conducting an anti-Chiang Kai-shek
movement. My assistance consisted of writing letters,
deciphering codes and negotiating with the Shanghai
representative of the Canton army. These efforts were
without success. From October 1930 until the present I have
had no employment, depending upon my relatives for my upkeep.
My father is Chou Foh-tsing (周福清), manager of the Hung Ta
Tung Cotton Mill, Harbin Road. He, my father, and all my
relatives are in Hangchow, where they went at the commence-
ment of the Sino-Japanese hostilities. I have been offered
a post as City Magistrate by the Chekiang Provincial
Government but I have declined owing to my heart being weak.
In 1927 I met Li Ming-tsung (李敏宗) at a dinner
party given by a friend when Li claimed to be a commander
of the 3rd Division of the 27th Army. Following that
occasion we met several times and the acquaintanceship
seemed to drop as we saw nothing of each other. On the
morning of 7th of this month he sent a coolie to my home
asking me to go to the Tung Chang lodging house, Avenue
Joffre, near Rue Chapot. No reason was given for the
request. I thought the request a little strange but
nevertheless I went to the Tung Chang lodging house the same
day at about 10 a.m., and met Li Ming-tsung alone when he
told me that arrangements had been made whereby the Reserve
Unit of the Bureau of Public Safety would come under the
orders of one Li Hsun (李) as a preliminary step to
organizing a Self-Defense Army. I do not know who Li Hsun
pages.zh:
2

玉祥在上海的秘密代表张东云（Chang Tung-yun）和李兴普（Lee Hing-pu），开展反蒋介石运动。我的协助工作包括写信、破译密码以及与粤军上海代表进行谈判。这些努力均未成功。从1930年10月至今，我一直没有工作，依靠亲戚供养。我的父亲是周福清（Chou Foh-tsing），哈尔滨路鸿达通棉纺厂经理。他和我的所有亲戚都在杭州，他们在中日敌对行动开始时去了那里。浙江省政府曾向我提供市长一职，但我因心脏虚弱而拒绝。
1927年，我在一次朋友举办的晚宴上认识了李敏宗（Li Ming-tsung），当时李声称自己是第27军第3师师长。那次之后我们又见过几次面，但由于彼此不再往来，交情似乎也就淡了。本月7日上午，他派一名苦力到我家，请我去霞飞路靠近沙波路（Rue Chapot）的同昌旅舍。请求中未说明原因。我觉得这个请求有点奇怪，但还是在那天上午10点左右去了同昌旅舍，单独见到了李敏宗，他告诉我，已做出安排，公安局后备队将归李勋（Li Hsun）指挥，作为组织自卫军的初步步骤。我不知道李勋

pages.en:
3

is. I did not ask Li Ming-tsung who he, Li Manuh, was as
the matter was strictly secret. Li King-tsang told me that
he wanted the service of people with diplomatic qualifications
to assist in establishing understanding with the local
representatives of the Foreign Powers. I promised to find
such a person for him. I then went (on March 8) to see
General Chou Feng-chi at 146 Rue Pere Robert and explained
the matter to him, telling him what I wanted. General Chou
appeared to be acquainted with the plot as he never put any
questions to me. I went to General Chou Feng-chi's house
again on the morning of March 9 when General Chou said he had
seen Wellington Koo who sympathises with the aim of an army
composed of merchant volunteers and police to defend Mantao
as the Japanese would not attack such a force in that it would
not be termed military. On the morning of March 10 Li Ming-
tseng again sent his coolie to my lodgings informing me that he
had removed to the Great Eastern Hotel. I went there the same
day at 9 a.m., when I saw Li Ming-tseng who introduced me to
two others in his room. These men were named Shen Tsh-chen
( 薛博誠 ), a training officer of the Bureau of Public
Safety, and Tang Ling ( 王麟 ), a military training officer
of the Great China University. I informed them of General
Chou's interview with Dr. Wellington Koo whereupon Shen
expressed his willingness to carry on the organisation of the
proposed army. I then withdrew as I thought they wanted to
discuss secret military matters. I then went to the home of
General Chou Feng-chi to inform him that Li Ming-tseng had
pages.zh:
3

是谁。我没有问李敏宗李曼努（Li Manuh，原文如此）是谁，因为此事严格保密。李金藏（Li King-tsang，音译，疑为前文李明章或李敏宗之误）告诉我，他需要具有外交资格的人士服务，以帮助与外国势力的当地代表建立联系。我答应为他寻找这样的人选。随后我（于3月8日）去罗伯特神父路146号见周凤岐将军，向他解释了此事，告诉了他我的意图。周将军似乎知晓这一阴谋，因为他没有问我任何问题。3月9日上午，我再次前往周凤岐将军府邸，周将军说他已见过顾维钧博士，顾博士同情由商人和警察组成军队保卫南市的宗旨，因为日军不会攻击这样一支不被视为军事力量的部队。3月10日上午，李敏增（Li Ming-tseng，音译，疑为前文李敏宗之误）再次派苦力到我的住处，通知我他已搬至大东酒店。我当天上午9点前往那里，见到了李敏增，他将我介绍给房间里的另外两个人。这两人是薛博誠（Shen Tsh-chen），公安局训练官，以及王麟（Tang Ling，原文拼音为Tang但中文为王麟，存疑），大夏大学军事训练官。我向他们通报了周将军与顾维钧博士的会谈情况，随后薛表示愿意继续组织拟议中的军队。我认为他们要讨论秘密军事事务，便退出了。随后我前往周凤岐将军府邸，告诉他李敏增已经

pages.en:
4
decided to put his plans for the organisation of a defence
army into execution.
On March 11 (at 5.30 p.m.) I went to the Great
Eastern Hotel where I saw Li Ming-tseng who introduced me
to Huang King, Chief of the Reserve Unit of the Public
Safety Bureau. Huang King expressed his desire to be
appointed Divisional Commander having sole control over the
Public Safety Bureau to which Li Ming-tseng agreed on the
condition that by the night of March 12 the Defence Army
should be formally established and that the flags of the
Army be hoisted at Nantao. Huang King promised to give
an answer personally at 9 a.m. March 12. In the room there
were two others; one was Teng Ling and the other named Lao,
brought by Huang King. I left at 8.40 p.m. while the four
persons were taking dinner. Li Ming-tseng told me he was in the
employ of one Li Ngash. Li Ming-tseng did not say who Li
Ngash was or what recommendation he, Li Ming-tseng, would
receive.
At 9.45 a.m. March 12 I went to the Great Eastern
Hotel and found Li Ming-tseng, Teng Ling, Lao and another
Chinese whom he introduced to me under the name Chiang Sung-
tao (江壽濤) as Group Commander of the Reserve Unit, the
latter two representing Huang King. Li then told me that
Huang King had sent these two representatives here and
demanded $100,000.00, 2,000 rifles and free appointment for
himself in the unit of division under him, that he had agreed
to give 1,000 rifles and pay $50,000 respectively in two or
pages.zh:
4
决定执行其组织防御军的计划。
3月11日（下午5点30分），我前往大东酒店，见到了李敏增，他将我介绍给公安局后备队队长黄King（Huang King，音译，疑为黄兴或黄某）。黄King表示希望被任命为师长，独家控制公安局，李敏增同意了这一要求，条件是国防军必须在3月12日晚之前正式成立，并在南市升起军旗。黄King承诺在3月12日上午9点亲自给予答复。房间里还有另外两个人；一个是邓灵（Teng Ling，音译），另一个姓劳，由黄King带来。晚上8点40分，当这四个人正在吃晚饭时，我离开了。李敏增告诉我，他受雇于一个叫李Ngash（Li Ngash，音译）的人。李敏增没有说李Ngash是谁，也没有说他自己会得到什么推荐。
3月12日上午9点45分，我前往大东酒店，发现李敏增、邓灵、劳以及另一个中国人，他向我介绍此人为江壽濤（Chiang Sung-tao），后备队大队长，后两人代表黄King。李随后告诉我，黄King派了这两名代表来这里，索要10万美元、2,000支步枪，并为其麾下师团单位争取自由任命权，他同意给予1,000支步枪，并在该军成立后的两或

pages.en:
5

seven days time after the inauguration of this army, and free
appointment. Meanwhile I saw Li holding a paper slip containing
an item intimating that $100,000 as reward and expenses would
be given to Huang immediately on the day following the
inauguration of the army. These two slips were subsequently
handed to Kiang Sung-tao. Li further instructed them to ask
Huang Hsing whether he accepted these conditions or not,
whereupon Kiang intimated that Huang would most probably
accept them, but to defray the expenses in starting the
movement at 9 p.m. March 12. Kiang demanded that $5,000
be issued to them at once. Li Ming-teeng agreed to pay
$5,000 but asked them to consult with Huang Hing first,
whereupon Kiang Sung-tao and Fung Ling left with the two chits,
while I remained in the hotel. Li Ming-teeng having no money,
consulted with me and in consequence I proceeded to Chen Feng-ai
shi's home where I arrived at 10.30 a.m. I explained to
Chen the situation and Chen promised to apply to Dr. Kee for
assistance and instructed me to return for reply an hour later.
After having spent an hour in visiting friends, I returned to
Chen's home. Chen gave me $1,000 in notes which he said was
obtained from Dr. Kee. I brought the $1,000 to Great Eastern
Hotel where I reached at about 11.40 a.m. I saw Li Ming-teeng
in Room 20. Then he told me that Huang Hing had agreed and
I told him that $1,000 had been brought here; I then handed
the money to him, whereupon we went to Room 34 where I found
that Kiang and Fung had both returned, Kiang bringing him with
small leather case. Li Ming-teeng then handed the money to
pages.zh:
5

七天内分别支付5万美元，以及自由任命权。同时，我看到李拿着一张纸条，上面有一项内容暗示，在军队成立后的第二天，将立即给予黄10万美元作为报酬和费用。这两张纸条随后交给了江壽濤。李进一步指示他们去问黄兴（Huang Hsing，此处名字拼写变化，可能指同一人或不同人）是否接受这些条件，随后江暗示黄很可能会接受，但要求在3月12日晚上9点支付启动运动的费用。江要求立即向他们发放5,000美元。李明腾（Li Ming-teeng，音译，疑为前文李敏增之误）同意支付5,000美元，但要求他们先与黄兴（Huang Hing，拼写再次变化）商量，随后江壽濤和冯灵（Fung Ling，音译，疑为前文邓灵之误）带着两张便条离开，而我留在酒店。李明腾因为没有钱，与我商量，因此我前往陈凤爱氏（Chen Feng-ai shi，音译）家中，于上午10点30分到达。我向陈说明了情况，陈答应向基博士（Dr. Kee，音译）求助，并让我一小时后回来听回复。在拜访朋友度过一小时后，我回到陈家。陈给了我1,000元钞票，他说这是从基博士那里得来的。我带着这1,000元来到大东酒店，大约在上午11点40分到达。我在20号房间见到了李明腾。然后他告诉我黄兴已经同意，我告诉他带来了1,000元；随后我把钱交给他，于是我们去了34号房间，我发现江和冯都已经回来了，江还带了一个小皮箱。李明腾随后把钱交给

pages.en:
6

Kiang Sung-tao who placed the notes on a table. While he
was placing the notes into a leather case, Zao had a rough check
of the notes. Li then in the presence of Kiang and others,
handed me the receipt of $3,000 as food money for the
Division signed by Huang Ming. Subsequently Kiang announced
that Pang Ming would come at 4 p.m. the same day to have a last
discussion on the matter and to fix the time for the starting
of this movement. (Kiang, Zao and Pang Ming then left.
I remained and took tiffin in the Dining Room with Li, one
unknown person, and one Chang Ming Yuan, whom I knew on my
visit to the Grand Eastern Hotel, through the introduction of
Li who described him as Chief of Staff. I do not know when
he entered this room. I returned to Room 34 at 4 p.m. with a
view to learning the result of coming discussion by Huang Ming
and found Li Hsing-tsang and Zao and two unknown persons, one
of whom was writing. I then asked Li whether Huang had come
or not. Li did not give a clear reply. A few moments later
Zao left. I then informed Li of a report to the effect that
the Chinese authorities would take special precautions to-night
for they had received information about possible uprising by
agitators. Just at that time Chinese and Russian
foreigners, armed with pistols, arrested us. They searched
our persons and the room.
pages.zh:
6

江壽濤，江把钞票放在桌子上。当他把钞票放进皮箱时，赵（Zao，音译，疑为前文劳或另一人）粗略地清点了一下钞票。随后李在江和其他人在场的情况下，递给我一张由黄明（Huang Ming，音译）签署的3,000元收据，作为该师的伙食费。随后江宣布，庞明（Pang Ming，音译）将于当天下午4点来就此事进行最后讨论，并确定启动这次运动的时间。（江、赵和庞明随后离开。我留下来，与李、一个不认识的人以及张鸣元（Chang Ming Yuan，音译，疑为前文张鸣远）在餐厅共进午餐，我是通过李的介绍在大东酒店认识他的，李称他为参谋长。我不知道他是什么时候进入这个房间的。下午4点，我回到34号房间，想了解黄明前来讨论的结果，发现李兴藏（Li Hsing-tsang，音译）、赵和两个不认识的人，其中一人在写字。于是我问李黄是否来了。李没有给出明确的答复。几分钟后，赵离开了。随后我告诉李，有报告称中国当局今晚将采取特别预防措施，因为他们收到了关于煽动者可能起义的情报。就在那时，持枪的中国和俄国外国人逮捕了我们。他们搜查了我们的身体和房间。

pages.en:
53
Chou Keng-zung (周幹臣)
Anhwei C.D.I.Robertson
Losea Btn. 12/3/32 Clerk Mao

My name is Chow Keng-zung, aged 53, native of Anhwei. I am married and reside with my wife and daughter at 86 Yung Hea Li, Rue Brenier de Montmorand. I had four children, three sons and a daughter. Two of my sons are dead. My second son was killed last year in Kiangsi when serving in General Sung Lien-chen's army operating against the Communists. My third son who was a sub-2nd Lieutenant served in the 87th Division of 5th Route Army and was recently killed near Hangwen whilst operating against the Japanese I was informed of his death by my eldest son named Chow Tsah-sang (周彥驤) who is a secretary employed by the Public Safety Bureau, Tsingtao. I was born at Hsuchow Anhwei where my father was an officer in the Imperial Army. When six years of age I commenced my education under a private tutor engaged by my family and studied under him until I was 17 years of age. I then joined the Imperial Military School at Pao Jan (保定), Chihli and six years later was chosen with 53 others on the instructions of Yuan Shih-kai to continue my military studies at the Military Academy, Tokio. I attended the Military Academy at Tokio for three years and returned with the 53 others to Tientsin where I was appointed Staff Officer under Yuan Shih-kai. I was then 26 years of age. After serving in my latter capacity as Staff Officer for six months I was transferred to the 15th Brigade of the Imperial Forces stationed at Chin Ting-fu, Chihli. One year later the 15th Brigade was despatched to Chinkiang (鎮江) near Shanghai, Kiangsu.
pages.zh:
53
周幹臣 (Chou Keng-zung)
安徽籍。C.D.I. Robertson
罗素营。1932年3月12日 书记员 Mao

本人名为周幹臣，现年53岁，安徽人。已婚，与妻子及女儿同住于蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）永和里86号。我共有四名子女，三子一女。其中两子已故。次子去年在江西服役于宋连珍将军麾下剿共部队时阵亡。三子曾任少尉，服役于第五路军第八十七师，近期在杭州附近对日作战时阵亡。我是从任职于青岛公安局的秘书、长子周彥驤处得知其死讯的。我出生于安徽徐州，父亲曾是清军军官。六岁时，我开始在家聘用的私塾先生指导下读书，直至十七岁。随后我进入直隶保定军校就读，六年后，奉袁世凯之命，我与另外五十三人被选派前往东京陆军士官学校继续深造军事学业。我在东京陆军士官学校就读三年，之后与那五十三人一同返回天津，被袁世凯任命为参谋官。当时我二十六岁。担任参谋官六个月后，我被调往直隶正定府驻防的清军第十五旅。一年后，第十五旅被派往江苏上海附近的镇江。

pages.en:
Four years later I was appointed Colonel of the Artillery
Battalion of the 16th Brigade and 12 months afterwards was
promoted Commander of the Artillery Regiment of the same
Brigade. In the year of the Revolution (1911) the 16th
Brigade of the Imperial Forces was reorganized into the 16th
Division of the army of the Chinese Republic and still remained
at Chi-liang (祁江). Four years later when Feng Kuo-
tsang (馮國璋) was Military Governor of Kiangsu Province, the
16th Division was transferred from Chi-liang to Nanking where
I served with it for one year and was then granted extended
leave owing to sickness. I returned to my native home at
Sungchow and six weeks later was appointed Chief Staff Officer
of the Special District of Chahar (張遠) North West
of Chihli and North Shansi. I held this appointment for one
year and retired to live in Peking. I lived in Peking for
two years and when Li Tsung-hsiang was appointed Military
Governor of Chekiang Province he invited me to serve as his
private counsellors which position I held for three years
and was then appointed by the Government as Chief Staff
Officer to Li Tsung-hsiang. I held this position for two
years and retired immediately prior to the outbreak of
hostilities between the forces of Li Tsung-hsiang and Chi
Sih-yuan (Chekiang - Kiangsu Civil War) to live in Yates Rd,
(I cannot recollect the number of the house) Shanghai for two
years. During the period of my stay in Shanghai I was not
engaged in any activity whatsoever. I was appointed advisor
to the Peking Government and served in a military capacity
pages.zh: 四年后，我被任命为第十六旅炮兵营营长，十二个月后晋升为同一旅的炮兵团团长。辛亥革命那年（1911年），清军第十六旅改编为中华民国陆军第十六师，仍驻守祁江（音译）。四年后，当冯国璋担任江苏省督军时，第十六师从祁江调往南京，我随该师服役一年，后因患病获准长期休假。我回到家乡松江，六周后被任命为察哈尔特别区（位于直隶西北部及山西北部）的总参谋长。我担任此职一年，随后退隐居住于北京。我在北京居住了两年，当卢永祥被任命为浙江省督军时，他邀请我担任他的私人顾问，我担任此职三年，随后被政府任命为卢永祥的总参谋长。我担任此职两年，在卢永祥与齐燮元部队爆发敌对行动（浙苏战争）前夕辞职，移居上海耶茨路（Yates Rd，门牌号已记不清），在那里住了两年。在上海居住期间，我没有从事任何活动。我被任命为北京政府顾问，并以军人身份服役

pages.en:
-1-

for one year at the end of that time I brought my family to
Shanghai where they took up residence at 3 Yu Yung Li (裕仁里),
but Mrs Robert and I returned to Tientsin to undergo medical
treatment but occasionally returned to Shanghai to visit
my family. I removed from 3 Yu Yung Li, the former Robert
to my present address about six years ago. During the time
I lived at Tientsin I was not employed in any capacity as
I suffered from long trouble and all my friends had retired
from active service. I returned to Shanghai at the end of
November 1931 and have remained here since. During the
time I was in the service of Lu Loong-hsiang about 9 years ago,
I met Sung Ngoh-su (孫玉書), then employed as an Inspector
in the Hangchow Mint, and we became friends since that time.
Sung Ngoh-su has been under me at various intervals as a
student. He lives on Jessfield Road and visits me frequently.
About 12 noon to-day, Sung Ngoh-su came to my house and told
me that Tsang Ming-yuan who was one of the 5 officers who
went with me to the Military Academy at Tokio, wished to see
me. I enquired of him where Tsang Ming-yuan was to be found
and he replied "Room 89, Great Eastern Hotel". I then told
Sung Ngoh-su that I wanted to go to the Tah Chung Dong Medicine
Shop, Nanking Road and that I would visit Tsang Ming-yuan at
the same time, and about 3 p.m. Sung Ngoh-su and I left my
house to go and purchase the medicine. We took a No. 17
Tramcar at Rue du Marché to the corner of Nanking and
Chekiang Roads where we alighted, walked north towards
Nanking Road and proceeded to Room No. 89 Great Eastern Hotel.
pages.zh:
-1-

一年，期满后我将家人接到上海，他们定居于裕仁里3号，但罗伯特夫人和我返回天津接受治疗，不过偶尔会回上海探望家人。大约六年前，我从原罗伯特住所裕仁里3号搬至现址。在天津居住期间，我未受雇担任任何职务，因为我长期患病，且所有朋友均已退役。我于1931年11月底返回上海，并一直居住至今。大约九年前，我在卢永祥麾下服役期间，结识了孙玉书（Sung Ngoh-su），他当时受雇于杭州造币厂任稽查员，自那时起我们成为朋友。孙玉书曾断续在我手下受训。他住在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road），经常来访。今天中午十二点左右，孙玉书来到我家，告诉我曾与我一同前往东京陆军士官学校的五名军官之一的臧明远（Tsang Ming-yuan，音译）想见我。我向他询问臧明远的下落，他回答说“在大东饭店89号房间”。于是我告诉孙玉书，我想去南京路的大中堂药店，同时顺便去拜访臧明远，下午三点左右，我和孙玉书离开家去买药。我们在马尔歇路（Rue du Marché）乘坐17路电车至南京路与浙江路路口下车，向北朝南京路方向步行，前往大东饭店89号房间。

pages.en:
-4-
on entering the room, Tsang King-yuan was not there but
two other gentlemen unknown to me were present. xxxxx
As Jung ngok-mu and I sat down, Tsang King-yuan entered and
after he enquired if I had had tiffin he gave me a cup of
tea. At that moment the police arrived and searched me
and then took me with the others to Police Station. I went
to the Great Eastern Hotel for no other purpose than to
meet Tsang King-yuan for a friendly chat and if Tsang King-
yuan or any other person can prove that I engaged in
any subversive activities I am quite willing to accept
punishment.
pages.zh:
-4-
进入房间后，臧金元（Tsang King-yuan，音译，疑为前述臧明远）不在，但有两位我不认识的绅士在场。xxxxx
当荣鄂木（Jung ngok-mu，音译）和我坐下时，臧金元走了进来，他问我是否吃过午饭后，给我倒了一杯茶。就在那时，警察赶到并搜查了我，然后将我和其他人带往警察局。我去大东饭店的目的只是为了与臧金元友好交谈，如果臧金元或任何人能证明我参与了任何颠覆活动，我完全愿意接受惩罚。

pages.en:
6
Lung Ngo-ding ( 陸外亭 )
uhu                                                                 core
Louisa              March 13, 1932                  Clerk Lah ei-kong

My name is Lung Ngoh-ling, age 45 years, and I
am a native of Wuhu, Anhwei Province. I am married and
my wife is at present in Wuhu. I never went to school
and I am illiterate. I was a hawker at my native
place for 8 years. When I was 25, I joined the Wuhu
Salt Smuggling Prevention Corps as a Constable and
stayed with this body until January 1, 1931 when it was
dissolved. On January 15, 1931 (lunar calendar), I
went to Linho and joined the Salt Smuggling Prevention
Corps there as a constable. I left Linho on March 1,
1932 when the Japanese Forces occupied the place. I
then took refuge at Soochow. I came to Shanghai via
Sungkiang and Hangchow on March 11. I came to Shanghai
to visit a man named Tso Tsung Teh who worked in Cheki.
He was a servant to a Chinese family. I first met him
in Wuhu where he was employed in a similar capacity. I
again met him sometime last year when he came to
Shanghai from Linho to make some purchases. I however
failed to locate him. I then came into the Settlement
and walked to Nanking Road. At about 2 p.m., March 11,
when I passing the Great Eastern Hotel I met a man
named Lee Ming-tseng. I knew this person in Wuhu
where he kept a charcoal shop. I asked him when he
came to Shanghai. He replied that he arrived from Wuhu
two days ago. He then questioned me about myself and
I told him that I arrived in Shanghai on March 11. He
then asked me to come into the hotel as it was raining.
pages.zh:
6
陆外亭 (Lung Ngo-ding)
芜湖                                                                 核心
罗素              1932年3月13日                  书记员 Lah ei-kong

本人名为陆鄂灵（Lung Ngoh-ling，音译），现年45岁，安徽省芜湖人。已婚，妻子目前在芜湖。我从未上过学，是文盲。我在家乡做了八年小贩。二十五岁时，我加入芜湖缉私营任警士，一直待在该部队直至1931年1月1日该部队解散。1931年1月15日（农历），我前往临河（Linho，音译），加入当地的缉私营任警士。1932年3月1日日军占领该地时，我离开了临河。随后我避难至苏州。我经松江和杭州于3月11日抵达上海。我来上海是为了拜访一位名叫左宗德（Tso Tsung Teh，音译）的人，他在浙江工作。他是一个中国家庭的仆人。我最初在芜湖认识他，当时他也受雇从事类似工作。去年某个时候，当他从临河来上海采购时，我又见到了他。但我未能找到他。随后我进入租界，步行至南京路。3月11日下午2点左右，当我经过大东饭店时，遇到了一位名叫李明增（Lee Ming-tseng，音译）的人。我在芜湖认识这个人，他在那里开了一家炭店。我问他何时来的上海。他回答说两天前从芜湖抵达。随后他问起我的情况，我告诉他我是3月11日抵达上海的。然后他因为下雨邀请我进饭店。

pages.en:
- 2 -

I went inside with him to his room No.29. At 3 p.m.
I left the hotel and to a bathhouse but I do not remember
the name of the place or the road. I returned to Lee's
room at the hotel about 7 p.m. About 9 p.m. I and Lee
went to bed. I got up at 8 a.m. on March 1st and went
out alone to a foodshop near the hotel. About 9 a.m.
I returned to Lee's room and found that he had got up.
I then turned out and walked about the hotel. A few
minutes later 3 other men entered the room. I did not
know these men so I left the room. I walked about the
hotel until 11 a.m. when I saw the 3 men leave the room.
I went back and saw Lee but he did not say anything. I
left the room and ordered food which was served me in an
unoccupied room. I finished eating at 12 noon and
went for a walk about the hotel. About 4 p.m. I sat
outside Lee's room No.29 and a little while later a
Party of police of the Public Safety Bureau came.
They took me into Room No.29 but there was no one inside.
They then searched and arrested me.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

我随他进入他的29号房间。下午3点，我离开饭店去一家浴室，但我不记得那地方的名字或所在道路。晚上7点左右，我回到饭店李的房间。晚上9点左右，我和李上床睡觉。3月1日早上8点我起床，独自出门去饭店附近的一家食品店。上午9点左右，我回到李的房间，发现他已经起床。随后我走出去，在饭店里闲逛。几分钟后，另外三个人进入了房间。因为不认识这些人，我离开了房间。我在饭店里闲逛，直到上午11点看到那三个人离开房间。我回去见李，但他什么也没说。我离开房间，点了食物，食物被送到一间空房间里供我食用。中午12点吃完后，我在饭店里散步。下午4点左右，我坐在李的29号房间外面，过了一会儿，公安局的一队警察来了。他们把我带进29号房间，但里面没有人。随后他们搜查并逮捕了我。

pages.en:
7
Wong Zoong-sung (王仲仁)
Kiangsu                                      D.S.I. Montgomery
Louza Station        March 13                Clerk Chao Shih-chow.

My name is Wong Zoong-zung (王仲仁) aged 35, native
of Kiangsu. I was married in 1923 but my wife died the
following year. I have no children of my own but have an
adopted son, aged 5 years, living at my native place, Tung
Tai (東台). I am at present employed as a military instructor
at the Dah Hsia University, Jessfield Road, where I live; my
pupils being students of the university who desire to have
military training which consists of drilling. In addition
to my work as a military instructor I undertake voluntarily
to give lessons in reading to young children at the Pei King
Elementary School which is near to the Dah Hsia University.
The body of students to whom I give military instruction are
not an "Anti-Japanese and National Salvation Army".
I was born at Tung Tai Hsien near Chinkiang. Between
the ages of 12 and 15 years, I attended a small school at my
native village after which I attended the Sing Tsa (心齋) high
school, also at Tung Tai, for a further two years. At the age
of 17, on hearing that students would be accepted at Feng Yue
Hsiang's Military School at Kaifeng, known as the Honan Military
School I proceeded to Kaifeng, where I learned that free tuition
could be obtained on passing an examination in reading, writing
and geography. I was allowed to sit at this examination and
succeeded in passing. I entered the Honan Military School
and studied for three years. On the completion of my studies
I and some 500 other graduates were posted as officers to Feng
Yue Hsiang's North-Western Army and we departed with some
100,000 soldiers to the Fukien province to suppress banditry.
pages.zh:
7
王仲仁 (Wong Zoong-sung)
江苏                                      D.S.I. Montgomery
罗素巡捕房        3月13日                书记员 Chao Shih-chow.

本人名为王仲仁，现年35岁，江苏人。我于1923年结婚，但妻子次年去世。我没有亲生子女，但有一个养子，现年5岁，住在我的家乡东台。我目前受雇于极司菲尔路的大夏大学任军事教官，我就住在那里；我的学生是希望接受包括操练在内的军事训练的大学生。除了担任军事教官的工作外，我还自愿在大夏大学附近的北京小学教幼童识字。我给予军事指导的学生团体并非“抗日救国军”。
我出生于镇江附近的东台县。12岁至15岁之间，我在家乡的一所小学校读书，之后又在东台的心斋中学读了两年。17岁时，听说冯玉祥在开封的军校（称为河南军校）招收学生，我便前往开封，在那里得知通过阅读、写作和地理考试即可获得免费教育。我获准参加此次考试并成功通过。我进入河南军校学习了三年。学业完成后，我和其他约500名毕业生被任命为冯玉祥西北军的军官，我们随同约十万士兵前往福建省剿匪。

pages.en:
- 2 -

On arrival at Ling Hong, Fokien Province, we learned that most
of the banditry had already been suppressed. I remained in
the North-Western Army in the Fokien Province for about three
years and then the army was disbanded. About 300 of the
ex-graduates of Kaifeng Military College then proceeded to
Canton and I elected to go with them. The remaining 200 returned
to their homes. On arrival at Canton I secured service under
General Hsu Tsung-tse (许崇智) in his First Route Army as
Captain. I proceeded with the Army to Pah Yuan San (白雲山)
and operated against General Chen Kwen-ming (陳炯明) troops.
After a year's fighting General Chen's forces retreated to
Weichow. The forces with whom I was serving followed them
and the fighting lasted for another two years. During one
engagement I received wounds in the legs, which necessitated
my resigning my service with the 1st Route Army. On leaving
the 1st Route Army I then came to Shanghai in order to receive
medical treatment which was rendered by a Chinese doctor named
Li Ling (李林) whose office was in Avenue Joffre.
After having received three months treatment I got
well again. I had a little money and I joined together with
some friends and started a hotel which was named the Yuan Chow
Hotel at Tung Shing Jan in the French Concession. After a
few months the hotel proved a failure and I returned to my
native place. I have not seen or heard of my shareholders
since then. At Tung Tai (my native place) I lived for two
years with my elder brother named Wong Yien-ming (王耀明).
There I got married but my wife died about a year afterwards.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

抵达福建林洪（Ling Hong，音译）后，我们得知大部分匪患已被平定。我在福建的西北军中停留了约三年，随后军队解散。当时约有300名开封军校的前毕业生前往广州，我选择与他们同行。其余200人返回家乡。抵达广州后，我在许崇智将军的第一路军中谋得队长一职。我随军前往白云山，并与陈炯明将军的部队作战。经过一年的战斗，陈部撤退至惠州。我所服役的部队紧随其后，战斗又持续了两年。在一次战斗中，我腿部受伤，这迫使我辞去了在第一路军的职务。离开第一路军后，我来到上海接受治疗，治疗由一位名叫李林的中国医生提供，他的诊所在霞飞路。
经过三个月的治疗，我康复了。我有一点积蓄，便与一些朋友合伙开办了一家名为元洲酒店（Yuan Chow Hotel，音译）的旅馆，位于法租界董兴仁（Tung Shing Jan，音译）。几个月后，酒店经营失败，我回到了家乡。自那以后，我再也没有见过或听说过我的股东们。在东台（我的家乡），我与名叫王耀明的哥哥一起生活了两年。在那里我结了婚，但妻子大约在一年后去世。

pages.en:
- 3 -

I was then about 29 years old. Not having any work to do at
my home, I decided to go to Canton which I did and on arrival
there I got in touch with General Chien Dah-chun (錢大鈞)
whom I had known when serving with the 1st Route Army. He
sponsored my going to the Whampoa Military Academy where I
remained for two years studying military matters. I then
went to Nanking and there met one Ho Min-yuin (何民魂), a
committee member of Kiangsu Provincial Government. I had
known him on my first visit to Canton when he was the editor
of a newspaper there. Through Ho Ming-yuin I obtained the
position of chief of the Public Safety Bureau at Pei Hsien
(縣) near to Nanking. I did not remain there more than
six months as my health broke down. I then proceeded to
Poochen (浦鎮) near Pukow and obtained the position of Chief
of the Public Safety Bureau there, but I was dismissed owing
to a new and more influential man being appointed. Hoping
to get in touch with friends at Shanghai I came here and stayed
at the Woo Ping (和平) Lodging House near Rue du Consulat.
I stayed at the lodging house for three months but unable
to find employment. I went to Ninghai where I obtained
a position as police inspector through the help of Lai Kong
(賴光) whom I had known at the Whampoa Military Academy.
I remained in this position for about two years, but on
account of a change in the chiefs of the Public Safety Bureau,
I lost my position and came to Shanghai again. On my return
to Shanghai I visited a man named Soong Tsung-kin (宋宗九),
whom I had known in Canton on my first visit there. Soong
pages.zh:
- 3 -

我当时大约29岁。因在家中无事可做，我决定前往广州，并随即成行。抵达广州后，我联系了钱大钧将军，此前我在第一路军服役时便认识他。他资助我进入黄埔军校，我在那里学习了两年军事课程。随后我前往南京，在那里结识了江苏省政府委员何民魂。我第一次访问广州时就认识他，当时他是当地一家报纸的编辑。通过何民魂，我获得了南京附近沛县公安局长一职。我在那里任职不到六个月，便因健康恶化而离职。接着我前往浦口附近的浦镇，并在那里谋得公安局长之职，但因一位更有权势的新任官员到任，我被解职。希望与上海的朋友取得联系，我便来到上海，住在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）附近的和平旅馆。我在该旅馆住了三个月，但未能找到工作。我前往宁海，通过在黄埔军校结识的赖光的帮助，获得了一名巡官的职位。我在这个职位上待了大约两年，但因公安局领导层变动，我失去了职位，再次来到上海。回到上海后，我拜访了一位名叫宋宗九的人，这是我第一次去广州时认识的。宋

pages.en:
- 4 -

at that time lived at 2 Ching Hai Li (敬禧里) Rue Wantz and
aided me to find my present position. He is now living at
No. 22 Pao Jen Li, Avenue Joffre.
During May 1931 I visited the Great World with an
old friend named Soong Tsung-kiu who now occupies the position
of Chief of the 8th Section of the Police Forces of the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau, and was introduced to one Kong Sung-dao
(江聲濤), a native of Anhwei aged about 20 years. He is a
subordinate official of the Public Safety Bureau being in charge
of the 1st corps. There was no special purpose in the
introduction other than friendship. I became friendly with
Kong and we used to meet about three times a month. Sometimes
I went to Kong's house which was near the Nantao Public Safety
Bureau and sometimes he came to see me at the Dah Hsia University.
On account of danger occasioned by the Japanese advance I could
no longer remain at the University and Kong told me I could
take meals at his house. We have seen a lot of each other
during the last few days. On one occasion when visiting
Kong at the Public Safety Bureau I was introduced to one Zau
If-yun (常翼元) who is a teacher of a small middle school
but I do not know where it is located. There was no object
in the introduction other than friendship. I have not seen
the latter very much except on occasion when I have visited
the Public Safety Bureau.
On March 11, I went to Kong Sung-dao's house for
tiffin and just when we had finished Zau If-yun came to see
Kong. Some conversation regarding a "Self-Protection Corps"
pages.zh:
- 4 -

当时住在万航渡路敬禧里2号，并帮助我找到了目前的职位。他现在住在霞飞路宝仁里22号。
1931年5月，我与一位名叫宋宗秋的老朋友一同游览大世界，他现任上海公共租界警察局第八科科长，经他介绍，我认识了一位名叫江声涛的安徽籍人士，年龄约20岁。他是公安局的一名下级官员，负责第一大队。这次介绍除了增进友谊外，并无其他特殊目的。我与江变得熟络，我们每月大约见面三次。有时我去江位于南市公安局附近的家中，有时他来大华大学看我。由于日军进逼带来的危险，我无法再留在大学，江告诉我可以在他家吃饭。最近几天我们经常见面。有一次我在公安局拜访江时，被介绍给常翼元，他是一所小型中学的教师，但我不知道该校位于何处。这次介绍除了增进友谊外，并无其他目的。除了在拜访公安局时偶尔见到他外，我很少见到后者。
3月11日，我去江声涛家吃午饭，就在我们刚吃完时，常翼元来看望江。江和常之间进行了一些关于“自卫团”的谈话

pages.en:
- 5 -

took place between Kong and Zau and I became interested. Kong
then said he had business at the Public Safety Bureau and
asked Zau and I to accompany him there to meet an old friend
named Wong Ming (黃明), Chief of the Special Duty Section
of the Nantao Public Safety Bureau. Accordingly we proceeded
on foot to the Public Safety Bureau and Kong introduced me to
Wong Ming. After the introduction was completed Kong, Zau
and Wong talked about the Self Protection Corps. I was told
by Kong that the idea of the Self Protection Corps was to
defend Nantao against the Japanese invasion. Kang suggested
that I accompany him to the Great Eastern Hotel where persons
interested in the Corps met in Rooms 34 and 29. Accordingly
Wong Ming, Kong Sung-dan, Zau Ih-van and I got into Wong Ming's
private motorcar and proceeded to the Great Eastern Hotel. In
Room No. 34 there were two men whose names I know to be Li Ming-
seeng (李敏生) and Tsang Ming-yuib (張明遠). I have known
Li for about one year having been introduced to him by one Loo
whom I had met when I was Chief of the Public Safety Bureau at
Pei Hsien. The introduction took place at the Hwa Feh (華妃)
Lodging House, Rue Brenier de Montmorand. I have known Chang
Ming-yuin for many years but I forget where I met him. For a
long time we talked about the Self Protection Corps and praised
the patriotic motives which actuated the proposed formation of
the unit. We all then sat down to dinner. After dinner was
finished Wong Ming instructed Kong to go to the Public Safety
Bureau and Kong immediately left the room. Li Ming-seeng
throughout the dinner and afterwards kept up a whispering
pages.zh:
- 5 -

引起了我的兴趣。江随后说他在公安局有事，邀请常和我陪他去那里见一位老朋友黄明，他是南市公安局特务股股长。于是我们步行前往公安局，江将我介绍给黄明。介绍完毕后，江、常和黄谈论了自卫团的事宜。江告诉我，组建自卫团的构想是为了防御日军对南市的入侵。江建议我陪同他前往东亚饭店，对该团体感兴趣的人士会在34号和29号房间会面。于是，黄明、江声涛、常翼元和我坐上了黄明的私人汽车，前往东亚饭店。在34号房间里有两个人，我知道他们的名字是李敏生和张明远。我认识李大约一年了，是由一位姓鲁的人介绍的，我在担任沛县公安局长时认识了这位鲁某。那次介绍发生在蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）的华妃旅馆。我认识张明远多年，但我忘记了是在哪里遇见他的。我们长时间讨论了自卫团，并赞扬了拟议组建该部队的爱国动机。随后我们一起坐下用餐。晚餐结束后，黄明指示江去公安局，江随即离开了房间。李敏生在晚餐期间及之后一直与黄明低声交谈

pages.en:
- 6 -
conversation with Wong Ming. At about 5.30 p.m. I was about
to leave when Zau Ih-van t le me to go on the following
to see Tong King at the Public Safety Bureau but did not say
for what purpose. I left the Great Eastern Hotel then and
went to the Tsung Siang Lodging House where I was staying on
account of not being able to go to the University.
At about 7 a.m. On March 12 Zau Ih-van came to my
lodging house in a ricsha and asked me to accompany him to
Kong's house and then go to see Tong King. I called a ricsha
and we both went together to Kong's house where we have
Breakfast together with Kong. After breakfast was finished
we all walked to Tong King's house but only Kong went inside
the house. A little time later Kong came out and said that
Tong King was not going to the Great Eastern Hotel but we
could use his motor car. Accordingly the three of us got
into Tong King's motorcar which was indicated by Kong and
we proceeded to the Great Eastern Hotel and to/ Room No.34
when we got there we found that Tsang King-yuen was already
in the room.Almost at the same time as we got there Li Ning-
tseong arrived. Kong told the company that he had been
authorised by Tong King to act as his representative and
stated that Tong King required $100,000 to organize the
"Self Protection Corps". Tsang King-yuen and Lee Ning Tseong
states that they did not have enough money at the time. Li
Ning-tseong and Tsang King-yuen went outside the room and
in a few minutes returned saying that half that sum could
be raised in ten days. Kang Sung-fan (江舜藩) then stated
pages.zh:
- 6 -

大约在下午5点30分，我正准备离开时，常翼元让我第二天去公安局见唐景，但未说明目的。随后我离开了东亚饭店，回到我居住的宗祥旅馆，因为无法返回大学，我便住在那里。
3月12日早上7点左右，常翼元乘人力车来到我的住处，请我陪他去江的家，然后去见唐景。我叫了一辆人力车，我们两人一起去了江的家，并与江共进早餐。早餐后，我们步行前往唐景的家，但只有江进了屋。过了一会儿，江出来说唐景不去东亚饭店了，但我们可以使用他的汽车。于是我们三人坐上了江指认的唐景的汽车，前往东亚饭店的34号房间。到达时，我们发现张金元已经在房间里了。几乎在我们到达的同时，李敏生也到了。江告诉大家，他已获唐景授权作为其代表，并称唐景需要10万美元来组织“自卫团”。张金元和李敏生表示他们当时没有足够的钱。李敏生和张金元走出房间，几分钟后回来说十天之内可以筹集到一半的金额。江舜藩随后声明

pages.en:
- 7 -

that enough money to purchase 2,000 rifles would also be
required. Lee King-tseong stated that he would raise enough
money to purchase half the number of rifles required. Kong
then stated that Wong Ming claimed the right to be made
Chief of the 3rd Division of the Self Protection Corps.
Tsang Ming-yuen then took a piece of paper and wrote out
an acceptance of Wong Ming's demands. Lee King-chun then
stamped the document with a seal in size about 1 inch by half
an inch. I did not see the characters on the chop. Lee
King-chun then handed the document to Kong Sung-dan who put
it in his pocket. Kong left the place a few minutes later
saying that he would deliver the document to Wong Ming. A
short time later Tsang Ming-yuen and Lee Ming-chun requested
Zau Ih-van and I to go and find Kong and ask him to come and
collect $3,000 on behalf of Wong Ming. Accordingly we
left the place and hired a public motorcar in which we
proceeded to Kong's house where we found Kong and the
three of us had tiffin together. Kong said that
Wong Ming would go to the Great Eastern Hotel at 4 p.m. that
day. Having finished tiffin at about 1.30 p.m. Kong Sung-
dan, Zau Ih-van and myself went in a hired motorcar to the
Great Eastern Hotel, Kong saying that he wanted to collect
the $3,000 for Wong Ming. The three of us went to Room 34
in which were Tsang Ming-yuen and Lee King-tseong. Kong
told Lee that he had come for the money for Wong Ming and
produced a receipt which he stated had been prepared by
Wong Ming as per an arrangement. The receipt was given to
pages.zh:
- 7 -

还需要足够的资金购买2,000支步枪。李敏生表示他将筹集足够购买所需数量一半步枪的资金。江随后称，黄明声称有权担任自卫团第三师师长。张明远随即拿出一张纸，写下接受黄明要求的字据。李敏生随后用一枚大约一英寸乘半英寸大小的印章在该文件上盖了章。我没有看清印章上的文字。李敏生随后将文件交给江声涛，江将其放入口袋。几分钟后江离开此地，称他会将文件交给黄明。不久后，张明远和李敏生请求常翼元和我去找江，让他来代黄明收取3,000美元。于是我们离开那里，雇了一辆公共汽车前往江的家，发现江在那里，我们三人一起吃了午饭。江说黄明将在当天下午4点去东亚饭店。下午1点30分左右吃完午饭后，江声涛、常翼元和我乘坐一辆租赁的汽车前往东亚饭店，江称他要去为黄明收取那3,000美元。我们三人进入34号房间，张明远和李敏生已在房内。江告诉李，他是来替黄明取钱的，并出示了一张收据，称这是黄明按照约定准备的。收据交给了

pages.en:
Sung Hyoh-su 孙孝苏
Hwaian, Kiangsu                                      Superintendent Robertson
Louza Stn.           13/3/32                          D.I.Sih Tse-liang

My name is Sung Hyoh-su, 42 years of age, native of
Hwaian, Kiangsu and am now residing at the home of my
daughter at 111 Jessfield Road. I studied at home until I
was 17 years of age when I opened a confectionary shop at
my native place. After 2 years the shop was closed owing
to bad business and I secured a situation as a clerk in the
Customs at Hwaian. I held this post until 1923 when I
received a job as clerk in the Mint at Hangchow which post
I held for 3 years after which I returned home because my mother
had died and again entered the Customs there as a clerk. I
retained my post until 1930 when the Hwaian Customs was
abolished by the Ministry of Finance. I remained unemployed
until January 1932 when I came to Shanghai and resided with
my daughter and son-in-law at 111 Jessfield Road, a
foreign unoccupied dwelling where my son-in-law is employed
as a watchman. Since arriving in Shanghai I have had no
employment and the only friend I have locally is Chou Keng
sung (周幹臣), who resides at 86 Rue Brenier de Mont-
morand and was formerly a Colonel in the Army at Hwaian and
at one time Chief of Staff to Lu Yung-hsiang, then Tuchun of
Chekiang. On the morning of March 10, I visited Chou at his
home and there met one Tsang Hinghwen (曾杏文) whom Chou
introduced as a former school fellow of his. The little
conversation which took place on this visit must have been
of a general nature as I cannot remember what was said. I
left Chou's house at about 11 a.m. and again visited him at
12 noon on March 12 when he informed me that his third son
pages.zh:
孙孝苏
江苏淮安                                      罗伯逊警司
娄山关站           1932年3月13日                          督察 施子良

我叫孙孝苏，42岁，江苏淮安人，现居住在杰斯菲尔德路111号我女儿家中。我在家读书直到17岁，随后在家乡开了一家糖果店。两年后因生意不佳店铺关闭，我在淮安海关谋得一名职员职位。我担任此职直到1923年，随后在杭州造币厂获得一份职员工作，该职位我担任了3年，之后因母亲去世回家，并再次进入当地海关担任职员。我一直保留该职位直到1930年，当时淮安海关被财政部撤销。此后我一直失业，直到1932年1月来到上海，与女儿和女婿居住在杰斯菲尔德路111号，这是一处外籍无人居住的房屋，我的女婿受雇担任看守。自抵达上海以来，我一直没有工作，我在本地唯一的朋友是周幹臣，他住在蒙马兰路86号，曾是淮安军队的一名上校，并一度担任时任浙江督军卢永祥的参谋长。3月10日上午，我前往周家拜访，在那里遇到了一位曾杏文，周介绍说是他的老同学。这次拜访中进行的简短谈话必定是一般性质的，因为我不记得说了什么。我大约在上午11点离开周家，并于3月12日中午12点再次拜访他，当时他告知我他的三儿子

pages.en:
-2-

a cadet in the 37th Division, have been killed in action
We went out for a walk about 5 p.m. and on reaching the Great
Eastern Hotel, Nanking Road, Chou suggested to call on
Tsang who, he said, was likely to be in room 29 of the
Great Eastern Hotel. We accordingly went to the room and
saw a man whom we did not know. He said his name was Wong
(王). Another man was outside the door enquiring what we
wanted. On our telling him he requested us to take a seat
and he would get Tsang. Shortly afterwards Tsang appeared
and while he and Chou were exchanging courtesies a party of
police arrived and arrested five of us, namely, Wong, Tsang,
Chou, myself and the man who was just outside the door.
I have no knowledge of any plan to organize a new army.
At no time did I hear Tsang or Chou talk on such a matter.
I have never taken part in political activities nor have I
any party leaning. Although I am without employment I have
property at Hwaian which produces a revenue of about $30.
monthly.
pages.zh:
-2-

是第37师的学员，已在战斗中阵亡。我们在下午5点左右出去散步，到达南京路的东亚饭店时，周建议去拜访曾，他说曾可能在东亚饭店的29号房间。于是我们前往该房间，见到一个我们不认识的人。他说他姓王。另一个人在门外询问我们要找谁。当我们告诉他后，他请我们就座，说他会去叫曾。不久后曾出现了，正当他和周寒暄时，一群警察赶到，逮捕了我们五人，即王、曾、周、我自己以及刚才在门外的那个人。
我对任何组建新军队的计划一无所知。我从未听到曾或周谈论此类事情。我从未参与过政治活动，也没有任何党派倾向。虽然我目前失业，但我在淮安有财产，每月产生约30元的收入。

pages.en:
9
Tang Ming-yuen
Hankow, March,
(Capt. Robertson)
11 p.m. March 13, J.I. Ck. Tse-king.

My name is Tang Ming-yuen (湯明遠). I am 58 years of age,
a native of Hupeh (Hankow) and have resided for the past year
in room 29, Jah Zung Lodging House, Rue Chapeal, French
Concession. When I was 20 years of age I proceeded to Tokio
where I studied for six years in the military Academy, my
fees being paid by General Tang Tzu-dong, the then Governor
of Hupeh and Hunan. I had passed the necessary examination
which entitled me to the course at the expense of the
Chinese Imperial Government. After graduating I proceeded
to Peking where I passed Chu Jen (舉人) degree in infantry
knowledge. I was then appointed a Company Commander in the
Hupeh Provincial Government. Two years later I went to
Nanking and received an appointment as Battalion Commander
with 500 troops under my command. I resigned this post after
one year and proceeded to Hankow where I was appointed
Counsellor to the Military Training Department which post I
held for six months. The Revolution broke out at this time
and I went to Shanghai where I received the appointment as
Senior Staff Officer to General Lan Tien-wei (藍天蔚) at that time
Commander of the Revolutionary Forces and proceeded to Chefoo
with the troops and navy. One month later (December 1911)
I was appointed Military Commander of Tungchowfu which post
I held for only three months owing to its being discontinued
as a result of the overthrow of the Ching Dynasty. After
handing over my troops to General Sung Loo (宋露), a
close associate of General Tan Kai-man, I returned to
Shanghai (in April). After remaining idle in Shanghai for
pages.zh:
9
汤明远
汉口，三月，
（罗伯逊上尉）
3月13日晚11时，江苏巡捕房。

我叫汤明远（湯明遠）。现年58岁，湖北（汉口）人，过去一年居住在法租界霞飞路（Rue Chapeal）贾宗旅馆29号房。我20岁时前往东京，在陆军士官学校学习了六年，学费由当时的湖广总督唐自东将军支付。我通过了必要的考试，从而有资格由中国清政府公费就读。毕业后，我前往北京，考取了步兵科的举人（Chu Jen）学位。随后我被任命为湖北省政府的一名连长。两年后，我去了南京，受任营长，麾下统领500名士兵。一年后我辞去该职，前往汉口，被任命为军事训练部顾问，在该职位上任职六个月。此时革命爆发，我前往上海，被任命为当时革命军司令蓝天蔚将军（General Lan Tien-wei）的高级参谋，并随部队和海军前往烟台。一个月后（1911年12月），我被任命为通州府军事指挥官，但由于清朝被推翻，该职位被撤销，因此我仅任职三个月。在将部队移交给谭凯曼将军的密友宋露将军（General Sung Loo）后，我返回上海（四月）。在上海闲居

pages.en:
2

one month I proceeded to Chinkiangpu, Northern Kiangsu,
where I was appointed Chief of Staff to the Defence
Commissioner and concurrently Chief of Police. I held this
position for one year and eight months and left following
the declaration of independence of Kiangsu against Yuan Shih-
kai. Returning to Shanghai I remained idle for four months
after which I went to Peking where I conducted an anti-Yuan
Shih-kai campaign for two years. After the death of Yuan
Shih-kai (June 1916), Li Yuan-hung was appointed President
and I was made a Military Councillor to him. This post I
held for one year. At the time Chang Hsun plotted to
restore the boy Emperor to the throne and because of this
I resigned and went to Shanghai where I remained unemployed
for eight months. I then went to Naimanfu (Szechuan and
Hopeh border) where a revolution had been started by General
Tang Ke-ming (唐克明) against Tuan Chi-jui and his Anfu
clique. Here I held the post of Senior Advisor to General
Tang. I held this post for three years under Generals
Tang Ke-ming (唐克明), Pa Wen-li (柏文蔚) and Lan Tien-wei
(蓝天蔚) in succession. As our army (anti-Anfu) was
defeated by the forces of General Wang Tsun-yuan (王占元),
Tuchun of Hopeh, I fled to Hankow where I remained idle for
eighteen months. After which I proceeded to Changsha where
I was appointed Military Advisor to Chao Heng-ti (赵恒惕),
Tuchun of Hunan which post I held for nine months. As Sun
Yat-sen sent troops to attack Chao Heng-ti, I went to
Shanghai where I remained idle for 18 months. I next went to
pages.zh:
2
