一个月后，我前往苏北镇江埠，被任命为防卫专员参谋长，并兼任警察局长。我担任此职一年零八个月，在江苏宣布独立反对袁世凯后离职。回到上海后，我闲居了四个月，随后前往北京，进行了两年的反袁世凯活动。袁世凯死后（1916年6月），黎元洪被任命为大总统，我成为他的军事顾问。我担任此职一年。当时张勋策划复辟溥仪皇帝，因此我辞职前往上海，在那里失业八个月。随后我前往内蛮府（Naimanfu，四川与河北边境），唐克明将军（General Tang Ke-ming）在此发动反对段祺瑞及其安福系的革命。我在这里担任唐将军的高级顾问。我先后在唐克明（唐克明）、柏文蔚（Pa Wen-li）和蓝天蔚（Lan Tien-wei）几位将军麾下担任此职三年。由于我们的军队（反安福系）被河北督军王占元将军（General Wang Tsun-yuan）的部队击败，我逃往汉口，在那里闲居了十八个月。之后我前往长沙，被湖南督军赵恒惕（Chao Heng-ti）任命为军事顾问，任职九个月。由于孙中山派兵攻打赵恒惕，我前往上海，在那里闲居了18个月。接着我前往

pages.en:
Nanchang, Kiangsi, where on the instructions of Sun
Yat-sen, I endeavoured to induce General Fang Peng-jen
(方本仁) Governor of Kiangsi Province, to attempt a coup
d'etat against Wu Pei-fu. I did not succeed and returned
to Shanghai where I remained without employment for about a
year. My next move was to Anking (Anhui) where I became
Chief of Staff to General Yen Te-chi (颜德基), Commander of
the 2nd Training Division of the 10th Route Army which post
I held for five months after which this unit was reorganized
into the 26th Division, 11th Route Army (October, 1927).
I continued to hold my post under the new regime for about
6 months at the end of which period I resigned owing to the
unit being in financial straits. At that time this unit
was in Swatow. I again returned to Shanghai (April 1928)
since when I have existed on my savings together with
financial assistance from friends. About 3 days ago, one
Li Ming-tseong (李族宗) came to my lodgings and invited me
to take a bath at the Orient Eastern Hotel. I accordingly
went there about 9 p.m. and owing to the curfew was compelled
to pass the night in the hotel. During my stay Mr Li
expressed a desire to have my assistance in a plot he was
planning in compliance with instructions from Hu Han-min,
Dr. Wellington Koo, and General Chen Chi-tang (陈济棠),
President of the Kuangtung Provincial Government. The
outline of the plot, Li Ming-tseong informed me, was the
organization of an army to be styled the South Eastern Self-
Defence Army to assist the 19th Route Army in opposing
pages.zh: 江西南昌，根据孙中山的指示，我试图劝说江西省省长方本仁将军（General Fang Peng-jen）发动反对吴佩孚的政变。我没有成功，返回上海，在那里失业约一年。我的下一站是安徽安庆，我在那里担任第十路军第二训练师师长颜德基将军（General Yen Te-chi）的参谋长，任职五个月后，该部队改组为第十一军第二十六师（1927年10月）。在新体制下我继续任职约6个月，期末因部队财政困难而辞职。当时该部队驻汕头。我再次返回上海（1928年4月），此后靠积蓄及朋友的资助生活。大约三天前，一个叫李族宗（Li Ming-tseong）的人来到我的住处，邀请我去东方大饭店洗澡。于是我于晚上9点左右前往那里，由于宵禁，被迫在酒店过夜。在此期间，李先生表示希望我协助他策划一项阴谋，他是奉胡汉民、顾维钧博士和陈济棠将军（广东省政府主席）的指示行事的。李族宗告诉我，阴谋的大致内容是组建一支名为“东南自卫军”的军队，以协助第十九路军对抗

pages.en:
Chiang Kai-shek and resisting the Japanese forces. Li also
intimated that he had made arrangements with the Safety Bureau
and the Merchants Volunteers for their assistance and co-operation.
Li also stated that one Huang Hing (黄), an officer of the
Bureau of Public Safety had accepted a post as Divisional
Commander in the proposed army and another man named Hsiang
(项), also of the Bureau, had accepted a post as Colonel.
Another member of the Safety Bureau, named Hsing (盛), had
accepted a post as Brigadier. Li also confided that the main
part of the plot was that the men of the Bureau of Public Safety
and the merchants Volunteers should form the nucleus of the
New Army. I replied that I must give the matter full consideration
before deciding in the matter of his request for my advice. I
visited the hotel again yesterday afternoon (March 11) when I
met Huang Hing. While I was there Li Sing-tao handed Huang
Hing his (Huang Hing's) letter of appointment as Commander of
the 3rd Division in the new Army. On this occasion Li told me
that General Chou Feng-chi (周凤岐), ex Tachun of Chekiang,
was also a party to the plot and in all likelihood would
command the new army. General Chou's present whereabouts are
unknown to me and I did not enquire from Li on this point.
On taking my departure from the Great Eastern Hotel, Li begged
of me to return and visit him again to-day. About 11 a.m.
to-day, I again went to the Great Eastern Hotel where I saw
Li in his room. Shortly afterwards two Chinese named Chang
(张) and Fang (方) came to the room and when they
were about to sit down to fiddle, Li took from his pocket
pages.zh: 蒋介石并抵抗日军。李还暗示，他已与安全局和商团义勇队安排好，以获得他们的协助与合作。李还称，安全局的一名官员黄兴（Huang Hing，姓黄）已接受拟议军队中的师长职务，该局另一名姓项（Hsiang）的人已接受团长职务。安全局的另一名成员姓盛（Hsing）已接受旅长职务。李还透露，阴谋的主要部分是让公共安全局的人和商团义勇队组成新军的核心。我回答说，在决定对他的请求提供建议之前，我必须对此事进行充分考虑。昨天下午（3月11日）我再次访问了该酒店，期间见到了黄兴。当我在那里时，李星道（Li Sing-tao）向黄兴递交了任命他为新军第三师师长的委任状。在这次会面中，李告诉我，浙江前督军周凤岐将军（General Chou Feng-chi）也是阴谋的参与者，并且很可能将指挥这支新军。我不知道周将军目前的下落，我也没有就此点询问李。离开东方大饭店时，李恳请我今天再回去拜访他。今天上午11点左右，我再次前往东方大饭店，在房间里见到了李。不久之后，两名叫张（Chang）和方（Fang）的中国人来到房间，当他们正要坐下打牌时，李从口袋里掏出

pages.en:
-3-
a bundle of bank notes which he handed to Chiang who counted
them and declared the amount as $3,000. As to the disposal
of the money I am not certain if it went entirely to Chiang
or was shared between him and Chao, but it went to one or
both of them. I did not pay close attention on this point
but I am certain the money did not go back to Li. Chiang
as I stated before is a member of the Bureau of Public Safety
while Chao I understood to be his colleague who would be
Chief of Staff to Huang Hing also of the Bureau, on his,
Huang's appointment in the new army. These two men immediately
after tiffin left the hotel, promising to return at 4 p.m.
with Huang Hing. After their departure Li told me that Huang
Hing was demanding $100,000 for his assistance in the plot.
Owing to lack of funds Li could not meet this but had paid
out the $3,000.00 to Huang through the two men, Chiang and
Chao with a promise of $100,000 on the successful carrying
out of the plot. Then I went to the room to-day there
were in the room three Chinese, two of whom I saw on my previous
visit. Their names are Li Bing-ngoo (李璧我) and Seong
Sah-taung (宋大璋). After the departure of Chao and Chiang
there were in the room the two Chinese Li Bing-ngoo and
Seong Sah-taung and myself, Li Bing-taong having gone to
another room. At about 3 p.m. two friends of mine named Chau
Hang-chun (周幹臣) and Sun Agoh-an (孫亞安) came to the room
to take a bath on my invitation. About 4 p.m. when Li Bing-
ngoo, Seong, Chau, Sun and myself were in the room, a party
of Municipal Police pushed open the door and entered. One
pages.zh:
-3-
一叠钞票，递给张，张清点后宣布金额为3,000元。至于这笔钱的处置，我不确定是完全给了张，还是由他和赵分享，但钱确实给了他们中的一人或两人。我没有密切关注这一点，但我确信钱没有退回给李。如前所述，张是公共安全局的一员，而我了解到赵是他的同事，将在黄兴于新军任职后担任黄的参谋长，黄也是该局的人。这两人在午饭后立即离开了酒店，承诺下午4点带黄兴回来。他们离开后，李告诉我，黄兴要求支付10万美元以协助该阴谋。由于缺乏资金，李无法满足这一要求，但已通过张和赵两人向黄支付了3,000.00美元，并承诺在阴谋成功实施后支付10万美元。然后我今天去那个房间时，房间里有三个中国人，其中两个是我上次拜访时见过的。他们的名字是李璧我（Li Bing-ngoo）和宋大璋（Seong Sah-taung）。赵和张离开后，房间里剩下李璧我、宋大璋和我自己，李炳堂（Li Bing-taong）去了另一个房间。下午3点左右，我的两个朋友周幹臣（Chau Hang-chun）和孫亞安（Sun Agoh-an）应我邀请来房间洗澡。下午4点左右，当李璧我、宋、周、孙和我都在房间里时，一群工部局警察推门而入。其中一人

pages.en:
-6-
persons were searched as was also the room the number of
which I cannot remember. The reason why Li Ming-tseong
approached me in regard to the plot was due to the fact that
he knew I had considerable experience in revolutionary
matters and was a military expert. I promised help in an
advisory capacity not for monetary gain, but simply because
the movement had my sympathy as I am opposed to Chiang Kai-
shek and his regime. I have known Li Ming-tseong for about
two months. I first met him on Rue Chapeal when I was
introduced to him by a friend named Tong Ching-che (王慶che)
who has now left Shanghai and whose present whereabouts I
do not know. After the Rue Chapeal meeting I did not see
Li Ming-tseong again until he was visited my lodgings three
days ago.
pages.zh:
-6-
对人员进行了搜身，房间也受到了搜查，房间号码我已记不清。李族宗就阴谋一事接触我的原因是因为他知道我在革命事务方面有丰富经验，并且是一名军事专家。我答应以顾问身份提供帮助，并非为了金钱利益，仅仅是因为该运动得到了我的同情，因为我反对蒋介石及其政权。我认识李族宗大约两个月。我第一次见到他是在霞飞路，当时由一位名叫王慶che（Tong Ching-che）的朋友介绍给我，此人现已离开上海，我不知道他目前的下落。在霞飞路会面后，直到三天前他来到我的住处之前，我没有再见过李族宗。

pages.en:
(10)

Soong Pah Dau (宋伯濤).
Changsha, Hunan                                      D.P.P.  Macadie
Louza Stn.          15/3/32                           Clerk K o Yen-keng.

My name is Soong Pah-dau, age 38, native of
Changsha and married.    At the time of my arrest, I
was living at No.26 Sing Ning Tsung (新民村), Rue
Brenier de Montmorand, with a relative of mine Soong
alias Soong Chi-liang (宋季良)
Suh-a wang (宋武璋), officer i/c Registry of the
Kiangnan Arsenal.    My native address is Laung Li Z
(寧鄉市), Toong Hyang (東鄉), Changsha.    I
was a farmer in my native place.    Between 1926 and 1928
I was a member of the commissariat of the Tientsin Tax
Bureau.    I left this position owing to the resignation
of the Chief of the Bureau.    In 1929 I became part
proprietor of a bath house in Fengru (蚌埠), Anhwei.
I left Fengru owing to the floods at that place which
made business very poor and came to Shanghai on December 16,
1931 with a view to approaching Soong Suh-piao (宋武彪),
Director of the Kiangnan Arsenal, for a job.    He is a
distant relative of mine.    I lived in the Kiangnan
Arsenal after my arrival in Shanghai until the beginning of
February when I went to the above address in the French
Concession following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities.    I did no work at the Arsenal nor at this latter
address.    I spent my time reading books and novels until
March 12, when about 9.30 p.m. members of the French Police
came to 26 Sing Ning Tsung (新民村) and arrested me.    I
was later transferred to a police station in the International
Settlement.    I am not concerned in any scheme of Soong Sub-
chuang's who never discussed anything with me.    No one
pages.zh:
(10)

宋伯濤 (Soong Pah Dau)。
湖南长沙                                      D.P.P.  Macadie
卢家湾捕房          1932年3月15日                           书记员 Ko Yen-keng。

我叫宋伯涛（Soong Pah-dau），38岁，长沙人，已婚。被捕时，我住在蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）新民村（Sing Ning Tsung）26号，与我的亲戚宋季良（Soong alias Soong Chi-liang）同住。
宋武璋（Suh-a wang），江南造船厂注册处负责人。我的原籍地址是长沙市东乡宁乡市（Laung Li Z, Toong Hyang, Changsha）。我在家乡务农。1926年至1928年间，我是天津税务局后勤部门的一员。由于局长辞职，我离开了这个职位。1929年，我成为安徽蚌埠一家浴室的部分所有者。由于当地发生洪水，生意非常萧条，我离开了蚌埠，并于1931年12月16日来到上海，打算向江南造船厂厂长宋武彪（Soong Suh-piao）谋求一份工作。他是我的远亲。抵达上海后，我一直住在江南造船厂，直到二月初，随着中日敌对行动的爆发，我搬到了上述法租界的地址。我在造船厂或后来的住所都没有工作。我一直读书和看小说，直到3月12日晚上9点30分左右，法国警察来到新民村26号逮捕了我。后来我被转移到公共租界的一个警察局。我与宋叔庄（Soong Sub-chuang）的任何计划无关，他从未与我讨论过任何事情。没有人

pages.en:
-2-
came to the address in the French Concession nor were any
meetings held there. I am not a member of any party or
sect and my only desire was to secure a position in the
Arsenal.

(Signed) Soong Tsh-ven.
pages.zh:
-2-
来到法租界的地址，那里也没有举行任何会议。我不是任何政党或教派的成员，我唯一的愿望是在造船厂谋得一个职位。

（签名）宋士文 (Soong Tsh-ven)。

pages.en:
Tsu Tei-tien (曹廷先)
Changsha, Hunan                                          Supt. Robertson
Louza "tn             13/5/··                              I.I.Sih Tse-lian

My name is Tsu Tei-tien (曹廷先), 19 years of age, native
of Changsha, Hunan and live at 26 Hsin Min Tehung (新民邨)
Rue Brenier de Montmorand, the home of my cousin, Soong
Yi-lieng (宋子良) who is in charge of the Registry office
in Kiangnan Arsenal. I myself am an apprentice mechanic
in the Arsenal. In 1928 I studied in the Tshoo Yih (楚怡)
Primary School, Changsha, for about 6 months. I was
compelled to give up studies owing to the poor financial
state of my family. At the beginning of 1929 I became
an apprentice in the Dah Kyih Kiang Paper Shop, Changsha.
I remained until December, 1931 when my parents received
a letter from my cousin Soong Yi-lieng asking that I
come to Shanghai and work as an apprentice mechanic in
the Arsenal. I arrived in Shanghai on January 25, 1932
and immediately commenced my apprenticeship. At about
8 p.m. March 12 when I was at home with my mother's brother
Soong Peh-dau (宋伯陶) a party of Police came in and
searched the room. They seized some letters and took us
into custody. Soong Suh-tseng (宋武璋) alias Soong Kyi-
lieng was not in at this time, leaving home at 12 noon that
day. Before his departure he told me that he was going
to call on some friend in the Great Eastern Hotel. He
did not mention the name of the friends nor the number of
the room to which he was proceeding. During my stay in
Soong's home I only saw 5 or 6 visitors. I do not know
their names but believe them to be employees of the Arsenal.
pages.zh:
曹廷先 (Tsu Tei-tien)
湖南长沙                                          罗伯逊巡官
老闸捕房             5月13日··                              I.I. Sih Tse-lian

本人名叫曹廷先，现年19岁，籍贯湖南长沙，现居于蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）新民邨26号，此系我表兄宋子良（Soong Yi-lieng）的住所，他在江南制造局注册处任职。我本人在该制造局担任见习技工。1928年，我在长沙楚怡小学就读约6个月。因家境贫寒，被迫辍学。1929年初，我成为长沙大奇江纸店（Dah Kyih Kiang Paper Shop）的学徒。我一直工作到1931年12月，当时父母收到表兄宋子良的来信，让我去上海，在制造局担任见习技工。我于1932年1月25日抵达上海，并立即开始学徒生涯。3月12日晚8点左右，当我与母亲的兄弟宋伯陶（Soong Peh-dau）在家时，一队警察闯入并搜查了房间。他们查获了一些信件，并将我们拘留。宋武璋（Soong Suh-tseng），又名宋子良（Soong Kyi-lieng），当时不在家，他于当天中午12点离家。临行前他告诉我，他要去大华饭店（Great Eastern Hotel）拜访一位朋友。他没有提及朋友的姓名，也没有说要去哪个房间。在宋家居住期间，我只见过5或6位访客。我不知道他们的名字，但相信他们是制造局的雇员。

pages.en:
Tsiang Ming-tsin (蔣明極)
Szechuen                                      B.S. Goldar 118
2 p.m.                19/5/32                 C.D.Sol.Illum

My name is Tsiang Ming-tsin (蔣明極), native of Yin Yang
Hsian (雲陽), Szechuen. I am aged 58 years and married
to Tsiang Tsang Sze, also a native of Szechuen, who is
at present staying in my native place.
    I first went to School at the age of 8 years, when I
entered a family school in my native place continuing my
education there until the age of 18. At the age of 16 years
I took an examination, passed and became a scholar under
the New-Tai (Foreign Knowledge) system which was introduced
during the Ching Dynasty. I studied under a tutor in my
native place until I was 26 years of age, when I proceeded
to Peking and there took an examination at the 2nd Imperial
Academy. On passing this examination I was selected to
become a civil officer under the Imperial Government. I
remained in Peking for a period of about 6 years altogether
and then was sent to Soochow where I took over the post of
President of the Judicial Yuen. I actually took over the
office in 1910 one year before the revolution. At the
outbreak of the revolution I took up the post of secretary
to Sung Tuh-chuan (程德全) who was that time a "resident
of the Kiangsu Province". I proceeded with him to the
attack on Nanking which took place on 18th day of the 9th
moon 1911. The siege of Nanking lasted about one month
when the holders gave in. With the fall of Nanking I
left the employment of Sung Tuh-chuan and entered the
service of Dr. Sun Yat-sen who had been elected temporary
President and had established his office in Nanking which
pages.zh:
蔣明極 (Tsiang Ming-tsin)
四川                                      B.S. Goldar 118
下午2时                1932年5月19日                 C.D.Sol.Illum

本人名叫蔣明極，籍贯四川云阳县（Yin Yang Hsian）。现年58岁，娶妻蒋张氏（Tsiang Tsang Sze），亦为四川人，目前居住在本人家乡。
    我8岁时首次入学，进入家乡的一所私塾，在那里一直读书到18岁。16岁时，我参加科举考试并及格，成为清朝末年引入的新学（外国知识）体系下的生员。我在家乡跟随一位导师学习，直到26岁，随后前往北京，在第二帝国学院（2nd Imperial Academy，译注：此处原文如此，可能指京师大学堂或相关机构）参加考试。通过考试后，我被选拔为清政府的文官。我在北京总共停留了约6年，随后被派往苏州，接任司法衙门（Judicial Yuen）主管一职。我实际上是在1910年就职的，即革命前一年。革命爆发时，我担任程德全（Sung Tuh-chuan）的秘书，程当时是“江苏都督”。我随他参加了1911年农历九月十八日发生的进攻南京的战斗。南京之围持续了约一个月，守军投降。随着南京陷落，我离开了程德全的麾下，转而效力于当选为临时大总统并在南京（被选为临时首都）设立办公处的孙中山博士。

pages.en:
-2-
city had been chosen as the temporary capital. About one
year after taking office as temporary president Dr, Sun Yat-
sen handed over office to Li Yuan-hung (黎元洪) who had been
selected as the first president and who had established his
government at Peking. With the formation of the new govern-
ment I left the services of Dr. Sun-Yat-sen and went to
Peking, entering the services of Li Yuan-hung as his secre-
tary and Political advisor. When Li Yuan hung completed
his term of office, I entered the service of Yuan ni-kai
(袁世凯) who succeeded him. I remained in the employ of
Yuan Shih-kai (袁世凯) as secretary and political advisor
until his death, at which I took service in the same
capacity with Feng Kuo-tsang (馮國章). Feng's death
occurred about one year after he took office I therefore
entered the services of Hsu tze-tsong, who was the next
president. I did likewise and returned to my native
place in Sz-emen. After being at home for a short period
I re-entered the service of the Republic and took up the
work as adviser to the offices of the ministries of Finance
Education etc. During this period I paid numerous visits
to my native place. I finally left the service of the
government in 1929 when I made my last trip to Peking.
Soon after my resignation I went to Szechuen and remained
there for about two years during which time I prepared
manuscripts for books on politics, economics, philosophy
and law. I completed my work on the books by the end of 1930.
I left Szechuen in April, and proceeded to Nanking at
pages.zh:
-2-
孙中山博士就任临时大总统约一年后，将职位移交给被选为首任总统并在北京建立政府的黎元洪（Li Yuan-hung）。随着新政府的成立，我离开了孙中山博士的服务，前往北京，作为黎元洪的秘书和政治顾问为其效力。当黎元洪任期届满时，我转而效力于继任者袁世凯（Yuan ni-kai / Yuan Shih-kai）。我作为秘书和政治顾问一直受雇于袁世凯，直到他去世，随后我以同样的身份为冯国璋（Feng Kuo-tsang，译注：应为冯国璋或冯国章，原文拼写有误，通常指冯国璋）服务。冯上任约一年后去世，因此我转而效力于下一任总统徐世昌（Hsu tze-tsong，译注：原文拼音对应徐世昌，但汉字未给出，依史实及拼音推断）。我也同样做了，并回到了四川西门（Sz-emen，音译）的家乡。在家短暂停留后，我重新进入民国政府服务，担任财政部、教育部等部委办公室的顾问。在此期间，我多次回到家乡。最终，我在1929年最后一次前往北京后离开了政府服务。辞职后不久，我去了四川，在那里停留了约两年，在此期间撰写了关于政治、经济、哲学和法律的书稿。到1930年底，我完成了这些书籍的编写工作。我于四月离开四川，前往南京，这是应

pages.en:
-3-
the instance of Shih Tsung-loo (    ), Commander of
the 4th Route Army in Kansu to apply to the Nanking Govern-
ment for funds for the 4th Route Army. I went to the
Military Headquarters where I made application to General
Chu Pei-teh (    ), Chief of Staff. The application was
accepted but the funds at the time had not been raised.
Ten days later after my arrival in Nanking I was arrested
by the Nanking Garrison Commander's Headquarters on the
charge of fabricating rumours, starting agitation, and
conducting subversive correspondence in a secret code and
an attempted Coup d'Etat against General Kuo Sze-tung
(    ) of the 20th Army Corps in Hupeh. I was detained
in Headquarters of the Garrison Commander for about 4 months
On my release I took up residence in Nanking, remaining
there for about 1 month, then came to Shanghai arriving
here on November 23, 1931. I took a room in the Far
Eastern Hotel and later moved to the Chai Loh Hotel on Thibet
Road. Later in the month of January I moved to my friend's
house in the Shih Wei Li, No.744, Seymour Road. My friend
Tsang Sze-sung (    ) who resides at this address is
assistant to the Commander of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression
Corps. Tsang told me that I could have a room on the
ground floor of No.744 Shih Wei Li, Seymour Road. Soon
after the start of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai I went to see J. Yamamoto at the Palace Hotel,
Room 128 and asked him to render me some assistance in
getting some of my friends out of the Chapel area.
pages.zh:
-3-
甘肃第四路军指挥官石宗鲁（Shih Tsung-loo，音译）的要求，向南京政府申请第四路军的经费。我前往军事总部，向参谋长朱培德将军（Chu Pei-teh，音译）提出申请。申请被接受，但当时资金尚未筹集到位。抵达南京十天后，我被南京卫戍司令部逮捕，罪名是散布谣言、煽动骚乱、使用密码进行颠覆性通信，以及企图对湖北第二十军郭斯栋将军（Kuo Sze-tung，音译）发动政变。我被关押在卫戍司令部约4个月。获释后，我在南京居住，停留了约1个月，然后来到上海，于1931年11月23日抵达此地。我在远东饭店（Far Eastern Hotel）租了一个房间，后来搬到了西藏路的柴洛饭店（Chai Loh Hotel，音译）。同年一月晚些时候，我搬到了西摩路（Seymour Road）744号施伟里（Shih Wei Li，音译）的朋友家。住在此地址的朋友张嗣松（Tsang Sze-sung，音译）是江苏剿匪指挥部指挥官的助理。张告诉我，我可以住在西摩路744号施伟里的一楼房间。上海中日敌对行动开始后不久，我去华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）128室见了山本（J. Yamamoto），请他协助我将一些朋友从闸北地区转移出来。

pages.en:
-4-
All my dealings with Japanese have been for the same
purpose.
Hitherto I have omitted to state that about 19 years
I was Superintendent in Charge of Chinese students in
Japan and whilst there I made a number of Japanese friends.
pages.zh:
-4-
我与日本人的所有交往都是为了同一目的。
此前我未提及，大约19年前，我曾担任留日中国学生监督，在那里结识了许多日本朋友。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. S. REGISTRY.
No. D 3369
Date 19/3/32

March

Political 8

Arrest of Revolutionaries - plot to overthrow Bureau of
Public Safety and organize a new army

At 4.10 p.m. March 12 members of the Public Safety
Bureau requested assistance from Louza Station to arrest
persons who were using Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great Eastern
Hotel, Kin wo Kan, off Nanking Road as a meeting place
where they were plotting the overthrow of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai. A party
of Municipal Police attended and the following nine persons
were arrested:-

Lee Ming Tscong        {李醒我}
Li Sing-ngoh          {宗我璋}
Soong Suh-tsang       {宋武石}
Chou Tsz-zah          {周子軒}
Chou Xeng-zung        {周正匡}
Iung Ngah-ding        {尹玉亭}
Wong Zoong-zung       {王仲仁}
Sung Ngo-su           {孫玉書}
Tsang Ming-yuen       {張鳴遠}

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appointment
were seized showing the arrested men to belong to
an organization known as the "Headquarters of the South-
Eastern Self Defence Army" (東南自衛軍). At 9.30 p.m.
on the same day Municipal Police with the assistance of
members of the French Police and Hantao Police searched
the home of the 2nd accused Lee Sing-ngoh (李醒我)
at 7 Rue Chapeal and seized a suitcase containing documents
and correspondence and in addition visited the home of the
third accused Soong Suh-tsang (宋武璋) at 26 Sing Ming
Tsung Alleyway, Rue Grenier de Montmoreau where a box
containing documents and correspondence was seized
and the two persons as follows found on the premises taken
into custody:

Soong Fah-dan         {宋柏濤}
Zau Wei-sien          {曹慰先}

(批：Attach file on the case.)
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号 D 3369
日期 1932年3月19日

三月

政治类 8

逮捕革命党人——阴谋推翻公安局并组织新军

3月12日下午4时10分，公安局成员请求老闸捕房协助，逮捕利用南京路金沃馆（Kin wo Kan，音译，疑为金华馆或类似名称）大华饭店29号和34号房间作为集会地点的人员，他们正在策划推翻公安局和大上海市政府。一队市警察前往，以下九人被捕：

李醒我 (Lee Ming Tscong)
宗我璋 (Li Sing-ngoh) [译注：中文名与拼音似有出入，依括号内中文]
宋武石 (Soong Suh-tsang) [译注：前文为宋武璋，此处为宋武石，依原文翻译]
周子軒 (Chou Tsz-zah)
周正匡 (Chou Xeng-zung)
尹玉亭 (Iung Ngah-ding)
王仲仁 (Wong Zoong-zung)
孫玉書 (Sung Ngo-su)
張鳴遠 (Tsang Ming-yuen)

查获了大量文件、印章和委任状，显示被捕人员属于一个名为“东南自卫军总部”的组织。当晚9时30分，市警察在法国警察和南市警察的协助下，搜查了第二被告李醒我（Li Sing-ngoh）位于霞飞路（Rue Chapeal，译注：原文Chapeal疑为Chapelle或类似，通常霞飞路为Avenue Joffre，此处可能指另一条路或原文有误，依音译暂作霞飞路或查佩尔路，但结合上下文及上海地名，Rue Chapeal极可能是Rue Chapelle或其他，此处保留音译或按常见误植处理，鉴于后文有Rue Grenier de Montmoreau，此处Rue Chapeal可能指某具体小路，暂译为查佩尔路或依音译）7号的住所，查获了一个装有文件和信件的公文箱；此外，还探访了第三被告宋武璋（Soong Suh-tsang）位于蒙莫罗路（Rue Grenier de Montmoreau，译注：即蒙马兰路）新民邨26号的住所，查获了一个装有文件和信件的箱子，并将在现场发现的以下两人拘留：

宋柏濤 (Soong Fah-dan)
曹慰先 (Zau Wei-sien)

（批：附上本案档案。）

pages.en:
March 14, 2

Political (9)

The seizure at this address, on examination, however, proved
of no value and had no bearing on the case.

From statements made by the accused it appears
that the Public Safety Bureau and the offices of the various
organs of the municipality of Great Shanghai were to be
occupied by the So th-Eastern Self Defence Army at a certain
time on March 13. The nucleus of this army was to consist of
members of the Public Safety Bureau and the Merchants Volunteer
Army Corps for which assistance $100,000 was to be paid
and 2,000 rifles supplied to the representatives of the
Bureau in question together with an assurance that no
dismissal or change of the present staff of the Public
Safety Bureau would be effected. The new army when formed
would be commanded by General Chou Feng-chi (周鳳岐)
who according to the statement of the first and principal
accused Li Ming-tsong, engineered the plot under the name
of Li Ngoh (李鍔).

General Chou Feng-chi who resides at 146 Rue Pere
Robert is notorious for his treachery against Lu Yung-hsiang
(盧永祥), Tuchun of Chekiang, when he (Lu) was overthrown
by Sun Chuan-fang and against the latter when the Nationalists
entered Chekiang in 1927. For his desertion of Sun Chuan
Fang the Nationalists appointed him commander of the 26th
Army which occupied Chapei and Paoshan in 1927. He held
this post for about six months when his command was given
to General Chen I (陳儀) owing to Chiang Kai-shek's doubt
as to his, Chou's, loyalty. Again in December 1929 Chou
planned a Coup d'Etat in Hangchow but the plot was discovered
pages.zh:
3月14日，2

政治类 (9)

然而，经检查，在该地址查获的物品证明毫无价值，与本案无关。

根据被告的供词，东南自卫军计划在3月13日的某个时刻占领公安局和大上海市各机关办公室。这支军队的核心将由公安局成员和商团义勇军组成，为此将支付10万美元作为援助，并向有关局的代表提供2,000支步枪，同时保证不对公安局现有人员进行解职或变动。新军组建后，将由周凤岐将军（Chou Feng-chi）指挥，据第一主犯李醒我（Li Ming-tsong）供称，该阴谋是以李鍔（Li Ngoh）的名义策划的。

周凤岐将军居住在罗伯特神父路（Rue Pere Robert）146号，他因背叛浙江督军卢永祥（Lu Yung-hsiang）而臭名昭著，当时卢被孙传芳推翻；后来在1927年国民革命军进入浙江时，他又背叛了孙传芳。因其背叛孙传芳，国民革命军任命他为第二十六军军长，该军于1927年占领了闸北和宝山。他担任此职约六个月，由于蒋介石怀疑其忠诚度，他的指挥权被移交给了陈仪将军（Chen I）。再次是在1929年12月，周在杭州策划政变，但阴谋在

pages.en:
March 14, 2

Political (10)

before maturity and Chou was forced to flee.

The statement of the 9th accused, Tsang Ming-yuen
a graduate of the Tokio Military Academy shows him up as
an individual who has lived in political and military
intrigue for the past twenty four years and a very
suitable man to assist in the plot of this kind.

The accused have been charged with Insurrection
Contrary to / t. 103 of the C.C.R.C. and will appear
before Court on March 18 when an application for their
extradition will be made by the Chinese Authorities.
pages.zh:
3月14日，2

政治类 (10)

成熟之前被发现，周被迫逃亡。

第九被告张鸣远（Tsang Ming-yuen）的供词显示，他是东京陆军士官学校毕业生，是一个在过去二十四年中一直生活在政治和军事阴谋中的人，非常适合协助此类阴谋。

被告被指控犯有违反《中华民国刑法》第103条的内乱罪，将于3月18日出庭，届时中国当局将提出引渡申请。

26. I. 32.
Date March 21st 1932

Station Reference No 121. REPORT

Subject (in full) Third further report on the case of Tsiang Ming-Tsih, who
is required by the Bureau of Public Safety as being a rebel.

Made by D.P. Crowden. Forwarded by C. Maguire

Sir.

"Tsiang Ming Tsih", was taken before
the U.S. Court this morning, 21.3.32, at 10am and the judge after
scrutinising the documents and letters, which were siezed during
the raid on the home of the accused, stated that there was no
definite proof in any of them that the accused is guilty of the
charge of being a rebel.

Therefore, after having heard the
evidence of the Bureau of Public Safety, the judge remanded the case
until a.m 23.3.32, to enable the Bureau of Public Safety to prod-
uce before the Court the two prisoners already in their custody
who had implicated the accused.

Before the hearing of the case however
the members of the Bureau of Public Safety in court, asked the
undersigned to withdraw their application for the custody of Tsiang
Ming Tsih as they now had decided that there was insufficient evid-
ence of his guilt. This request was refused and the case presented
as stated above.

The judge ordered the money, documents,
and letters used in the evidence to be taken back to the station
for safe custody until the remanded sitting on 23.3.32

（左侧手写批注：1K 21/3/32 2）

32年1月26日。
日期：1932年3月21日

捕房参考号 121. 报告

主题（全称）关于蒋明枢（Tsiang Ming-Tsih）一案的第三份补充报告，公共安全局因其系反叛分子而要求将其缉拿归案。

由 D.P. Crowden 撰写。由 C. Maguire 转呈

先生。

“蒋明枢”（Tsiang Ming Tsih）于今晨，即1932年3月21日上午10时，被提至美国法院。法官在仔细审查了在搜查被告住所时查获的文件和信件后表示，其中没有任何确凿证据证明被告犯有被指控的反叛罪。

因此，在听取了公共安全局的证词后，法官将案件延期至1932年3月23日上午审理，以便公共安全局向法庭提交目前由其羁押的两名曾牵连被告的囚犯。

然而，在开庭审理之前，出庭的公共安全局成员请求撤回对蒋明枢的羁押申请，因为他们现在决定认为证明其有罪的证据不足。该请求被拒绝，案件按上述情况呈堂。

法官命令将作为证据使用的钱款、文件和信件带回捕房妥善保管，直至1932年3月23日的延期开庭。

（左侧手写批注：1K 32年3月21日 2）
（左下角手写批注：ml 32年3月21日 96.3.32）

D.P. Crowden

Date March 20, 19 32

Subject (in full) Execution of Warrants No.4091 and 4092 issued at the instance
of the Public Safety Bureau

Made by D.S. Golder Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.D.I.

At about 12 noon on March 19th armed with Search
744
Warrant No.4091 in respect of/Shih Wei Li (慈惠里), off
Seymour Road and Warrant of Arrest No.4092 in respect of
Tsiang Ming-tsih (蒋明樞) (of the address designated in the
Search Warrant), both authorities having been issued by the
2nd Branch Kiangsu High Court at the request of the Public
Safety Bureau, a visit was paid to the address aforementioned
by the undersigned, members of the Public Safety Bureau and
detectives of I.D. Bubbling Well Station. Tsiang Ming-
tsih was taken into custody in a downstairs room of 744
Shih Wei Li and a search conducted of the room. In it
were found a large number of letters, the import of which
is at present obscure, $945.00 silver, which was hidden
beneath the bed and for which Tsiang Ming-tsih has so
far not given a proper accounting. The prisoner was
removed to Bubbling Well Station where he was questioned
regarding his activities (Statement attached). Two written
notes in Japanese were found but it is impossible to say to
exactly what they refer.

The money $945 was sealed and handed over to the
Sergeant on Duty, Bubbling Well and a receipt obtained for
same.

The prisoner will appear before the Court tomorrow
March 21st when the Public Safety Bureau will make applica-
tion for his extradition.

D. S. Golder
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Si, Please keep to Information. / attend to W station. / M.G. / D. i/c Sp. Br. / Mar 20 1932）

日期：1932年3月20日

主题（全称）执行应公共安全局请求签发的第4091号和4092号令状

由 D.S. Golder 撰写，由 Henry Robertson, C.D.I. 转呈

3月19日中午12时许，持有关于西摩路（Seymour Road）旁慈惠里（Shih Wei Li）744号的第4091号搜查令，以及关于蒋明枢（Tsiang Ming-tsih）（地址见搜查令指定）的第4092号逮捕令，这两份文件均系江苏高等法院第二分院应公共安全局请求签发，本人会同公共安全局成员及静安寺捕房情报科侦探前往上述地址。蒋明枢在慈惠里744号楼下房间内被拘捕，并对该房间进行了搜查。房内发现大量信件，其含义目前尚不明确；另有银元945.00元，藏于床下，蒋明枢至今未对此作出合理解释。囚犯被带至静安寺捕房，并就其活动接受讯问（附陈述书）。现场发现两张日文便条，但无法确切说明其指代内容。

款项945美元已封存并移交静安寺捕房值班警长，并取得了收据。

囚犯将于明日，即3月21日出庭，届时公共安全局将申请将其引渡。

D. S. Golder
特别科科长。

（批：Si，请保留在情报科。/ 关注W捕房。/ M.G. / 特别科主管 / 1932年3月20日）

REPORT
Station Reference No. 121
Date March 20, 19 32
Subject (in full) Further report on assistance to C. C. L. Authorities
re. arrest of one Tsiang Ling Tsih, wanted as being a rebel.
Made by D. P. S. Crowden Forwarded by
Sir,
Between 10a.m. and 12noon today 20-3-32 Tsiang Ling Tsih
was taken to the Special Branch Headquarters where his statement was
taken by D. S. Golder, copies of which are attached. At the same time
9 letters and two other documents were translated, copies of these
are also attached as they of importance with regard to the allegation
that Tsiang Ling Tsih is implicated as a rebel.
Money in silver dollars to the value of $947.00 seized
at the same time that the suspect was arrested in his rooms on 19th.
March will be taken to the S. S. D. Court tomorrow 21-3-32, together
with the originals of the letters and documents aforementioned.
Representatives of the Bureau of Public Safety will be present in the
Court to apply for the despatch of the suspect.
ml.
S. Crowden
20596

报告
捕房参考号. 121
日期：1932年3月20日
主题（全称）关于协助中国当局逮捕一名因系反叛分子而被通缉的蒋灵芝（Tsiang Ling Tsih）的进一步报告。
由 D. P. S. Crowden 撰写，由 [空白] 转呈
先生，
今日，即1932年3月20日上午10时至中午12时之间，蒋灵芝（Tsiang Ling Tsih）被带至特别科总部，由 D. S. Golder 对其进行了讯问并记录供词，副本附后。同时翻译了9封信件和另外两份文件，这些文件的副本也附后，因为它们对于指控蒋灵芝牵连参与反叛活动至关重要。
3月19日嫌疑人在其房间内被捕时同时查获的价值947.00美元的银元，将于明日，即1932年3月21日，连同上述信件和文件的原件一并提交至特区地方法院。
公共安全局代表将出庭申请移送该嫌疑人。
ml.
S. Crowden
20596

REPORT

Station Reference No. 1218

Subject (in full) Fourth further report on the case of Tsiang Hing Tsih, who
is required by the Bureau of Public Safety as being a rebel.

Made by D.S.I. Widdowson Forwarded by L. Maguire C.I.

（批：FR 24/3/32 7/-）

Sir,
Tsiang Hing Tsih was again taken before the S.S.D. Court
on the 23-3-32 when Judge Voong ordered him to be handed over to the
Staff of the Shanghai Municipality B.P.S. He was handed over
accordingly.
The sum of $945.00 found on the premises where he was arrested, was
ordered to be handed over to one named Yang, a representative of
Mr. Tsang Sse-sung (張樹聲) of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression Corps,
who apparently is the owner of the money.
The bank pass-books likewise seized were handed over to representa-
tives of the Bureau of Public Safety.
It is understood that the Judge told Mr. Wong the Asst. M.A. that
the B.P.S. official who attended Court at the last hearing, on the
21-3-32, reported to his superiors that Tsiang Hing Tsih had been
released, the Judge had received a telegram from Nanking asking the
reason why.

Copy for A.S. (Special Branch) Widdowson.
D.S.I.

报告

捕房参考号. 1218

主题（全称）关于蒋兴志（Tsiang Hing Tsih）一案的第四份补充报告，公共安全局因其系反叛分子而要求将其缉拿归案。

由 D.S.I. Widdowson 撰写，由 L. Maguire C.I. 转呈

（批：FR 32年3月24日 7/-）

先生，
蒋兴志（Tsiang Hing Tsih）于1932年3月23日再次被提至特区地方法院，Voong 法官命令将其移交给上海市公安局（B.P.S.）人员。随后已按规定移交。
在其被捕地点查获的945.00美元款项，奉命移交给一位姓杨的人，此人是江苏剿匪总队张树声（Tsang Sse-sung）先生的代表，此人显然是这笔钱的所有者。
同样被查获的银行存折已移交给公共安全局代表。
据悉，法官告诉助理法医 Wong 先生，出席3月21日上次庭审的公共安全局官员向其上级报告称蒋兴志已被释放，法官因此收到来自南京的电报，询问原因。

抄送特别科助理 S. (Special Branch) Widdowson.
D.S.I.

S. l. Station,
Date March 21, 19 32.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Re Attached.

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Henry Courtenay, esq.

I submit herewith for your informations copies
of translations of papers found at No.744 Sze Wei Li,
Seymour Road at 12 noon March 19th, when Tsiang Ming Jih
(蒋明杰), for whom a warrant had been issued, was arrest-
ed. The Public Safety Bureau allege that Tsiang Ming
Jih is connected with the case in which a number of arrests
were made in Louza District on Saturday, March 12.
The documents found in his possession do not
prove a clear case against him and as the Chinese Authorities
will make application for his extradition I have therefore
forwarded
the attached so that you might be placed in full possession
the facts of the case.

D. S. Golder
Commissioner of Police,
S.M.P.

Officer i/c Special Branch

（批：As Tsiang is not a bona fide resident of the Settlement, I shall if consulted tell the Mun. Advocate that the Police have no special reason for objecting to his being handed over to the Chinese authorities. Some of the attached papers are interesting.
W. Everson O. i/c Sp. Br.）

报告

主题（全称）关于附件。

由 D. S. Golder 撰写，由 Henry Courtenay 先生转呈

现随函附上1932年3月19日中午12时在西摩路慈惠里（Sze Wei Li）744号查获文件的译文副本，供阁下知悉。当时持有令状通缉的蒋明杰（Tsiang Ming Jih）被捕。公共安全局指控蒋明杰与3月12日星期六在老闸区发生的多起逮捕案件有关。
在他身上发现的文件并不能构成针对他的明确案件，鉴于中国当局将申请将其引渡，因此我转呈
附件，以便阁下全面掌握本案事实。

D. S. Golder
警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

特别科科长

（批：由于蒋并非租界的合法居民，若被咨询，我将告知市公署律师，警方没有特别理由反对将其移交给中国当局。部分附件文件颇有意思。
W. Everson 特别科主管）

（左侧手写批注：收到 3月21日 3月29日）

pages.en:
Tsiang Ming-tsih (蔣明柱)
Szechuen                                      D.S.Golder 118
2 p.m.                19/3/32                 C.D.S.I.Huang

My name is Tsiang King-tsih (蔣明柱), native of Yin Yang
Hsian (雲陽), Szechuen. I am aged 58 years and married
to Tsiang Tsang Sse, also a native of Szechuen, who is
at present staying in my native place.
    I first went to School at the age of 8 years, when I
entered a family school in my native place continuing my
education there until the age of 18. At the age of 18 years
I took an examination, passed and became a scholar under
the Seu-Zai (Foreign Knowledge) system which was introduced
during the Ching Dynasty. I studied under a tutor in my
native place until I was 28 years of age, when I proceeded
to Peking and there took an examination at the 2nd Imperial
Academy. On passing this examination I was selected to
become a civil officer under the Imperial Government. I
remained in Peking for a period of about 6 years altogether
and then was sent to Soochow where I took over the post of
President of the Judicial Yuan. I actually took over the
office in 1910 one year before the revolution. At the
outbreak of the revolution I took up the post of secretary
to Sung Teh-chuan (程德全) who was that time a "President
of the Kiangsu Province". I proceeded with him to the
attack on Nanking which took place on 18th day of the 8th
moon 1911. The siege of Nanking lasted about one month
when the holders gave in. With the fall of Nanking I
left the employment of Sung Teh-chuan and entered the
service of Dr. Sun Yat-sen who had been elected temporary
President and had established his office in Nanking which
pages.zh:
蒋明柱 (Tsiang Ming-tsih)
四川                                      D.S.Golder 118
下午2时                1932年3月19日                 C.D.S.I.Huang

本人名为蒋明柱 (Tsiang King-tsih)，籍贯四川云阳县 (Yin Yang Hsian)。现年58岁，已婚，妻子为蒋藏氏 (Tsiang Tsang Sse)，亦系四川人，目前居住在本人原籍。
    本人8岁开始入学，在家乡入私塾读书，直至18岁。18岁时参加科举考试，及格后成为清朝引入的“西学” (Seu-Zai，即外国知识) 体系下的生员。本人在家乡跟随导师学习至28岁，随后前往北京，在第二高等学堂参加考试。通过该考试后，被选拔为清政府文官。本人在北京总共停留约6年，随后被派往苏州，接任司法院院长一职。本人实际上于1910年就职，即革命前一年。革命爆发时，本人担任程德全 (Sung Teh-chuan) 的秘书，程当时任“江苏省都督”。本人随他参加1911年农历八月十八日发生的南京攻坚战。南京围城战持续约一个月，守军投降。随着南京陷落，本人离开程德全麾下，投效当选为临时大总统并在南京（被选为临时首都）设立办公处的孙中山博士。

sen handed over office to Li Yuan-hung (黎元洪) who had been

until his death, at which I took service in the same
capacity with Feng Kuo-tsang (馮國璋). Feng's death
occurred about one year after he took office I therefore
entered the services of Hsu Shih-tsang, who was the next
after being in office 2 years Hsu Shih-tsang resigned
president. I did likewise and returned to my native
place in Szechuen. After being at home for a short period
I re-entered the service of the Republic and took up the
work as advisor to the offices of the ministries of finance
Education etc. During this period I paid numerous visits
to my native place. I finally left the service of the
government in 1929 when I made my last trip to Peking.
Soon after my resignation I went to Szechuen and remained
there for about two years during which time I prepared
manuscripts for books on politics, economics, philosophy
and law. I completed my work on the books by the end of 1930.
I left Szechuen in April, and proceeded to Nanking as

孙中山博士就任临时大总统约一年后，将职位移交给被选为首任总统并在北京建立政府的黎元洪 (Li Yuan-hung)。随着新政府的成立，本人离开孙中山博士麾下，前往北京，作为秘书和政治顾问投效黎元洪。当黎元洪任期届满后，本人投效继任者袁世凯 (Yuan Shih-kai)。本人一直担任袁世凯的秘书和政治顾问，直至其去世，随后以同样身份受雇于冯国璋 (Feng Kuo-tsang)。冯国璋就职约一年后去世，因此本人转投徐世昌麾下。徐世昌就职两年后辞去总统职务。本人亦随之辞职，返回四川原籍。在家短暂停留后，本人重新效力于民国政府，担任财政部、教育部等部委的顾问。在此期间，本人多次返回原籍。本人最终于1929年最后一次前往北京后辞去政府职务。辞职后不久，本人前往四川，在那里停留约两年，期间撰写了关于政治、经济、哲学和法律的书稿。本人于1930年底完成著书工作。
本人于四月离开四川，应甘肃第四路军指挥官史宗鲁 (Shih Tsung-loo) 之邀，前往南京

pages.en:
-3-
the instance of Shih Tsung-loo (史宗魯), Commander of
the 4th Route Army in Kansu to apply to the Nanking Govern-
ment for funds for the 4th Route Army. I went to the
Military Headquarters where I made application to General
Chu Pei-teh (朱培德), Chief of Staff. The application was
accepted but the funds at the time had not been raised.
Ten days later after my arrival in Nanking I was arrested
by the Nanking Garrison Commander's Headquarters on the
charge of fabricating rumours, starting agitation, and
conducting subversive correspondence in a secret code and
an attempted Coup d'Etat against General Hsueh Yueh-tung
(薛岳棟) of the 20th Army Corps in Hupeh. I was detained
in headquarters of the Garrison Commander for about 4 months
On my release I took up residence in Nanking, remaining
there for about 1 month, then came to Shanghai arriving
here on November 23, 1931. I took a room in the Far
Eastern Hotel and later moved to the Goei Loh Hotel on Thibet
Road. Later in the month of January I moved to my friend's
house in the Chih Wei Li, No.744, Seymour Road. My friend
Tsang Tse-syng (張樹声) who resides at this address is
assistant to the Commander of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression
Corps. Tsang told me that I could have a room on the
ground floor of no.744 Chih Wei Li, Seymour Road. Soon
after the start of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities in
Shanghai I went to see U. Yamamoto at the Palace Hotel,
Room 129 and asked him to render me some assistance in
getting some of my friends out of the Chapel area.
pages.zh:
-3-
向南京政府申请第四路军经费。本人前往军事总部，向参谋长朱培德 (Chu Pei-teh) 将军提出申请。申请虽被接受，但当时款项尚未筹集。抵达南京十天后，本人被南京卫戍司令部逮捕，罪名是制造谣言、煽动闹事、使用密码进行颠覆性通信，以及企图对驻湖北的第二十军薛岳栋 (Hsueh Yueh-tung) 将军发动政变。本人被拘押在卫戍司令总部约4个月。获释后，本人在南京居住，停留约1个月，随后来到上海，于1931年11月23日抵达此地。本人先在远东饭店租了一间房，后搬至西藏路的戈威洛酒店 (Goei Loh Hotel)。同年一月下旬，本人搬至西摩路744号慈惠里朋友家中。住在此地址的朋友张树声 (Tsang Tse-syng) 是江苏剿匪指挥部指挥官的助理。张树声告诉本人，可以使用西摩路744号慈惠里底楼的一间房。上海中日敌对行动开始后不久，本人前往华懋饭店129室会见山本 (U. Yamamoto)，请他协助将本人的一些朋友从闸北地区撤出。

Translation of document seized during a raid on
the home of Tsiang Mingjih, 744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road at 12 noon March 19, 1932.

---

Ming,

I am very glad to hear that Tsou Sung will
proceed to Hupeh and I hold the following opinion :

1. As the matter according to Sun Ah-deu (? Sun Fo)
will be announced at a time when everything had
been properly arranged and it is believed that the
"Straw Head General" (Chiang Kai-shek) will not
meddle with it. Will you advise Tsing not to
worry any more. He (? Tsou Sung)) will go to
Nanking to exert all his energy to assist in
accomplishing the matter.

2. As regard Mo Nghi's (Feng) case, the official
circle exerts every effort to prove that it is
groundless. Have you heard any evidence regarding
the same?

3. As there is assistance from the Interior, the
situation will not be affected and as the
influence of the bandits will be intensified during the
present national crisis in Hupeh, it is very needful
to have a stable commander. The present unsettled
situation will profit a wise person who can pick up
an excellent chance through it.

(Sd.) Han Ts-ching

---

Envelope: Chiang Kai.,
Mingjih
c/o 744 Shih Wei Li, Seymour Road.

Awaiting reply. From Zing Ming.

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明极 (Tsiang Mingjih) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

---

明：

获悉邹松 (Tsou Sung) 将前往湖北，甚感欣慰，本人持有以下意见：

1. 据孙阿斗 (? 孙科 Sun Fo) 称，此事将在一切安排妥当后公布，相信“草头将军” (蒋介石) 不会插手。请劝告青 (Tsing) 不必再担忧。他 (? 邹松) 将前往南京，竭尽全力协助促成此事。

2. 关于莫疑 (Mo Nghi，即冯) 一案，官方圈子正竭力证明其毫无根据。你是否听到有关此事的任何证据？

3. 由于有内部援助，局势不会受到影响；鉴于当前国家危机期间湖北匪患影响加剧，非常需要一位稳定的指挥官。目前的动荡局势有利于智者从中捕捉绝佳机会。

(签名) 韩佐清 (Han Ts-ching)

---

信封：蒋介.,
明极
转交 西摩路慈惠里744号。

等候回复。来自青明 (Zing Ming)。

Translation of document seized during a raid on
the home of Tsiang Ming-chih, 844 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road, at 12 noon, March 19, 1932.

---

December 31
Mr. Ming Jih,

My friend Liu Ching-san's men have
about 5,000 rifles and are at present distributed
on the border of Kiangsu and Shantung. I request
you to try to find some one in Shanghai to collect
them and organize them, whereby we can make a
fundamental force out of them with a view to
completing the Chinese Revolution. It will be
best to have a discussion with your Assistant.
Hoping that you will favour me with a reply,

Yours faithfully,

Chang Chi-ming.

P.S. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen appointed Liu as Commander
of the 11th Army. During the Northern Punitive
Drive, he was appointed by Chiang as Commander-
in-Chief of the Kiao Tung People Group and at
present acts as Major General Military Adviser.
Li Chi-sen is at present Director of Military
Training; have you any connection with him and
can you introduce me to him?

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里844号蒋明之 (Tsiang Ming-chih) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

---

12月31日
明极先生：

我的朋友刘景三 (Liu Ching-san) 的部下拥有约5,000支步枪，目前分布在江苏和山东边境。请你尝试在上海找人收集并整编这些武器，以便我们将他们组建为一支基本力量，以完成中国革命。最好与你的助理商议。
盼复，

此致
敬礼，

张济明 (Chang Chi-ming)。

附言：1924年，孙中山任命刘为第十一军军长。在北伐期间，他被蒋介石任命为胶东人民集团总指挥，目前担任少将军事顾问。李济深 (Li Chi-sen) 目前担任军事训练总监；你与他是否有联系，能否将我引荐给他？

Translation of document seized during a raid on the
home of Tsiang Ming-chih (蔣明極), 744 Shih Wei
Li, Seymour Road, at 12 noon, March 19, 1932.

--

December 21,

Minister Shigemitsu,

I beg to inform you that I arrived
in Shanghai yesterday and would like to have an interview
with you. If you have time, I shall come to you and
have a hearty talk with you. Besides I have some
important affairs to discuss with you.

Yours faithfully,
Sd. Chiang Zu-lih
(alias Ming Jih)

P.S. I appreciate your introduction to me last year
of Consul Shang Tsuan (上村) who had several
negotiations with me which resulted in satisfaction.
I met brethren Pai Kong (北岡), Dien Chung (田中),
Chung Tsing (村井) yesterday. I told them to
convey the matter to you and I believe that they have
dealt it with you already. I hope that you will appoint
a date for an interview.

(Note: The last three names mentioned in P.S. are
all Japanese).

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明极 (Tsiang Ming-chih，原文注：蔣明極) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

--

12月21日，

重光公使阁下：

谨告知阁下，本人昨日抵达上海，希望能与阁下会面。若阁下有暇，本人将登门拜访，与阁下畅谈。此外，本人还有一些重要事务需与阁下商讨。

此致
敬礼，
签名：蒋祖礼 (Chiang Zu-lih)
(别名：明极 Ming Jih)

附言：感谢阁下去年将我引荐给上村 (Shang Tsuan) 领事，他与本人进行了数次谈判，结果令人满意。本人昨日会见了北冈 (Pai Kong)、田中 (Dien Chung)、村井 (Chung Tsing) 诸位同仁。本人已托他们将此事转达给阁下，相信他们已与阁下接洽。希望阁下能约定会面日期。

(注：附言中提到的最后三个名字均为日本人)。

The following is the translation of a letter
addressed by Shigemitsu to Tsiang Ming-chih dated
December 24:-

December 24,
Office of the Japanese
Minister to China.

Mr. Min Tsih,

Your letter has been duly received and
perused. Your arrival in Shanghai this time makes
me very willing to see you and have a talk with you,
which, however, is made impossible owing to my present
engagement, official and private. Should you have
anything to do, please kindly interview Advisor Ling
Tsuh (林出) and have dealings with him.
Excise me.

Yours faithfully,
Shigemitsu
(Minister to China).

------

Translation of the envelop :-

From Shigemitsu

Mr. Tsiang Ming-tsih,
c/o Chang Residence
744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road.

........

February 18.

Commander-in-Chief Uyeda,

It is three years since we saw you last;
have you an idea about the hearty talk and joking beside
the sea among us and Chuen Be (南池) (Chief of Staff),
San Ya (三野) (Staff Officer), Chih Dien (吉田 )
(Interpreter and Adviser), when you were in command at
Tientsin and Taku. This time you came to Shanghai and
I too owing to some important affairs have arrived here.
I originally intended to have an interview with you,
but am not in position to do so due to my present
engagement. Therefore I have to write to you to
offer my good wishes. I am at present engaged in
the peace movement; you can get important particulars
from Dien Chung (田中 ), Fei Kong (北岡 ) Chun Tsing
(村井 ), and Kiang Gee (江崎 ) (all names of
Japanese).

As regards whether there is hope for peace and
other measures, please tell me through Brother Dian
Chung (田中 )

Yours faithfully,
Have an attached card.

P.S. The intimate friendship between the two nations
should be based on the people. Your Army is
famous for its civility; I hope that it will
not treat the people in a brutal manner, but will
be merciful towards them.

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路（Seymour Road）慈惠里744号蒋明极（Tsiang Ming-chih）寓所突袭行动中查获文件的译文。

........

2月18日。

植田（Uyeda）司令官阁下：

自上次拜别，已历三载；不知阁下是否还记得，当您在天津和大沽指挥期间，我们与您以及南池（Chuen Be）（参谋长）、三野（San Ya）（参谋）、吉田（Chih Dien）（翻译兼顾问）在海边畅谈欢谑的情景。此次您来到上海，我也因要务在身抵达此地。我原本打算拜访您，但因目前事务缠身，无法成行。因此特致函向您致以问候。我目前从事和平运动；您可以从田中（Dien Chung）、北冈（Fei Kong）、村井（Chun Tsing）和江崎（Kiang Gee）（均为日本人姓名）处获悉重要详情。

关于和平是否有望及其他措施，请通过田中（Dian Chung）兄告知我。

此致
敬礼
附名片一张。

又及：两国之亲密友谊应建立在民众基础之上。贵军以文明著称；我希望贵军不要粗暴对待民众，而应对他们施以仁慈。

Brother Hung.

We have not corresponded to each other

ised with a little success. Certain Manager

1932年3月19日中午，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明日（Tsiang Ming -jih）寓所突袭行动中发现的文件译文。

2月11日。

洪兄：

我们许久未通信了。我们的“公司”组织已取得少许成功。某经理（18 Ts）密电码。已离开此处前往天津。你为何不与麦兄一同前往天津，或许不难了解时局状况。也许我不久后将北上，以便安排我们之间的会议。由于此处正在开设分部，有可能我们会请你南下。随信附上给麦兄的便条。

此致
敬礼

明。

又及：“公司”的组织情况很好，但暂时不要招募其他人。你在天津时，可寻找汉莫（Han Moh）（段高赛派系）的那些熟人，你会得到帮助。

Translation of a document found during a raid on
the home of Tsang Ming-jih. No 744 Shih Wei Li
Seymour Road at noon on March 19th 1932.

February 11th.

Brother Mei Pah.

Our company has achieved some success
A certain manager has returned to Tientsin from
Shanghai. Why do not go to Tientsin with Brother
Min (小民) and maybe there is some meaning there.

Yours Faithfully

Min.

1932年3月19日中午，在西摩路慈惠里744号曾明日（Tsang Ming-jih）寓所突袭行动中发现的文件译文。

2月11日。

梅巴（Mei Pah）兄：

我们的“公司”已取得一些成功。某经理已从上海返回天津。你为何不与民兄（小民）一同前往天津，或许其中另有深意。

此致
敬礼

民。

Translation of a document found during a raid on the
the home of Tsiang Ming Jih, No.744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road at noon on March 19th, 1932.

Kuo, Commander of the 26th Division of the National Army,
According to the No.204 letter of the Garrison
Commander's Headquarters'of Hankow, during the inspection
of postal matters they discovered a Japanese telegram
entitled "Telegram from the Song Dau (Japanese) Consul-
General at Tientsin to the Acting Consul-General Shigimitsu
of Shanghai" in company with a paper written according to
a secret code in a roll of mosquito paper sent to Tsiang
Ming Jih, Sing Hwa Hotel, Nanking, from Hankow and that
these documents are fabricating rumours, starting agitation
communicating under a secret code and of a rebellious character
and we are requested to arrest the person in order to
prevent possible embarassment. In accordance with this
we have arrested one Tsiang Ming Jih and seized a number
of documents of a rebellious nature including several
letters from Chiang Soo, 43 Yung Tsing Tsung Road, Hankow,
to Tsiang Ming Jih, and Ling Ching Dai, in connection
with a proposed coup d'etat against Kuo. Accordingly
we replied Au (夏), the Garrison Commander of Hankow
by telegram and requested him to arrest the accomplice.
In answer to this we were later informed by the afore-
mentioned Authorities that one Chiang Soo had been arrest-
ed, who stated that he is engaged as an advisor of the
26th Division and undertook the activities of overthrow-
ing Kuo and they also asked if itis all right to send
these accused Tsiang Ming Jih and Chiang Soo to your
Division for investigation. Regarding this we would
like to get a reply from you.
Attached herewith is a copy of the original letter
from the Garrison Commander's Headquarters, the Japanese
telegram with translation and three letters written by
Chiang S...

1932年3月19日中午，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明日（Tsiang Ming Jih）寓所突袭行动中发现的文件译文。

致国民革命军第二十六师师长郭：

据汉口卫戍司令部第204号函称，在检查邮政事务期间，他们发现一卷寄往南京新华饭店蒋明日的蚊香纸中，夹有一份题为“驻天津日本总领事松道（Song Dau）（日本人）致上海代理总领事重光（Shigimitsu）的电报”的日本电报，以及一份用密码书写的文件，这些文件制造谣言、煽动骚乱、使用密码通讯，具有叛乱性质，并要求逮捕该人以防止可能发生的麻烦。据此，我们逮捕了蒋明日一人，并查获若干具有叛乱性质的文件，包括汉口永清宗路43号的蒋苏（Chiang Soo）写给蒋明日和凌清岱（Ling Ching Dai）的几封信件，内容涉及策划推翻郭的政变。因此，我们致电汉口卫戍司令夏（Au），请求其逮捕同伙。对此，上述当局后来回复称，蒋苏已被捕，他声称自己受聘为第二十六师顾问，并承担了推翻郭的活动；他们还询问是否可以将被告蒋明日和蒋苏送至贵师进行调查。关于此事，我们希望得到您的答复。
随函附上卫戍司令部原函副本、日本电报及其译文，以及蒋苏...所写的三封信件。

pages.en:
Tsiang Ming-tsih (蒋明柱)
Szechnen                                J.S.Golder 118
2 p.m.              19/3/32             C.D.S.I.Huang

My name is Tsiang Ming-tsih (蒋明柱), native of Yin Yang
Hsian (雲陽), Szechuan. I am aged 56 years and married
to Tsiang Tsang Sze, also a native of Szechuen, who is
at present staying in my native place.
    I first went to School at the age of 8 years, when I
entered a family school in my native place continuing my
education there until the age of 18. At the age of 18 years
I took an examination, passed and became a scholar under
the Seu-Zai (Foreign Knowledge) system which was introduced
during the Ching Dynasty. I studied under a tutor in my
native place until I was 20 years of age, when I proceeded
to Peking and there took an examination at the 2nd Imperial
Academy. On passing this examination I was selected to
become a civil officer under the Imperial Government. I
remained in Peking for a period of about 6 years altogether
and then was sent to Soochow where I took over the post of
President of the Judicial Yuan. I actually took over the
office in 1910 one year before the revolution. At the
outbreak of the revolution I took up the post of secretary
to Sung Teh-chuan (程德全) who was that time a "President
of the Kiangsu Province". I proceeded with him to the
attack on Nanking which took place on 18th day of the 8th
moon 1911. The siege of Nanking lasted about one month
when the holders gave in. With the fall of Nanking I
left the employment of Sung Teh-chuan and entered the
service of Dr. Sun Yat-sen who had been elected temporary
President and had established his office in Nanking which
pages.zh:
蒋明柱（Tsiang Ming-tsih）
四川                                J.S.Golder 118
下午2时              1932年3月19日             C.D.S.I.黄

我叫蒋明柱，四川云阳县（Yin Yang Hsian）人。现年56岁，已婚，妻子蒋藏氏（Tsiang Tsang Sze）亦为四川人，目前居住在家乡。
    我8岁开始上学，进入家乡的家塾读书，一直读到18岁。18岁时参加考试，及格后成为清朝引入的“西学”（Seu-Zai，即外国知识）体系下的生员。我在家乡跟随导师学习至20岁，随后前往北京，在那里参加了第二帝国学院（Imperial Academy）的考试。通过该考试后，我被选为清政府的文官。我在北京总共停留了约6年，然后被派往苏州，接任司法院院长一职。我实际上是在1910年就职的，即革命前一年。革命爆发时，我担任程德全（Sung Teh-chuan）的秘书，程当时是“江苏省总统”。我随他参加了1911年农历八月十八日对南京的进攻。南京围城战持续了约一个月，守军投降。随着南京陷落，我离开了程德全的幕府，进入当选为临时大总统并在南京（被选为临时首都）设立办公处的孙中山博士麾下服务，该

pages.en:
-2-
city had been chosen as the temporary capital. About one
year after taking office as temporary president Dr. Sun Yat-
sen handed over office to Li Yuan-hung (黎元洪) who had been
selected as the first President and who had established his
government at Peking. With the formation of the new govern-
ment I left the services of Dr. Sun-Yat-sen and went to
Peking, entering the services of Li Yuan-hung as his secre-
tary and political advisor. When Li Yuan-hung completed
his term of office, I entered the service of Yuan Shih-kai
(袁世凯) who succeeded him. I remained in the employ of
Yuan Shih-kai (袁世凯) as secretary and political advisor
until his death, at which I took service in the same
capacity with Feng Kuo-chang (馮國璋). Feng's death
occurred about one year after he took office I therefore
entered the service of Hsu Shih-chang, who was the next
After being in office 2 years Hsu Shih-chang resigned
president. I did likewise and returned to my native
place in Szechwan. After being at home for a short period
I re-entered the service of the Republic and took up the
work as adviser to the offices of the Ministries of Finance
Education etc. During this period I paid numerous visits
to my native place. I finally left the service of the
government in 1929 when I made my last trip to Peking.
Soon after my resignation I went to Szechwan and remained
there for about two years during which time I prepared
manuscripts for books on politics, economics, philosophy
and law. I completed my work on the basis of the end of 1930.
I left Szechwan in April, and proceeded to Nanking at
pages.zh:
-2-
城市被选为临时首都。孙中山博士就任临时大总统约一年后，将职位移交给被选为首任总统并在北京建立政府的黎元洪（Li Yuan-hung）。随着新政府的成立，我离开了孙中山博士的服务，前往北京，作为秘书和政治顾问进入黎元洪的幕府。当黎元洪任期届满时，我进入继任者袁世凯（Yuan Shih-kai）的幕府。我一直担任袁世凯的秘书和政治顾问直至其去世，随后我以同样的身份服务于冯国璋（Feng Kuo-chang）。冯国璋就职约一年后去世，因此我进入下一任总统徐世昌（Hsu Shih-chang）的幕府。徐世昌任职2年后辞职。我也同样辞职，回到四川家乡。在家短暂停留后，我重新进入民国政府服务，担任财政部、教育部等部的顾问。在此期间，我多次返回家乡。最终，我在1929年最后一次前往北京后离开了政府服务。辞职后不久，我前往四川，在那里停留了约两年，期间撰写了有关政治、经济、哲学和法律的书稿。我在1930年底完成了这项工作。我于4月离开四川，前往南京，在

pages.en:
-3-
the instance of Shih Tsung-loo (史宗魯), commander of
the 4th Route Army in Kansu to apply to the Nanking govern-
ment for funds for the 4th Route Army. I went to the
military headquarters where I made application to General
Chu Pei-teh (朱培德), Chief of Staff. The application was
rejected as the funds at the time had not been raised.
Ten days later after my arrival in Nanking I was arrested
by the Nanking Garrison Commander's Headquarters on the
charge of fabricating rumours, starting agitation, and
conducting subversive correspondence in a secret code and
an attempted Coup d'Etat against General Kuo Ju-tung
(郭汝棟) of the 20th Army Corps in Szech. I was detained
in Headquarters of the Garrison Commander for about 4 months
On my release I took up residence in Nanking, remaining
there for about 2 months, then came to Shanghai arriving
here on November 25, 1931. I took a room in the Far
Eastern Hotel and later moved to the Central Hotel on Bhoot
Road. Later in the month of January I moved to my friend's
house in the Shih Wei Li, No.744, Seymour Road. My friend
Tseng Mo-sung (張樹聲) who resides at this address is
assistant to the Commander of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression
Corps. Tseng told me that I could have a room on the
ground floor of No.744 Shih Wei Li, Seymour Road. Soon
after the start of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai I went to see D. Yamamoto at the Palace Hotel,
Room 136 and asked him to render me some assistance in
getting some of my friends out of the Chapei area.
pages.zh:
-3-
应甘肃第四路军指挥官史宗魯（Shih Tsung-loo）之请，向南京政府申请第四路军经费。我前往军事总部，向参谋长朱培德（Chu Pei-teh）将军提出申请。该申请被驳回，理由是当时款项尚未筹集到位。

抵达南京十天后，我被南京卫戍司令部逮捕，罪名是制造谣言、煽动闹事、使用密码进行颠覆性通信，以及企图对驻四川的第二十军军长郭汝棟（Kuo Ju-tung）将军发动政变。我在卫戍司令部总部被拘留约四个月。获释后，我寓居南京，停留约两个月，随后前往上海，于1931年11月25日抵达此地。我先在远东饭店（Far Eastern Hotel）租了一间房，后来搬至蒲石路（Bhoot Road）的中汇大楼（Central Hotel）。同年一月下旬，我搬至西摩路744号施伟里（Shih Wei Li）的朋友家中。住在此址的朋友张树声（Tseng Mo-sung）是江苏剿匪指挥部指挥官的助理。张树声告诉我，我可以住在西摩路744号施伟里的一楼房间。上海中日战事爆发后不久，我去皇宫饭店（Palace Hotel）136室拜访了山本（D. Yamamoto），请他协助我将一些朋友从闸北地区撤出。

pages.en:
-4-
All my dealings with Japanese have been for the same
purpose.
Hitherto I have omitted to state that about 19 years
I was superintendent in charge of Chinese students in
Japan and whilst there I made a number of Japanese friends.
pages.zh:
-4-
我与日本人的所有交往均出于同一目的。
此前我未提及，大约19年前，我曾担任留日中国学生监督，在此期间结识了许多日本朋友。

Kue, Commander of the 26th Division of the National Army,
According to the No.204 letter of the Garrison
Commander's Headquarters'of Hankow, during the inspection
of postal matters they discovered a Japanese telegram
entitled "Telegram from the Song Dau (Japanese) Consul-
General at Tientsin to the Acting Consul-General Shigimitsu
of Shanghai" in company with a paper written according to
a secret code in a roll of mosquito paper sent to Tsiang
溪 桥
Ming Jih, Sing Hwa Hotel, Nanking, from Hankow and that
these documents are fabricating rumours, starting agitation
code
communicating under a secret/and of a rebellious character
and we are requested to arrest the person in order to
prevent possible embarrassment. In accordance with this
we have arrested one Tsiang Ming Jih and seized a number
of documents of a rebellious nature including several
蒋 李 永 靖 正 鸿
letters from Chiang Soo, 43 Yung Tsing Tsung Road, Hankow,
林 镜 台
to Tsiang Ming Jih, and Ling Ching Dai, in connection
with a proposed coup d'etat against Kue. Accordingly
we replied An (夏), the Garrison Commander of Hankow
by telegram and requested him to arrest the accomplice.
In answer to this we were later informed by the afore-
mentioned Authorities that one Chiang Soo had been arrest-
ed, who stated that he is engaged as an officer of the
26th Division and undertook the activities of overthrow-
ing Kue and they also asked if itis all right to send
these accused Tsiang Ming Jih and Chiang Soo to your
Division for investigation. Regarding this we would
like to get a reply from you.

Attached herewith is a copy of the original letter
from the Garrison Commander's Headquarters, the Japanese
telegram with translation and three letters written by
Chiang Soo.

Shig Wei Li, Seymour Road at noon on March 19th
1932.

Februaru 11.

Brother Hung.

We have not corresponded to each other
for a long time . Our company has been organ-
ised with a little success. Certain Manager
(18 Ts ) Secret Code. has left here for Tientsin.
Why do you not go to Tientsin with Brother Mai,
possibility it would not be difficult to know the
time state. Maybe I shall go to the North in the
near future with a view to arranging a conference
among us. As a branch is opening here it is
possible that we shall ask you to come south .
Attached herewith is a note for Brother Mai.

Yours Faithfully

Ming.

P.S. The organisation of the company is very good
but for the present do not ask for other men
When you are in Tientsin look for those
acquaintances of the Kan Moh ( Tuan Gee-sai
clique and you will receive help.

2月11日。

洪兄：

我们已久未通信。本公司组织已初见成效。某经理（18 Ts，密码）已离此前往天津。你为何不与麦兄一同前往天津？届时了解时局状况或许并非难事。近期我或许会北上，以便安排我们之间的会议。由于此处正在开设分部，我们可能会请你南下。随函附上给麦兄的便条。

此致
敬礼

明

附言：公司组织状况良好，但暂时不要招募其他人。你在天津时，请寻找干莫（Kan Moh，音译，即段祺瑞派系）的那些熟人，你会得到帮助。

(学惠里), Seymour Road, at 12 noon March 19, 1932.

........

February 18.

Commander-in-Chief Uyeda,

It is three years since we saw you last;
have you an idea about the hearty talk and joking beside
the sea among us and Chuen Jee (南池) (Chief of Staff),
San Ya (三野) (Staff Officer), Chih Dien (吉田 )
(Interpreter and Advisor), when you were in command at
Tientsin and Taku. This time you came to Shanghai and
I too owing to some important affairs have arrived here.
I originally intended to have an interview with you,
but am not in position to do so due to my present
engagement. Therefore I have to write to you to
offer my good wishes. I am at present engaged in
the peace movement; you can get important particulars
from Dien Chung (田中 ), Pei Keng (北岡) Chun Tsing
(村井 ), and Kiang Gee (江崎) (all names of
Japanese).

As regards whether there is hope for peace and
other measures, please tell me through Brother Dien
Chung (田中 )

Yours faithfully,
Name on attached card.

P.S. The intimate friendship between the two nations
should be based on the people. Your Army is
famous for its civility; I hope that it will
not treat the people in a brutal manner, but will
be merciful towards them.
pages.zh:

........

2月18日。

植田司令官阁下：

自上次拜别，已历三载；不知阁下是否还记得，当阁下在天津及大沽指挥期间，我们与您以及南池（Chuen Jee，参谋长）、三野（San Ya，参谋）、吉田（Chih Dien，翻译兼顾问）在海边畅谈欢笑的情景。此次阁下莅临上海，鄙人亦因要事抵沪。原本打算拜访阁下，但因目前事务缠身，未能如愿。故此致函，以表问候。鄙人目前正致力于和平运动；有关详情，可向田中（Dien Chung）、北岡（Pei Keng）、村井（Chun Tsing）及江崎（Kiang Gee）（均为日本人姓名）查询。

关于和平是否有望及其他措施，请通过田中（Dien Chung）兄告知我。

此致
敬礼
署名见附名片。

又及：两国之亲密友谊应基于人民。贵军以文明著称，希望贵军不要粗暴对待百姓，而应予以宽待。

December 21,

Minister Shigemitsu,

I beg to inform you that I arrived
in Shanghai yesterday and would like to have an interview
with you. If you have time, I shall come to you and
have a hearty talk with you. Besides I have some
important affairs to discuss with you.

Yours faithfully,
Sd. Chiang Zu-lih
(alias Ming Jih)

P.S. I appreciate your introduction to me last year
of Consul Shang Tsuan (上村) who had several
negotiations with me which resulted in satisfaction.

Chung Tsing (村) yesterday. I told them to
convey the matter to you and I believe that they have
dealt it with you already. I hope that you will appoint
a date for an interview.

December 31
Mr. King Jih,
My friend Liu Ching-san's men have
about 5,000 rifles and are at present distributed
on the border of Kiangsu and Shantung. I request
you to try to find some one in Shanghai to collect
them and organize them, whereby we can make a
fundamental force out of them with a view to
completing the Chinese Revolution. It will be
best to have a discussion with you, assistant.
Hoping that you will favour me with a reply,
Yours faithfully,
Cheng Chi-ming.

P.S. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen appointed Mu as Commander
of the 11th Army. During the Northern Punitive
Drive, he was appointed by Chiang as Commander-
in-Chief of the Kiao Tung People Group and at
present acts as Major General Military Advisor.
Li Chi-sen is at present Director of Military
Training; have you any connection with him and
can you introduce me to him?

Ming,

I am very glad to hear that Tsou Sung will
proceed to Hupeh and I hold the following opinion :

1. As the matter according to Sun Ah-deu (? Sun Fo)
will be announced at a time when everything had
been properly arranged and it is believed that the
"Straw Head General" (Chiang Kai-shek) will not
meddle with it. Will you advise Tsing not to
worry any more. He (? Tsou Sung)) will go to
Nanking to exert all his energy to assist in
accomplishing the matter.

2. As regard Mo Nghis (Feng) case, the official
circle exerts every effort to prove that it is
groundless. Have you heard any evidence regarding
the same?

3. As there is assistance from the Interior, the
situation will not be affected and as the
influence of the bandits will be intensified during the
present national crisis in Hupeh, it is very needful
to have a stable commander. The present unsettled
situation will profit a wise person who can pick up
an excellent chance through it.

(sd.) Han Ts-ching

---

明：

获悉邹松（Tsou Sung）将赴湖北，不胜欣喜，我有如下意见：

1. 根据孙阿斗（Sun Ah-deu，？孙科）的意见，此事将在一切安排妥当后公布，相信“草头将军”（蒋介石）不会从中干涉。请劝告青（Tsing）不必再担忧。他（？邹松）将前往南京，竭尽全力协助促成此事。

2. 关于莫尼斯（Mo Nghis，冯）一案，官方正竭力证明其毫无根据。阁下是否听到有关此事的任何证据？

3. 由于有内地援助，局势不会受到影响；且鉴于当前湖北国难期间匪患影响将加剧，非常需要一位稳定的指挥官。目前的动荡局势有利于智者，使其能从中抓住绝佳机会。

（签署）韩子英（Han Ts-ching）

---

信封：蒋先生，
明极
转交西摩路慈惠里744号。

候复。来自 Zing Ming。

Judge to Mr. Sung Yue Sung:- According to the Rendition Agreement, the Court have to make some enquiries in this case. I am not going to have the case renewed.
Judge to Accused: Your case was tried by Judge Soong yesterday and it has been considered by us to hand you over to the P.S.B.
Mr. Sung Yue Sung (Lawyer):- The question of Extradition in this case involves much on the part of law. Judge Soong, when he sat yesterday, allowed to give me time to make out a written petition regarding the part of law in this case. Will the Court give me time to express my opinion.
Judge to Mr. Sung:- According to the Rendition Agreement, we do not have to talk about law. Article 6 of the Agreement clearly states that if the case is proved to be a Prima Faci case, it can be handed over.
Mr. Sung Yue Sung:- In the Judicial Court, I submit that Law and criminal procedure should be taken into consideration. I draw the Court's attention to Article 5 of the Agreement .
Judge to Mr. Sung:- This case has been proved to be a prima faci case, and according to the Rendition Agreement should be handed over.

Judge to Mr. Sung:- The enquiries have already been concluded by
Judge Soong. There is no ruling in this case. I hand them over acco-
rding to the Rendition Agreement.

Mr. Sung:- I ask for a short remand of two to three days.

Representatives of P.S.B. :- A despatch from the P.S.B. was sent to
to this Court this morning for the extradition of the accused. I ask
the Court to hand them over to us, as it has been the ruling in this
Court to hand accused over in cases like this. I also ask that the
documents and other property seized be handed over to us with the ac-
cused.

Mr. Sung Yue Sung:- I ask the Court to give the accused a chance
for explanation for two or three minutes.

Judge to Mr. Sung:- You may explain now.

Mr. Sung:- According to Article 15 of the Criminal Procedure the
residence of the accused should be taken into consideration in this
case. All the accused reside in the Settlement and are therefore sub-
ject to the Jurisdiction of this Court. The second point, is if they
are handed over, they should not be handed over to the P.S.B. but to
the Kiangsu High Court. The third point, according to Article 21 of
the Criminal Procedure the accused should not be handed over to the
P.S.B. The fourth point, the Martial Law at Nantao, has not effected
in the Settlement, and therefore should not be handed over to the Ch-
inese Authorities. It is absolutely right to have the case tried in
this Court in which a Procurator sits with the Judge. It is the Civil
right of the accused to be tried before a Judicial Court to which the
Jurisdiction is subject. If according to the Rendition Agreement the
the accused are handed over, there is no use to make enquiries and no
use to prove a prima facie case if the Court has deemed to hand them
over. I ask that the execution of this be temporary suspended.

Judge to Mr. Sung:- This case was first discovered by the P.S.B.

宋岳松先生：- 我请求法庭给被告两三分钟的时间进行解释。

法官对宋先生说：- 你现在可以解释。

宋先生：- 根据《刑事诉讼法》第15条，本案中应考虑被告的居住地。所有被告均居住在租界内，因此受本庭管辖。第二点，如果他们被移交，不应移交给上海市公安局，而应移交给江苏高等法院。第三点，根据《刑事诉讼法》第21条，被告不应移交给上海市公安局。第四点，南市的戒严令并未在租界生效，因此不应移交给中国当局。由检察官与法官共同坐堂审案的本庭审理此案是完全正确的。被告有权在具有管辖权的司法法院受审，这是其民事权利。如果根据《引渡协定》将被告移交，若法庭已决定移交他们，那么进行查问和证明表面证据确凿就没有任何意义了。我请求暂时中止执行此决定。

法官对宋先生说：- 本案最初是由上海市公安局发现的。

For that they during the month of March 1932 at Shanghai

Mr. Sung Vung Dong for the 4th accused.

Mr. Lea:- At 4.10.p.m. on the 2th 12/3/32 a detective named Ng
Siau Fung from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau went to Louze Stat-
ion and reported that there were a number of persons in Rooms No.34
and 29 in the Great Eastern Hotel plotting to overthrow the present
Safety Bureau and the Volunteer Corps in Nantao. He also asked for
assistance to raid these rooms. The Police gave them assistance and
went there and arrested the 1st to the 9th accused as well as findi-
ng many documents, shops and flags in the room. These things are of
an illegal organization called "The Self-Defence Army". House No.7
of Rue Chapsel was also raided and more documents were found relati-
ng to the same organization. House No.26 Rue Brenier Montmorand was
then raided and there the 10th and 11th accused were arrested. The
representative of the Bureau is in Court and he will apply for the
handing over of the accused. The Police have no opinion re extradit-
ion and we entirely leave it in the hands of the Court.

D.S. Wilcox:- At 4.10.p.m. on the 12/3/32 members of the Public
Safety Bureau came to Louza Station and asked for assistance to arr-
est some persons in Rooms 34 and 29 of the Great Eastern Hotel. They
stated that the place was being used as a meeting place to plot the
overthrow of the Public Safety Bureau and administration of the Mun-
icipality of Greater Shanghai. Myself and C.D.S. 128 gave assistance

第1号被告回答法官问：- 我与另外三人住在大东旅馆34号房间。我已在那里住了4天。其他三人来房间拜访第9号被告。在房间内发现了文件、印章和旗帜。Wong Ming是南市公安局的总探长。我不认识宋孙楚（Soong Sun Chu）。“东南自卫军”的性质是基于爱国主义。我不知道这支军队的计划。它仅成立了3或4天。第9号被告是我的朋友，是我首先邀请他来房间的。几天前我遇到一个叫Lee Kgoh的人，他给了我100美元在旅馆订房。起初我只订了34号房间，我预订29号房间是因为“李”的妻子也住在那里。“李”只让我在那里招待他的朋友；我在“自卫军”中没有职位，也不知道有多少人参与其中。我不知道

Detective Ng Siau Pung to Judge :- The 1st accused himself is Lee Ngoh because a shop the name of "Lee" was found in his possession.

1st Accused in answer to Judge :- I am not "Lee Ngoh". The shop was never found in my possession.

2nd Accused in answer to Judge :- I am a private "Inspector" in the Shanghai Arsenal. Soong Kee Liang is a relative of the Chief of the Arsenal. It was the 9th accused who asked me to go to the room No.34 of the Great Eastern Hotel. The 9th accused was formerly the Chief of Staff in the 29th Army. I went to the Hotel on the 11/3/32. On the 12/3/32 I went there again. I do not know the 1st accused or anything about the "Self-Defence Army. The 9th accused asked me to go to the Hotel and he promised to get me a job. I would like to be tried in this Court, because then I would have a chance to explain.

3rd Accused in answer to Judge :- My real name is Soong S Zeng. I gave a false name to the Police when I was arrested. I know nothing about the Self-Defence Army. I am employed in the Shanghai Arsenal as a clerk. On the 11/3/32 I was in my friends house named Lieu Tso Ming, and there the 9th accused was introduced to me. On the 12/3/32 wrote a note to me asking me to go to the Great Eastern Hotel. I went there and the 9th accused introduced me to the 1st accused. They asked me to participate in the "Patriotic Self-Defence Army". I was arrested when I was about to leave the room. The 2nd accused is also employed in the Arsenal. There were a number of documents in Room No.29. I wish to be tried in this Court and I also beg the Court to make full enquiries into this case.

4th Accused in answer to Judge :- I reside at No.7 Rue Chapsal. I went to Room No.34 of the Great Eastern Hotel to see the 1st accused. I was introduced to this place by one named Tou Ming Gee. It was the 6th accused who first spoke to me about the Self-Defence Army. I was told that the present Safety Bureau and the Nantao Volunteer Corps

侦探 Ng Siau Pung 回答法官问：- 第1号被告本人就是 Lee Ngoh，因为在他身上发现了一枚刻有“李”字的印章。

第1号被告回答法官问：- 我不是“Lee Ngoh”。从未在我身上发现过那枚印章。

第2号被告回答法官问：- 我是上海兵工厂的一名私人“督察”。宋启良（Soong Kee Liang）是兵工厂厂长的亲戚。是第9号被告叫我去大东旅馆34号房间的。第9号被告曾任第29军参谋长。我于1932年3月11日去的旅馆。1932年3月12日我又去了一次。我不认识第1号被告，也不了解“自卫军”的任何情况。第9号被告叫我去旅馆，并答应给我找份工作。我希望在本庭受审，因为这样我就有机会解释。

第3号被告回答法官问：- 我的真名是宋S Zeng（音译）。被捕时我向警方报了假名。我对自卫军一无所知。我在上海兵工厂任职员。1932年3月11日，我在我的朋友刘佐明（Lieu Tso Ming，音译）家中，第9号被告在那里被介绍给我。1932年3月12日，他给我写了一张便条，叫我去大东旅馆。我去了那里，第9号被告把我介绍给第1号被告。他们要求我参加“爱国自卫军”。我正准备离开房间时被捕。第2号被告也在兵工厂工作。29号房间里有很多文件。我希望在本庭受审，我也恳请法庭对此案进行全面调查。

第4号被告回答法官问：- 我住在查普萨尔路（Rue Chapsal）7号。我去大东旅馆34号房间看望第1号被告。是一个名叫Tou Ming Gee（音译）的人把我介绍到那里的。是第6号被告首先跟我谈起自卫军。我被告知，目前的公安局和南市义勇队

续 愿意改组。我在军队中没有固定职位，只是协助外交方面的工作。第1号被告是 Lee Ngok（音译）的代表。顾维钧博士（Mr. Wellington Koo）也知道这个组织，他负责与上海的英美当局打交道。我被告知，英美当局不会反对这个组织，因为在这支军队占领南市区后，将为他们提供极大的便利。我反对被移交给公安局。
第5号被告回答法官问：- 我是一名退伍军人。我在大东旅馆29号房间被捕。我的长子通知我，我的三儿子在与日军作战期间在闸北阵亡，所以我来上海核实这一消息。第8号被告曾是我的同学，他来看望我，并请我于1932年3月12日去旅馆。1932年3月12日我去了那里，但发现他不在房间里。后来他来了，不久后我们都被捕了。我对“自卫军”一无所知。
第6号被告回答法官问：- 被捕前我从未去过大东旅馆29号房间。
副巡长威尔逊（D.S. Wilson）回答法官问：- 第6号被告被捕时在房间里。
第6号被告回答法官问：- 我从“Lieu-ki”（音译）来到上海。我在路上遇到第1号被告，他叫我去大东旅馆。我对自卫军一无所知。我没受过教育。我反对被移交给公安局。
第7号被告回答法官问：- 我是大华大学（Dah Hwa College，音译）的教授。我认识第9号被告。我和一个叫蒋松道（Kiang Sung Dao，音译）的人一起去了大东旅馆，他是公安局第一科的探长。起初，我遇到一个叫宋子琴（Sung Tse Chin，音译）的人，他也是公安局第六科的探长，他跟我谈起了自卫军。他们在旅馆告诉我，目前的公安局将改组

Sheet No.5.

Continued. re-organized by the Self Defence Army. In the Hotel, I saw the 1st
accused hand over $3,000.00 to Kiang Sung Dao. The 1st accused is not
"Lee Ngoh", "Lee Ngoh" is a fat man. Kiang Sung Dao is my friend, and
he took part in the Self Defence Army. "Kiang" later betrayed us, and
that is why we were arrested. I ask that he be also dealt with as he
is also one of the participants in this matter. I object to being handed over to the P.S.B.

8th Accused in answer to Judge :- The visiting cards in Court are
mine. On the 12/3/32 I visited the 5th accused in his house, and later
we went to Room No.29 of the Great Eastern Hotel where we were arrested. I do not know the 9th accused. The 7th accused was in Room
No.29 when we first entered. I object to being handed over to the
Public Safety Bureau.

9th Accused :- I am a returned student from Japan. The statement
I made at the Station is contradictory because the translation cannot fully carry out my own meaning. I met the 1st accused in February
last year. On the 9/3/32 he came to my house but he did not meet me.
Later, he sent me a note asking me to go to the Great Eastern Hotel,
and I went there and met him. He talked to me about the organization
of the Self Defence Army. He told me that the Public Safety Bureau
and the Volunteer Corps at Nantao are all willing to be re-organized.
I suggested to him that if such an Army would not harm the Public
it could be organized. I also spoke to him about anti-Tsiang Ka Zah
for the non-resistance of the Japanese Invasion in the 3 Eastern Provinces. I object to being handed over to the Public Safety Bureau
because I have enough chance to explain here.

10th Accused :- I reside at 26 Rue Brenier Montmorand with Soong
Chi Liang and the 11th accused. The 11th accused is my nephew and so
is Soong S Tsang. "Zau Yao" is not my alias. "Yau Yao" is the name
of my relative. The letter in Court was written by a man named Tong
Sung and it was not addressed to me. Soong Zung Le is the name of my
brother. I do not know anything about the Self Defence Army. I know
the 2nd and 3rd accused.

第5页。

续。由自卫军重组。在酒店里，我看见第一被告将3,000.00美元交给蒋松道（Kiang Sung Dao）。第一被告不是“李鄂”（Lee Ngoh），“李鄂”是个胖子。蒋松道是我的朋友，他参加了自卫军。“蒋”后来背叛了我们，这就是我们被捕的原因。我要求也对他进行处理，因为他也是此事的参与者之一。我反对被移交给公安局。

第八被告回答法官：- 庭上的名片是我的。1932年3月12日，我去第五被告家中拜访了他，随后我们去了东亚大酒店29号房间，在那里我们被捕。我不认识第九被告。当我们刚进去时，第七被告就在29号房间里。我反对被移交给公安局。

第九被告：- 我是从日本归国的留学生。我在警局所做的陈述自相矛盾，因为翻译不能完全表达我的本意。我是去年二月认识第一被告的。1932年3月9日，他来到我家，但没有见到我。后来，他给我寄了一张便条，叫我去东亚大酒店，我便去那里见了他。他跟我谈了关于组建自卫军的事。他告诉我，南市公安局和义勇队都愿意接受重组。我建议他，如果这样一支军队不危害公众，就可以组建。我还跟他谈到了反蒋（Tsiang Ka Zah），因为他在东三省对日本入侵采取不抵抗政策。我反对被移交给公安局，因为我在这里有充分的机会进行解释。

第十被告：- 我与宋志良（Soong Chi Liang）及第十一被告住在布伦尼埃·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier Montmorand）26号。第十一被告是我的侄子，宋增藏（Soong S Tsang）也是我的侄子。“Zau Yao”不是我的别名。“Yau Yao”是我亲戚的名字。庭上的那封信是一个名叫唐松（Tong Sung）的人写的，并不是写给我的。宋宗乐（Soong Zung Le）是我兄弟的名字。我对自卫军一无所知。我认识第二和第三被告。

Detective Ng Siu Fung in answer to Judge :- The 10th and 11th
accused were arrested in the house off Rue Brenier Montmerand when
the premises were visited in search of documents.

11th accused:- The 10th accused is my uncle. I live in his house.
The 11th accused is a teacher in the Arsenal. Soong Kyi Lieng is my
cousin. Soong Zung Sah is the name of the father of Soong Sah Tsaung
I work in the Arsenal and I earn $9.00 per month. I object to being
handed over. I can furnish security.

Wit. Kiang Sung Dao :- I am a Detective Inspector of the Public
Safety Bureau. I admitted to Court that I took part in the organiz-
ation of the Self Defense Army on behalf of the Public Safety Bureau
but I arrested these accused because the League Commission will ar-
rive today in Shanghai and it would be a disgrace to China if any
violence should occur now in Nantao. The 7th. accused is my friend
and he asked me to assist in the organisation of the Self Defence
Army about a month ago. Afterwards he effected some arrangements with
a man named Sung Tsa Chu who is a detective in charge of the 8th.
Division of the P.S.Bureau.I am certain of this as Sung phoned to
me about the matter at 5..p.m. on the 8th. inst. At 4.0.p.m. on the
9th. inst. the 7th. came to my house and gave me $100.00. and later
Sung came and gave me two powers of attorney. They told me that I had
been appointed a Brigade General in the newly-organised army. They
also told me that Mr. Wellington Koo had assumed responsibility for
foreign affairs and that Mr. Sung Fo would provide financial support
and further, that Tseu Vung Gee would attend to military supplies.
When they left I reported this to my superior officer Wong Ming; The
latter then got into touch with Wellington Koo and Sun Fo but they
denied all knowledge of the Self-Defense Army. The 7th. sent a chop
to my house on the afternoon of the 10th. asking Sung S Chu and my-
self to accompany him on a visit to the commander-in-chief Tseu Vung
Gee. He told me that the 1st. was the chief director of the army;
the 9th. the chief-of-staff, the 3rd. the secretary and the 4th. a

第6页

侦探吴少峰（Ng Siu Fung）回答法官：- 第十和第十一被告是在搜查文件时，于布伦尼埃·蒙梅朗路（Rue Brenier Montmerand）的一所房屋内被捕的。

第十一被告：- 第十被告是我的叔叔。我住在他家里。（原文此处似有误，前文称第十一被告是第十被告的侄子，此处又重复“第十一被告是...”可能指代另一人或笔误，依原文译出）第十一被告是兵工厂的一名教师。宋基良（Soong Kyi Lieng）是我的表亲。宋增萨（Soong Sah Tsaung）的父亲名叫宋宗萨（Soong Zung Sah）。我在兵工厂工作，月薪9.00美元。我反对被移交。我可以提供保释金。

证人蒋松道（Kiang Sung Dao）：- 我是公安局的探长。我在法庭上承认，我代表公安局参与了自卫军的组织工作，但我逮捕这些被告是因为国联调查团今天将抵达上海，如果此时南市发生任何暴力事件，将是中国的耻辱。第七被告是我的朋友，大约一个月前他请我协助组织自卫军。后来，他与一名叫宋查楚（Sung Tsa Chu）的人达成了一些安排，此人是公安局第八分局负责侦缉工作的探员。我对此确信无疑，因为本月8日下午5点，宋就此事给我打了电话。本月9日下午4点，第七被告来到我家，给了我100.00美元，随后宋来了，给了我两份委任状。他们告诉我，我被任命为新组建军队的旅长。他们还告诉我，顾维钧先生已负责外交事务，宋佛（Sung Fo，音译，疑指孙科 Sun Fo）将提供财政支持，此外，朱永吉（Tseu Vung Gee，音译）将负责军需供应。他们离开后，我向我的上级王明（Wong Ming）汇报了此事；后者随即与顾维钧和孙科取得联系，但他们均否认对自卫军有任何了解。第十日下午，第七被告派人送了一枚印章到我家，要求宋查楚和我陪同他去拜访总司令朱永吉。他告诉我，第一被告是军队的总指挥；第九被告是参谋长；第三被告是秘书；第四被告是

did so. Tseu Vung Ges, the 1st. 2nd. 4th. and 9th. were all present

start a riot in Nantao on the morning of the 12th. inst., On the

meeting was being held and he instructed me to make the suggestion

Ming was informed of this and he told me to receive it. I was also
given some banners and badges. I went through with this in order to
get information regarding the organisation. The 7th. received an
appointment in the army as the chief of the Nantao Safety Bureau.
They also planned the overthrow of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai. Wong Ming also took part in a meeting at the hotel. Sung
Tsa Chu did not do so however but sent a representative. Later we
reported the matter to the Louza Police and the accused were arrested

dition. I would ask that the case be remanded to enable me to make

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized in the rooms, which prove the arrested
men to belong to an organisation which they call "Head-
quarters of the 1st Brigade, 2nd General Group of the
South East Self-Defense Army.

As far as can be ascertained the object of the
plot was to buy over the Public Safety Bureau and the
heads of the heads of the various administration Offices
of the Greater Shanghai Municipality and then form the
"South East Self-Defense Army" of men picked from the
Chinese Police and the Chinese Merchant Volunteer Corps.

Several appointments have already been issued for
Commissions in this army, two of which were handed over,
by the 7th accused on 11-3-32, to Zang Zah Jui ( )
Chief Captain of the 8th Division, Nantao Police and
Kiang Sung Sen ( ). Chief Captain of the Nantao
Public Safety Bureau, appointing them as Brigade Comman-
der and Battalion Commander, respectively of the afore-
mentioned army.

在房间内查获大量文件、印章和委任状，证明被捕者属于一个他们称为“东南自卫军第二总队第一支队司令部”的组织。

据查，该阴谋的目的是收买公安局及大上海特别市各行政机关的首长，然后从华捕和华商义勇队中挑选人员组建“东南自卫军”。

该军队的一些委任状已经发出，其中两份由第7名被告于1932年3月11日交给南市警察第八师师长臧致瑞（Zang Zah Jui）和南市公安局长江松森（Kiang Sung Sen），分别任命他们为上述军队的支队长和营长。
