Sol., S.B.
March 14, 32

Arrest of 'Revolutionaries' in the Settlement

// and Superintendent Robertson

At 4.10 p.m. March 12, members of the Public
Safety Bureau requested assistance from Louza Station to
arrest persons who were using Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great
Eastern Hotel, Kia Wo Kan, off Nanking Road as a meeting
place where they were plotting the overthrow of the Public
Safety Bureau and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
A party of Municipal Police attended and the following nine
persons were arrested:

Lee Hing-tseong ( )
Li Sing-ngah ( )
Soong Suh-tsang ( )
Chou Tsz-mih ( )
Chiu Keng-sung ( )
Iung Ngoh-ding ( )
Teong Zeong-pung ( )
Sung Ngoh-on ( )
Tsang Ming-yuen ( )

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized showing the arrested men to belong to an
organization known as the "Headquarters of the South-Eastern
Self Defence Army"( ). At 9.30 p.m. on the
same day Municipal Police with the assistance of members
of the French Police and Native Police searched the home
of the 2nd accused Lee Sing-ngah ( ) at 7 Rue Chapel
and seized a suitcase containing documents and correspondence
and in addition visited the home of the third accused Soong
Suh-tsang ( ) at 35 Sing Ming Tsang Alleyway,
Rue Recteur de Jessé (where a box containing documents
and correspondence was seized and the two premises of Officer
pages.zh:
Sol., S.B.
1932年3月14日

租界内“革命党人”之逮捕

// 及罗伯逊巡官

3月12日下午4时10分，公安局成员请求老闸捕房协助，逮捕那些利用南京路附近嘉禾馆 (Kia Wo Kan) 大华饭店 (Great Eastern Hotel) 29号和34号房间作为集会地点的人，他们在此策划推翻公安局及大上海市政府。
一队工部局警察到场，以下九人被捕：

Lee Hing-tseong ( )
Li Sing-ngah ( )
Soong Suh-tsang ( )
Chou Tsz-mih ( )
Chiu Keng-sung ( )
Iung Ngoh-ding ( )
Teong Zeong-pung ( )
Sung Ngoh-on ( )
Tsang Ming-yuen ( )

查获大量文件、印章和委任状，显示被捕者属于一个名为“东南自卫军总部” ( ) 的组织。同日晚上9时30分，工部局警察在法国警察和华人警察成员的协助下，搜查了第二被告 Li Sing-ngah ( ) 位于 Chapel 路7号的住所，查获一只装有文件和信件的皮箱，此外还走访了第三被告 Soong Suh-tsang ( ) 位于 Rue Recteur de Jessé 新明洋行弄堂35号的住所（在此查获一只装有文件和信件的箱子，并将该处发现的两名职员

pages.en:
-2-

found on the premises, taken into custody
    Soong Pah-dau        (        )
    . Zau Wei-sien       (        )
The seizure at this address, on examination, however, proved of
no value and had no bearing on the case.

    From statements made by the accused (copies of which
are attached) it appears that the Public Safety Bureau and
the offices of the various organs of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai were to be occupied by the South-Eastern Self
Defence Army at a certain time on March 13. The nucleus of
this army was to consist of members of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Merchants Volunteer Corps for which assistance
$100,000 was to be paid and 2,000 rifle supplied to the
representative of the Bureau in question together with an
assurance that no dismissal or change of the present staff
of the Public Safety Bureau would be affected. The new
army when formed would be commanded by General Chow Feng-chi
(        ), who according to the statement of the first
principal accused Li Hing-tseng, engineered the plot under
the name of Li Ngoh (        ).
    General Chen Feng-chi who resides at 146 Rue Pere
Robert is notorious for his treachery against Lu Yung-hsiang
(        ), Tutan of Chekiang, when he was overthrown by
Sun Chuan Fang and against the latter when the Nationalists
entered Chekiang in 1927. For his desertion of Sun Chuan-
fang the Nationalists appointed him commander of the 26th
Army which occupied Chapai and Nantao in 1927. He held
this post for about six months when his command was given
pages.zh:
-2-

拘捕
    Soong Pah-dau        (        )
    . Zau Wei-sien       (        )
然而，经查证，在该地址查获的物品毫无价值，与本案无关。

    根据被告所作的供词（副本附后），看来东南自卫军计划于3月13日的某个时刻占领公安局及大上海市政府各机关办公室。这支军队的核心将由公安局成员和商团义勇队组成，为此将支付10万美元援助，并向有关局的代表提供2,000支步枪，同时保证不对公安局现有人员进行解职或变动。新军队组建后，将由周凤岐将军 (        ) 指挥，据第一主犯 Li Hing-tseng 供称，周以 Li Ngoh (        ) 之名策划了此次阴谋。
    居住在 Pere Robert 路146号的陈凤岐将军因背叛浙江督军卢永祥 (        ) 而臭名昭著，当时卢被孙传芳推翻；后来当国民党于1927年进入浙江时，他又背叛了孙传芳。因其背叛孙传芳，国民党任命他为第26军军长，该军于1927年占领了闸北和南市。他担任此职约六个月，后因蒋介石怀疑其忠诚度，其指挥权被移交

pages.en:
-3-

to General Chen I (        ) owing to Chiang Kai-shek's doubt
as to his, Chou's, loyalty. Again in December 1929 Chou
planned a Coup d'Etat in Hangchow but the plot was discovered
before maturity and Chou was forced to flee.
        The statement of the 9th accused, Tsang Ming-yuan
(        ), a graduate of the Tokio Military Academy shows
him up as an individual who has lived on political and
military intrigue for the past twenty four years and a very
suitable man to assist in a plot of this kind.
        The accused have been charged with Insurrection
Contrary to Art. 103 of the C.C.R.C. and will appear before
Court on March 14 when an application for their extradition
will be made by the Chinese Authorities.

                                        Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

给陈仪将军 (        )。此外，周于1929年12月又在杭州策划政变，但阴谋在成熟前被发现，周被迫逃亡。
        第九被告 Tsang Ming-yuan (        ) 的供词显示，他是东京陆军士官学校毕业生，在过去二十四年里一直靠政治和军事阴谋为生，是非常适合协助此类阴谋的人选。
        被告被控犯有违反《中华民国刑法》第103条之内乱罪，并将于3月14日出庭，届时中国当局将提出引渡申请。

4) Circular to various organs.

5) Circular to various consulates.

6) Circular telegram.

7) Pass word.

8) Signals.

9) Design of flag, to use the present design but change the
characters.

List of property seized in Room No.34, Great Eastern Hotel,
King Hwa Rd., rented in the name of Lee Min Tsoong (李敏生),
at 4.20 p.m. March 12, 1932.

1. Blue cloth flag bearing the inscription of "Headquarters of
the South-Eastern Self Defence Army" 東南自衛軍第三師司令部

2. 1 written note stating as follows:-
"I shall come at 4 p.m. to-day to discuss the matter.
Please inform all comrades to attend."
Signed and chopped by
Wong Ming (黃明)。

3. 7 letters of appointment issued by/the Headquarters of Lee Ngoh
(李), Commander-in-Chief of the "Headquarters of the South
Eastern Self Defence Army", to the following persons :
1) Tsu Tao Dong (朱作同) as the Superintendent of the
Bureau of Public Utility.
2) Song Zau Yao (宋兆堯) as staff officer holding the
rank of colonel.
3) Li Tieh Kong (李鐵公) as the Special Deputy of the
Wireless Administration Bureau.
4) Tseng Ming Yuen (張明遠) as the Staff Officer and
Chief of Staff, Headquarters, South Eastern Self De-
fence Army.
5) Li Zau Tseng (李佐曾) as the Chief of General Staff
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.
6) Song Sz Tsaung (宋式璋) as the Chief of Secretariat
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.
7) Tseu Koen Dzung (周幹臣) as Senior Military Advisor
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.

4. 2 drafts of circulars addressed to the people by Li Ngoh (李壑)
and others of the Headquarters of South Eastern Self Defence
Army, to be despatched through various provincial, Hsien and other
official organs and newspaper offices, denouncing non-reinforce-
ments to the 19th Route Army which led to its subsequent re-
treat during the Sino-Japanese conflict in Shanghai, condemning
General Chiang Kai Shek to have caused the Japanese aggression
and civil strife, and announcing the object of the organization
of a South Eastern Self Defence Army to resist Japan and to save
the nation.

5) 1 map of Chekiang Province.
李 張 周
6) 1 envelop addressed to Messrs. Li and Tsang by Tseu.

7) 1 envelop addressed to Wong Tsong Zung (王仲仁) Great China
University by Ming (明) from Room No. 34, Dah Dong Lodging
House, Chun San Road. Enclosed letter to ask a loan of $50.00
to defray hotel expenses.

8) 1 draft of an incomplete speech announcing that the South Eas-
tern Self Defence Army, which is organized by the people, has
no party spirit, and that Chiang Kai Shek was formally a loa-
fer.

9) 4 name cards bearing the following names:-
1) James H. Tso (祝志偉) Boone College, C.M.U. Wuchang.
2) Henry T.Z. Huang (黃子健) Secretary, Sung Ming Cotton
3) Li Wing Hoong (李詠洪) Mgr. & Wkg. Co., 50 Kiangse Rd.
Shanghai.

10) 14 copies of Summarised regulations governing a children's
hospital at No. 137 Rd. Joffre.

11) A quantity of blank envelopes and paper.

1932年3月12日下午4时20分，在以李敏生（Lee Min Tsoong）名义租下的金华路（King Hwa Rd.）汇中饭店34号房间内查获的物品清单。

1. 一面蓝布旗，上书“东南自卫军第三师司令部”字样。

2. 一张字条，内容如下：-
“我将于今日下午4时前来商议此事。
请通知各位同志出席。”
由黄明（Wong Ming）签名并盖章。

3. “东南自卫军司令部”总司令李壑（Li Ngoh）签发给下列人员的委任状7份：
1) 朱作同（Tsu Tao Dong）任公用局局长。
2) 宋兆堯（Song Zau Yao）任上校参谋。
3) 李鐵公（Li Tieh Kong）任无线电台管理局特派副职。
4) 張明遠（Tseng Ming Yuen）任东南自卫军司令部参谋兼参谋长。
5) 李佐曾（Li Zau Tseng）任东南自卫军司令部参谋长。
6) 宋式璋（Song Sz Tsaung）任东南自卫军司令部秘书长。
7) 周幹臣（Tseu Koen Dzung）任东南自卫军司令部高级军事顾问。

4. 东南自卫军司令部李壑（Li Ngoh）等人致民众的通函草稿2份，拟通过各省、县及其他官方机构和报社发出，谴责因未对第十九路军进行增援导致其在上海中日冲突中随后撤退，谴责蒋介石将军导致日本侵略和内乱，并宣布组建东南自卫军以抗日救国的宗旨。

5) 浙江省地图1幅。
李 張 周
6) 周先生致李先生和张先生的信封1个。

7) 明（Ming）从春山路（Chun San Road）大东旅馆（Dah Dong Lodging House）34号房寄给大夏大学王仲仁（Wong Tsong Zung）先生的信封1个。内附信件请求借款50.00美元以支付酒店费用。

8) 一篇未完成的演讲草稿，宣称由民众组织的东南自卫军没有党派色彩，并称蒋介石从前是个游手好闲之徒。

9) 名片4张，姓名如下：-
1) James H. Tso (祝志偉)，武昌华中大学（C.M.U.）博文学院。
2) Henry T.Z. Huang (黃子健)，秘书，松明棉花
3) Li Wing Hoong (李詠洪)，经理，江西路50号华兴公司（Wkg. Co.），上海。

10) 霞飞路137号儿童医院管理规章摘要14份。

11) 空白信封和纸张若干。
